title: Software engineer
description:
Ben je al wat jaren software aan het bouwen en wil je echt impact maken? Dat kan als software engineer bij AFAS! Via onze software automatiseren duizenden organisaties in Nederland hun bedrijf. Zo krijgt een derde van de Nederlanders hun loonstrook via onze software en wordt bij het bakken van bijna al het brood in Nederland onze software gebruikt. En dat allemaal met één standaardpakket, zonder maatwerk.



Bent u de juiste sollicitant voor deze functie? Ontdek het door het functieoverzicht hieronder te lezen.

Wil je graag eerst kennismaken voordat je gaat solliciteren? Plan een afspraak in met één van onze collega's.


Bij AFAS? Waarom zou ik dat willen?

Nou, bijvoorbeeld omdat je dan bij het beste en leukste softwarebedrijf van Nederland werkt. Samen met ruim 650 collega's zetten we ons elke dag in voor het succes van onze 14.000+ klanten. Van accountantskantoren tot ziekenhuizen, allemaal gebruiken ze AFAS!


Bij AFAS werken we met meer dan 150 enthousiaste mensen aan onze software, van documentalist tot productmanager: we streven naar het beste product voor onze klant. Onze 70+ ontwikkelaars zijn verdeeld over 10 teams en werken met elkaar aan verschillende projecten en met verschillende technologieën. Zo hebben wij ons eigen frontend en back-end framework ontwikkelt waar we gebruik van maken in al onze nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Als software ontwikkelaar werk je mee om ons product verder uit te bouwen en het succes van meer dan 3.000.000 gebruikers te garanderen.


Oke, interessant! Maar wat ga ik dan doen?

Je werkt in een team met developers, ontwerpers en test engineers. Samen bouwen jullie aan uiteenlopende projecten, zoals:



  • nieuwe functionaliteit voor talentmanagement en onboarding;
  • tooling waarmee herstelwerkzaamheden in de cloud sneller en slimmer gaan;
  • koppelingen met webshops voor automatische factuurverwerking;
  • implementatie van een passkey om in te loggen.

Daarnaast ontwikkel je jezelf én je collega’s door code reviews, kennisdeling en technische sessies.


Loop een digitale dag mee met software developer Wim


Over de AFAS-cultuur: wat maakt die zo tof?

Wij inspireren bedrijven en organisaties om beter te ondernemen. We inspireren de wereld om ons heen om het beter te doen. En we inspireren jou om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Dat begint allemaal met onze cultuur. De AFAS-cultuur. Die koesteren we. De belangrijkste pijlers? Vertrouwen (we hebben maar één regel en dat is: handel vanuit gezond verstand), gek (onze CEO verkleedt zich als giraffe op het jaarlijkse AFAS-uitje), familie (we zijn er voor elkaar én durven direct en eerlijk tegen elkaar te zijn) en doen (eerst doen, dan denken; dat is ons motto). Gaaf, toch?


Dit heb je

  • Hbo of wo denk- en werkniveau.
  • 2 jaar of meer werkervaring als software ontwikkelaar.
  • 32 uur per week de tijd om bij ons te werken (We werken vier dagen in de week, vrijdag is je vaste ontwikkeldag. Lees meer over Vier het leven en je ontwikkeldag).
  • Geen wereldreis nodig om op kantoor te komen. In je eerste halfjaar ben je vier dagen per week op kantoor om AFAS goed te leren kennen, daarna minimaal drie dagen per week.
  • Passie voor programmeren.
  • Een open houding en de wens om zowel jezelf te ontwikkelen als anderen verder te brengen.

Dit kan je

  • Nederlands spreken en schrijven.
  • Ontwikkelen op het .NET platform met C# en/of voor het web met TypeScript en JavaScript.
  • Werken met Microsoft SQL.
  • Software ontwikkelen door gebruik te maken van verschillende patronen en technieken.
  • Jezelf nieuwe technologieën eigen maken, en dit ook overbrengen aan collega’s.
  • Zelfstandig en nauwkeurig werken.

Dit krijg je

  • Een ontzettend leuk team waarmee je nauw samenwerkt.
  • Flexibele werktijden en thuiswerkdagen. Maandag en donderdag zijn vaste kantoordagen, dinsdag of woensdag mag je werken vanuit huis.
  • Ruimte om technologische ontwikkelingen te volgen, je collega’s te inspireren of zelf geïnspireerd te worden.
  • Moderne hard- & software.
  • Verantwoordelijkheid, maar ook een goede begeleiding.
  • Een goed salaris (afhankelijk van ervaring), een winstdeling, een 13e maand en vakantiegeld.
  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen met interne en externe opleidingen.
  • Gekkigheid, zoals toffe bedrijfsuitjes, leuke feestjes in ons clubhuis of een concert in AFAS Live (als je dit leuk vindt!).
  • Alle andere arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je in onze werkwijzer.

Lijkt dit jou een leuke functie, maar twijfel je of je voldoet aan alle eisen? xgiwjmb Gooi die twijfel overboord, we moedigen je juist aan om wél te solliciteren!

title: Administrative Outpatient Rehab Associate, 30hr - Days
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Winchester Hospital is a Top Massachusetts recognized 223-bed regional hospital that is the leading provider of comprehensive health care services in the northwest suburban Boston area.



The Outpatient Rehab Associate contributes to the Hospital’s mission by welcoming and registering patients in an efficient and empathetic manner. This position is the first face/voice of the department when a patient calls/visits and can have a dramatic impact on making individuals feel welcomed. In addition this position impacts patient safety, clinical care, Registration, and claim reimbursement by ensuring the patient identifiers are correct, insurance coverage is accurate and effective on the service dates and by collecting copayments. The functions of this position directly affect the bottom line of the Rehabilitation department.

Job Description:

Days: Monday-Thursday

Education Preferred: 1 year of advanced schooling

Experience Preferred: 3 years of administrative support/secretarial experience in a health care office setting including 1 year or more of Epic, Google suite experience and efficiency.

  • Greets patients and others timely and in a manner that is respectful and empathetic. Answers the phone in the same manner

  • Notifies appropriate personnel or records messages

title: Head of Legal
description:
About the role

Pocket is looking for its first in-house legal hire to build and own the company’s legal function as we scale globally.

This is a highly hands-on role working directly with the founders across corporate, commercial, employment, privacy, compliance, and people-related matters.

You will serve as the central legal owner across the organization, working closely with our external counsel while progressively bringing more legal knowledge, processes, and execution in-house.

This is not a role for someone who only coordinates outside counsel. We are looking for someone who is comfortable drafting, negotiating, making practical risk assessments, and building processes from scratch.

What you'll own

Corporate & Governance

  • Corporate governance and board-related matters
  • Equity, ESOP, stock option and capitalization matters
  • Fundraising and financing support
  • Coordination with external corporate counsel

Commercial

  • Drafting and negotiating commercial agreements

  • NDAs and other day-to-day contracts
  • Building standardized contracting processes and templates

Employment & People

  • Employment and contractor agreements
  • Employee separations and related documentation
  • IP assignment and confidentiality matters
  • Employee policies and handbook
  • Immigration and employment-law coordination
  • Supporting People Operations and HR-related compliance

Privacy & Compliance

  • Privacy and data protection
  • Consumer protection
  • Product-related regulatory matters
  • Internal compliance programs
  • Coordination with specialist external counsel where necessary

Legal Operations

  • Build Pocket's legal infrastructure
  • Create scalable processes for contracts and approvals
  • Manage outside counsel and legal spend
  • Identify legal risks proactively rather than reactively

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of relevant legal experience
  • Strong training at a leading law firm and/or high-growth technology company
  • Experience working with venture-backed technology companies
  • Strong corporate and commercial background
  • Familiarity with employment matters and privacy/compliance
  • Comfortable operating across areas outside of a narrow legal specialization
  • Highly practical and commercially minded
  • Able to distinguish between material company risk and theoretical legal risk
  • Comfortable working directly with founders in a fast-moving environment
  • Builder mentality — you want to create the function, not inherit an established legal department

Experience with consumer technology, hardware, AI, international expansion, or high-growth DTC businesses is a strong plus.

Reporting

Reports directly to the COO and works closely with the CEO, CTO, Finance, Operations, Product, and external counsel.

As Pocket grows, this person should have the opportunity to build and lead the broader Legal function.

You will be part of Modular Control Architecture (MCA) software team. The MCA SW architecture is highly flexible, made up of many modular software, application, and hardware elements. While flexibility adds opportunity and capability, it also adds complexity, driving the importance of a robust platform SW and communication strategy. MCA is built on MBSE (Model Based System Engineering) principles for requirements management and test cases with full traceability built into the MBSE model.

How will you make a difference?

The Engineering Technical Leader is responsible for the development and integration of ethernet communication networks supporting the locomotive control system. This role focuses on ensuring robust, reliable, secure, and scalable data exchange between distributed controllers, including locomotive supervisory controls, propulsion controls, engine controllers, I/O modules, and external interfaces.

Operating within the MCA (Modular Control Architecture) team, this role bridges network architecture, control system behavior, and validation, ensuring network communication supports locomotive control, performance, and cybersecurity expectations across multiple locomotive platforms.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant engineering experience

  • Experience with networked control systems, including embedded communications, Ethernet-based networking, switch protocols, timing, synchronization, and interface definition

  • Experience in system integration and/or system validation

  • Proficiency with DDS, INCA, MATLAB/Simulink, and GitLab-based source repositories

  • Working knowledge of Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) using SysML and familiarity with INCOSE systems engineering best practices

  • Ability to support hands‑on validation in simulation labs and on‑locomotive environments

  • Willingness to travel as required

What will your typical day look like?

  • Lead the development of the control system network architecture, including data flows, protocols, bandwidth allocation, timing, and redundancy.

  • Own the integration of distributed control nodes across locomotive control system networks

  • Evaluate and manage network impacts of new features, software updates, and hardware changes.

  • Develop and execute network-centric system integration test plans across SIL, HIL, lab, and on‑locomotive environments.

  • Validate network performance against latency, jitter, throughput, synchronization, and availability requirements.

  • Investigate and resolve cross-system communication issues, including message loss, timing instability, packet congestion, and fault recovery behavior.

  • Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure consistent interface definitions and assumptions.

  • Ensure alignment between logical architectures and physical network implementations.

  • Plan individual work for assigned features as input to project plans.

  • Execute development activities with cross functional team to ensure design status, readiness, adequacy, and test asset availability

  • Conduct test plan and integration result design reviews

  • Communicate status on system architecture and stability to engineering leadership

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

title: Equipment Buyer/Planner
description:
Primary Function of Position

The Manufacturing Equipment Buyer/Planner is responsible for the procurement and lifecycle management of materials, components, and spare parts required to install, sustain, and maintain manufacturing line equipment. This position plays a critical role in ensuring uninterrupted production by proactively sourcing and securing the equipment-related materials and spare parts necessary to support maintenance, repairs, upgrades, and capital deployments.

The core of this role is procurement execution: identifying qualified suppliers, negotiating terms, managing purchase orders, and ensuring on-time delivery of critical parts and materials. The successful candidate will maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure reliability under time-sensitive conditions and will resolve sourcing issues quickly to prevent disruption to production continuity. Experience with materials or supply planning is a plus, as it supports more effective forecasting and coordination with maintenance and operations teams, but is not the primary focus of the role.

This position is well suited to a candidate who demonstrates strong procurement expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and a consistent record of proactive sourcing and execution in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

Essential Job Duties

  • Plan, buy, and manage direct materials and spare parts required to support manufacturing line equipment, tooling, automation, and test systems, ensuring continuity of operations and minimal production disruption.
  • Partner with Engineering, Maintenance, and Production to define and maintain technical specifications, drawings, acceptance criteria, and documentation for equipment materials and spares supporting installation, sustainment, and repair activities.
  • Own spare parts strategy for manufacturing equipment, including criticality assessment, recommended stocking levels, lead‑time risk mitigation, and lifecycle planning aligned to equipment uptime and production needs.
  • Support Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), deviations, and qualification builds by assessing and executing procurement impacts related to equipment materials, spare parts, cost, lead time, and supplier scope.
  • Execute sourcing events (RFI/RFQ/RFP) for manufacturing equipment materials, line tooling, test and measurement systems, and associated spare parts, evaluating total cost of ownership (TCO), serviceability, and long‑term supportability.
  • Supports negotiation and of administration of supplier commercial terms where required—including pricing, payment terms, incoterms, lead times, warranties, service agreements, and after‑sales support—to meet manufacturing quality, cost, and delivery (QCD) objectives.
  • Partners with Sourcing and Category Management in supplier governance and QBRs, includes monitoring of supplier performance (OTIF, lead time adherence, responsiveness, warranty performance, corrective actions) as well as identifying and mitigating supply risks that could impact manufacturing line availability.
  • Converts approved requisitions into purchase orders; manage acknowledgements, expedites, changes, cancellations, and deliveries through installation, commissioning, or spares receipt with proactive risk management.
  • Coordinate logistics and site‑readiness activities—including packaging, freight, customs documentation, rigging, utilities, and safety requirements—to enable on‑time deployment of manufacturing equipment materials and spares.
  • Track and report procurement activities against manufacturing project schedules, equipment installations, and sustainment plans, providing clear status, risks, and recovery actions to stakeholders.
  • Manage end‑of‑life (EOL) and obsolescence for equipment materials and spares by partnering with Engineering to identify, qualify, and transition alternate parts and suppliers.
  • Serve as the liaison between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance to execute the Request for Capital Expenditure (RCE) process in compliance with company procedures.
  • Prepare, submit, and maintain complete technical, financial, and contractual documentation (RCEs, BOMs, contracts, spares lists) to support audit readiness and regulatory compliance when required.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Manufacturing-Focused Procurement: Demonstrated experience buying materials, components, and spares for manufacturing line equipment, automation, tooling, or capital assets.
  • Spare Parts and Lifecycle Planning: Strong capability in critical spares identification, stocking strategies, lead‑time risk mitigation, and lifecycle support of production equipment.
  • Administration and Organization: Proven ability to organize and evaluate data to support timely execution of core job responsibilities and support sourcing events where required.
  • Technical Acumen: Ability to interpret equipment drawings, data sheets, BOMs, and specifications, translating engineering and maintenance requirements into executable purchasing actions.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Effective partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Maintenance, Finance, Quality, and Sourcing to align operational, technical, and compliance needs.
  • Execution and Reliability: Strong bias for action with ownership of delivery performance, equipment readiness, and spares availability supporting manufacturing uptime.
  • Analytical and Decision‑Making Skills: Ability to assess supply risk, forecast equipment and spare part demand, prioritize critical needs, and make data‑driven decisions under operational pressure.
  • Process Discipline: Consistent execution across requisition‑to‑PO cycle time, PO accuracy, contract coverage, and documentation rigor.

Required Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Formal training in purchasing, materials management, production planning, or inventory management.
  • Experience or training in regulated or quality‑controlled manufacturing environments (e.g., medical devices, semiconductors, aerospace, automotive).
  • Documented technical training enabling interpretation of equipment data sheets, mechanical/electrical drawings, P&IDs, and manufacturing BOMs.
  • Proficiency in ERP and purchasing systems (e.g., SAP, SAP Fiori, Coupa, Agile, NEPTUNE) with strong Excel capabilities for cost modeling and analysis.
  • Training in negotiation, cost analysis, and supplier management, through formal coursework, certifications, or structured programs.
  • Strong written and verbal business communication skills for effective engagement with cross‑functional teams and suppliers.

Working Conditions

  • Maintains on-site presence to perform core job duties; expected to be in the office a minimum of 5 days per week. Schedule is subject to change as project schedules necessitate.
  • Potential for up to 20% travel, including visits to domestic and international supplier sites and manufacturing locations.

Job Description

About the role:


At Takeda, we are a forward-looking, world-class R&D organization that unlocks innovation and delivers transformative therapies to patients. By focusing R&D efforts on four therapeutic areas and other targeted investments, we push the boundaries of what is possible in order to bring life-changing therapies to patients worldwide.

As an Associate Director-level clinical data science leader within Data & Quantitative Sciences, you will translate complex clinical, biomarker, and external data into actionable evidence that informs clinical development decisions.

How you will contribute:

  • Lead fit-for-purpose statistical, data science, and advanced analytics approaches across assigned studies, assets, or specialty areas, including exploratory analysis, predictive modeling, simulation, and integrated data review.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Clinical, Clinical Pharmacology, PSPV, Clinical Data Management, Translational Sciences, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, and external partners to ensure high-quality, traceable, analysis and submission-ready data and decision-ready insights.

  • Advance modern ways of working by applying AI/ML, automation, reusable analytics workflows, and governed data standards while maintaining scientific rigor, regulatory awareness, and patient-focused decision making.

  • Lead clinical data science strategy and delivery for one or more studies, assets, or capability areas, ensuring alignment with development objectives, timelines, quality expectations, and stakeholder needs.

  • Design and/or execute quantitative analyses using clinical trial data, biomarkers, real-world data, external data, and other relevant sources to generate interpretable insights for study teams and governance forums.

  • Apply appropriate statistical, machine learning, simulation, and visualization methods to support patient-level prediction, endpoint interpretation, risk assessment, scenario planning, and evidence generation.

  • Define requirements for model-ready datasets and analytics-ready data flows, including variable derivations, data quality expectations, lineage, traceability, metadata, and documentation sufficient for regulated clinical development use.

  • Partner with Clinical Pharmacology PSPV, Translational Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Regulatory, and platform teams to ensure that CDISC, submission, and downstream quantitative decision-making needs are built into study setup, data review, and reporting processes.

  • Provide scientific and technical oversight of internal and external delivery partners, including review of analysis plans, specifications, code, outputs, data visualization, and interpretation of findings.

  • Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks related to data quality, analytic assumptions, vendor delivery, timelines, reproducibility, and regulatory acceptability of data science outputs.

  • Drive continuous improvement in clinical data science practices through reusable code, standards, training, mentoring, automation, AI-enabled workflow improvements, and adoption of industry best practices.

  • Mentor junior colleagues or delivery partners in clinical data science methods, reproducible analytic practices, technical problem solving, and effective communication of quantitative insights.

Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

  • PhD in statistics, biostatistics, data science, epidemiology, biomedical engineering, computer science, quantitative sciences, or related field with 5+ years of relevant experience; or MS with 8+ years of relevant experience. Equivalent combinations should be reviewed with HR.

  • Significant experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare research environment, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional decisions at study, asset, or functional level.

  • Experience providing technical leadership, matrix leadership, vendor oversight, and/or mentorship of junior colleagues or delivery partners.

  • Advanced knowledge of clinical trial design, drug development, endpoints, estimands, biomarkers, data interpretation, and the role of analytics in clinical decision making.

  • Strong foundation in statistics and quantitative methods, including longitudinal analysis, survival methods, causal reasoning, simulation, predictive modeling, and uncertainty communication.

  • Hands-on proficiency in R and/or Python, with working knowledge of SAS and SQL; ability to review and guide reproducible analyses, code quality, version control, and validated workflows.

  • Working knowledge of CDISC standards, including SDTM, ADaM, controlled terminology, Define-XML concepts, and submission-oriented data expectations.

  • Experience integrating and interpreting diverse data sources, including clinical trial, biomarker, real-world, external, imaging, digital health, or other high-dimensional data as appropriate to the portfolio.

  • Practical understanding of AI/ML and advanced analytics in regulated clinical development, including model development, validation, documentation, bias/assumption assessment, and fit-for-purpose deployment.

  • Knowledge of FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP, GxP, data privacy, inspection readiness, and traceability expectations relevant to clinical data and quantitative deliverables.

  • Communicates complex quantitative findings clearly to scientific, operational, technical, and senior leadership audiences.

  • Influences across functions without relying on direct authority; builds trusted partnerships with clinical, statistical, programming, data management, regulatory, technology, and vendor stakeholders.

  • Balances scientific rigor, speed, quality, and pragmatic delivery; proactively escalates risks with options and recommendations.

  • Demonstrates enterprise mindset, curiosity, continuous improvement, and commitment to developing others and advancing modern clinical data science capabilities.

title: Employment Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about supporting people with disability to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying and individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant at our Castle Hill NSW site within our Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Who Are We:

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

Who You Are:

A champion of diversity and inclusion – you believe that everyone, no matter their abilities, deserves a chance to succeed

A natural connector – you know how to create opportunities for participants and speak to stakeholders with confidence

Innovative and solutions focussed – You see the challenge as an opportunity and have experience creating pathways to success

You may also have experience in another industries or roles like sales, retail, call centre, hospitality, consulting, business development, and administration. These skills can set you up for success in this role!

Find the perfect match – you’ll support participants with disability to prepare for, find and maintain sustainable employment.

Boost Confidence – You will help participants see their strengths, overcome obstacles, and take on their new employment with a renewed sense of purpose

Shake Things Up – You will provide creative solutions to overcome employment challenges, making sure every participant has the tools and support for success

Advocating – You will be an advocate for inclusive hiring practices and workplace adjustments

Celebrate the Moments That Matter – Every successful placement is a success, and we are all about celebrating success, big and small with our participants

Building lasting connections – You will form partnerships with companies that are passionate about diversity and inclusion, making sure everyone has a chance to shine!

Why You’ll Love It

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

  • Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success

At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! title: Montör | Globalt företag | Eskilstuna
description:
Är du en person som har erfarenhet från att arbeta som montör eller har du alltid velat arbeta som montör? Då passar det här jobbet dig! Som montör hos vår kund som arbetar inom industrin så kommer du att ansvara för att noggrant montera och installera olika komponenter enligt specifikationer och instruktioner från vår kund, säkerställa att arbetet utförs med hög kvalitet samt bidra till teamets produktivitet.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som montör inom industrin, andra branscher eller inom produktionsmiljö. Eller är du en person som är väldigt intresserad av industrin och framförallt en montörs arbetsuppgifter så är du också den vi söker! Det är mycket viktigt att du kan lyssna noga och ta till dig instruktioner. Dels för att du alltid ska arbeta säkert men också utföra arbetet väl. Du behöver också ha goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt, för att kunna kommunicera effektivt med ditt team och följa säkerhetsföreskrifter. Din noggrannhet och tekniska intresse är centrala för att lyckas i rollen.

Som en av oss

Som anställd bemanningskonsult hos oss får du alltid en marknadsmässig lön, semester, pensionsavsättning, försäkringar och anslutning till vårt kollektivavtal. Vi vill att du ska må bra hos oss så självklart erbjuder vi våra konsulter friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård. Under din anställning har du en konsultchef som är ansvarig för ditt uppdrag och ser till att du trivs på din arbetsplats och stöttar dig samt utvecklar dig i din yrkesroll.

Om Lernia

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt omfattande nätverk erbjuder vi spännande jobb hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och varumärken som hjälper dig att utveckla din kompetens och karriär, både på lång och kort sikt.

Hur du söker tjänsten

För att söka tjänsten, scrolla ner till ansökningsformuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Bakgrundskontroll

För vissa tjänster ingår bakgrundskontroll som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Om du går vidare i processen kommer du att behöva verifiera din identitet via BankID innan kontrollen genomförs.

Solid knowledge of asynchronous design concepts and CDC methodologies. Deep understanding of SoC design flows (Lint, CDC, Synthesis/STA, Power). Strong fundamentals in digital design and scripting languages. Excellent problem‑solving and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with global multi-functional teams.

Preferred / Added Advantages

Exposure to LPDDR Subsystem, CPU Subsystems, and SoC Test Controller design. Experience with ASIC controllers for storage or memory systems. Hands‑on post‑silicon debug and silicon support experience.

title: Staff Service Desk Analyst
description:
Are you looking to join a fast-paced, dynamic team where you can put your program management and technical support skills to use? Intuit is looking for a dynamic and customer-focused Staff Service Desk Analyst to join our Workforce Technology team. If you love working in a culture of lean experimentation and rapid iteration, we've got a challenge for you!


The Staff Service Desk Analyst will be looked upon as the go-to lead technical and program resource for the Service Desk, overseeing staff and processes to ensure end users receive appropriate assistance while maintaining high touch service. This includes ownership of procedures related to the identification, prioritization, and resolution of end-user requests, as well as the monitoring, tracking, and coordination of Service Desk functions across a broader, cross-functional scope. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills combined with strong program management and technical judgment are essential to providing a high touch level of support at scale.


Responsibilities


  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the Service Desk, driving readiness and alignment on service delivery.

  • Own and manage dedicated support queues, overseeing the identification, prioritization, and resolution of end-user help requests.

  • Configure, implement, and provide advanced support for incident resolution and service request processes involving applications, hardware, network, and business systems.

  • Partner with external vendors and technical teams as the primary coordination point for both remote technical needs and onsite support logistics.

  • Lead readiness planning and execution for new technology rollouts, including training and enabling Service Desk technicians ahead of any new tools or systems introduced.

  • Work on complex, cross-functional assignments with limited supervision, drawing in specialized technical or vendor expertise whenever necessary.

  • Exercise discretion and judgment to ensure Operational Service Levels are met, recommending custom solutions to business problems that can have enterprise-wide impact.

  • Derive insights from support and incident data to recommend process improvements, both internally and with business partners, ensuring continual innovation.

  • Partner with a diverse group of stakeholders – including developers, PMs, business leaders, vendors, and senior leadership – to resolve issues impacting end users systemically.

  • Act as an escalation point for complex issues, taking ownership of resolution when a problem requires specialized knowledge or cross-team coordination beyond front-line support.

  • Contribute to Knowledge Base content and keep process documentation current.

  • Proactively lead planning cycles to prepare for upcoming technology refreshes, rollouts, and support scaling needs.

  • Mentor and educate colleagues from a technical and growth perspective, providing documentation and training as needed.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience; ITIL, CompTIA, MCP/CCNA/MCSA/MCSE, or similar technical certification (or in-progress coursework) a plus.

  • Proven experience in service desk, IT support, or technical program management, ideally with exposure to multi-site or distributed environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional relationships and influence without direct authority, working effectively with business leaders and vendor partners.

  • Strong troubleshooting and technical aptitude, with the ability to translate between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience managing support queues, ticketing systems, or similar workflow tools.

  • Vendor coordination experience, particularly around onsite technical support and technology deployment.

  • Apply effective project management skills; understands how to manage scope, time, functionality, cost, and quality across a program.

  • Solid relationship and performance management skills, including the ability to coach and develop junior colleagues.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to train and enable technical staff on new systems and processes.

  • Ability to work independently as a team member in a high-performance, 24/7 availability environment.

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar for process documentation, planning, and communication a plus.


Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Architect - Sales Engineer
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

Exciting opportunities exist within the Verizon Global Presales Engineering organization. As a Solutions Architect, you will be an integral part of a talented team collaborating with our clients’ on their Digital Transformation. You play a meaningful role in building long-term business relationships within assigned enterprise accounts. This is a high-impact role working closely with the Sales team and customers to identify and qualify opportunities and design solutions to address customer business challenges.

At Verizon, we do much more than sell technology. We deliver groundbreaking solutions that improve the agility, productivity and global reach of businesses. We lead. Others follow. No-one can match our capability to design, build and operate integrated global networks, cutting-edge information systems and mobile technologies. Are you ready to improve a best in class enterprise sales team that thrives on teamwork and collaboration? Can you see yourself delivering technology and innovative solutions that connect people the world over and transform the way communities live, work and play? Do you want to change the way the world works? Welcome to Verizon – a company you can be proud to represent and be a part of.

We’re a leader in transforming enterprises, including 97% of the Fortune 1000. We’re also a business that invests in its people. So as you contribute to our business, we’ll make sure you grow. And get the rewards you deserve. Competitive salaries are enhanced by plenty of incentive awards for sales performance.

You will seek to build deep, consultative technical relationships with your customers, effectively becoming a trusted adviser. An SA is ideally positioned to understand the customer's high-level objectives and match these to Verizon solutions in order to satisfy business and technical requirements.

    What we’re looking for...

    • Being an integral part of a team to identify and qualify business opportunities and develop the strategy to resolve technical matters.

    • Recommending integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution using best practices.

    • Owning the technical relationship with Verizon customers, including managing product and solution briefings, proof-of-concept work, and the coordination of additional technical resources.

    • Working directly with customers to create solutions and use cases that leverage Verizon product integrations that generate business value.

    • Articulating the Verizon Enterprise vision on technologies and solutions towards the Client; positions Verizon Enterprise as thought leader on key technological developments.

    • Leading prioritization of Customer solution / technical requirements and champions resolution of solution / product gaps internally (also towards Product Groups).

    • Developing individual skill set and expand product knowledge to maximize value and to deliver quality services to our clients.

    • Traveling to Client sites, conferences, and other related events as required.

    You’ll need to have:

    • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

    • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.

    • Four or more years of experience in the tech industry, pre-sales, customer-facing, consulting or other relevant technical experience.

    • Experience architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems.

    • Experience architecting and developing LAN/WAN or large infrastructure and network solutions for enterprise customers.

    • Experience with networking concepts including: software defined networking, routing, VPNs, load balancers, and firewalls.

    • Knowledge of data and information security - especially as it relates to issues within businesses.

    • Experience in two or more of the following areas: Software Defined Networking (SDN), IT infrastructure and systems security, cloud or network systems management, and business continuity.

    • Willingness to travel.

    • Valid driver's license.

    Even better if you have one or more of the following:

    • MA/MS degree in engineering or computer science.

    • Ability to quickly learn, understand, and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies and solutions in the cloud/IT technology space.

    • Experience running multiple projects or deals under tight timelines.

    • Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as AWS Solution Architect, Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK), CompTIA Security+, Cisco Certified Design or Network Associate, ITIL Foundations, or similar.

    • Experience implementing or designing two or more of the following: Data and IP Services Managed Operations; Security Services; Call Center Technologies and or IT Applications Management.

    If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

    Where you’ll be working

    In this mobile role, you'll primarily work from customer or field location(s), with occasional visits to a Verizon location for in-person training and meetings.

    Scheduled Weekly Hours

    40

    Equal Employment Opportunity

    Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

    Benefits and Compensation

    Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

    The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is a commission based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

    The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $202,000.00.

    The annual salary range for the Colorado location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $202,000.00.

title: Scheduler
description:
Consertus is a global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep human expertise with advanced digital tools to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,000 professionals worldwide, we help clients plan, execute, and optimize large-scale capital programs.

Our integrated services span digital, advisory, and delivery, empowering organizations to navigate complexity, manage risk, and achieve strategic goals in sectors including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial, life sciences, and technology.

At Consertus, we celebrate individual strengths, foster strong relationships, and promote flexibility in how and where we work. Join us to grow your career, develop your skills, and make a lasting impact as we transform how the world is built.

Discover how Consertus is driving transformative change for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve at www.consertus.com

About this Role:

Consertus is seeking an experienced Scheduler to support our Metrolink program in Pomona, California.

This position will provide advanced project scheduling and project controls support for complex rail and transit capital projects, working closely with the Project Controls Manager, project management teams, contractors, consultants, and other project stakeholders.

The Senior Scheduler will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed Primavera P6 CPM schedules, monitoring schedule performance against established baselines, evaluating schedule changes and delays, reviewing contractor-submitted schedules, and providing clear schedule reporting and recommendations to project leadership.

The ideal candidate brings significant scheduling experience supporting large-scale, multi-phase, multimillion-dollar design and construction programs, preferably within the rail, transit, heavy civil, or public infrastructure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain detailed, logic-driven construction schedules for new construction, renovation, and capital improvement projects.
  • Develop and analyze labor and equipment resource requirements and prepare resource-loaded and cost-loaded, time-phased schedules.
  • Establish and maintain project schedule baselines and monitor actual progress against approved baseline schedules.
  • Perform schedule updates, variance analysis, critical path analysis, and milestone tracking.
  • Identify schedule risks, delays, variances, and potential impacts to project milestones and completion dates.
  • Perform Time Impact Analyses (TIA) for proposed or actual schedule changes and delays.
  • Develop schedule mitigation strategies, recovery recommendations, and corrective-action plans for the Project Management Team.
  • Maintain logic-driven schedules that clearly identify major interfaces, dependencies, constraints, milestones, and critical-path activities.
  • Review and analyze contractor-submitted schedules for logic, sequencing, progress, compliance, and overall schedule integrity.
  • Prepare written schedule review comments and coordinate required corrections with contractors and project stakeholders.
  • Develop detailed planning documents, time-scaled charts, schedule diagrams, and other project controls deliverables.
  • Prepare recurring schedule progress reports, executive briefing materials, milestone reports, and schedule performance summaries.
  • Develop effective reporting tools and visualizations to communicate complex project sequencing, schedule status, risks, and progress.
  • Promptly communicate significant schedule variances or emerging concerns to project leadership and provide recommendations for corrective action.
  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, construction teams, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to obtain schedule information and maintain accurate project schedules.
  • Support project leadership with schedule-related analysis and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of professional project scheduling experience, including experience supporting heavy civil, infrastructure, or multiple complex projects.
  • Previous scheduling experience supporting rail, transit, or major transportation infrastructure projects.
  • Experience working with a public transportation agency or other public-sector capital program.
  • Demonstrated experience scheduling the design and construction of large-scale, complex capital projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience using Primavera P6 for CPM schedule development, maintenance, updating, and analysis.
  • Experience developing and maintaining schedule baselines and evaluating actual performance against baseline.
  • Experience with cost-loaded and/or resource-loaded schedules.
  • Experience performing schedule variance analysis, critical path analysis, and Time Impact Analyses.
  • Experience reviewing and analyzing contractor-submitted schedules.
  • Ability to develop and manage progress-reporting methodologies for complex design and construction programs.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, schedule logic, dependencies, milestones, and project interfaces.
  • Ability to interpret complex technical design and construction information and communicate schedule impacts to both technical and management-level stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented professional with demonstrated reliability, accountability, and ability to collaborate within multidisciplinary project teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multi-phase, multimillion-dollar construction programs.
  • Advanced experience with Primavera P6 schedule analysis, cost loading, resource loading, TIAs, and contractor schedule reviews.

Working Hours & Location

This is a full-time, exempt hybrid position supporting the Metrolink program in Pomona, California.

The anticipated work schedule is:

  • 3 days per week onsite at the project location in Pomona
  • 2 days per week remote
  • Monday through Friday during standard business hours

The onsite/remote schedule may vary depending on project and client requirements.

Compensation Range

$178,200 – $228,800 annually; Eligible for Bonus

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, qualifications, education, certifications, technical expertise, internal equity, and applicable market considerations.

What’s In It for You:

In addition, the role will support day-to-day testing activities for AGW initiatives, including functional, integration, regression, performance, and security testing. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with expertise in API testing, automation architecture, DevOps practices, and quality engineering methodologies.

Duties & Responsibilities

Platform Quality Engineering Leadership

  • Own and drive the test automation vision and roadmap for the API Gateway platform.
  • Design and implement scalable automation frameworks supporting API, integration, regression, performance, and security testing.
  • Establish quality engineering standards, testing best practices, and automation governance across the platform.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture, product, and platform teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Define quality metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Test Automation Engineering

  • Build automated API validation suites covering functionality, security, performance, resiliency, and compliance requirements.
  • Integrate automated testing into Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement automated regression suites that enable rapid and reliable platform releases.
  • Create automation solutions that reduce manual testing effort while increasing test coverage and release confidence.

API Gateway Testing & Validation

  • Develop automated validation for API proxy configurations, security policies, routing, authentication, authorization, and traffic management controls.
  • Validate enterprise integrations across internal and external consumer applications.
  • Support testing of production fixes, platform upgrades, and disaster recovery exercises.
  • Ensure APIs meet functional, performance, scalability, and security requirements.

Day-to-Day Quality Assurance Activities

  • Perform defect analysis, root cause identification, and validation of remediation efforts.
  • Collaborate closely with developers and product owners to resolve quality issues.
  • Support user acceptance testing and production verification activities as needed.

Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate and introduce modern testing tools, frameworks, and engineering practices.
  • Promote shift-left testing and automation-first quality practices.
  • Mentor engineers and team members on automation development and quality engineering techniques.
  • Drive improvements in release quality, test coverage, deployment reliability, and operational stability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and support SAP security roles and authorizations across SAP environments.
  • Manage user administration activities, including user provisioning, deprovisioning, access requests, and role assignments.
  • Support implementation, enhancement, and troubleshooting of SAP S/4HANA and SAP Fiori Security.
  • Perform Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis, risk assessment, and access risk remediation using SAP GRC Access Control.
  • Assist with IT General Controls (ITGC) and SOX compliance audits by preparing audit evidence, documentation, and control testing support.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams to resolve authorization and security-related issues.
  • Support security governance, compliance initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational security standards, policies, and compliance requirements.
  • Participate in security reviews, access certification activities, and periodic user access audits.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience with:

    • SAP S/4HANA Security
    • SAP Fiori Security
    • SAP GRC Access Control
    • IT SOX / ITGC Audit Support

Strong expertise in:

    • SAP Role Design and Authorization Concepts
    • User Access Management
    • Segregation of Duties (SoD) Analysis
    • Compliance and Risk Controls
  • Good understanding of SAP security best practices and governance frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC Certification.
  • Experience working in large-scale enterprise SAP environments.
  • Exposure to complex SAP landscapes and transformation projects, including S/4HANA implementations and migrations.

Key Competencies

  • Security Governance and Compliance
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation
  • Access Management and Role Administration
  • Audit and Regulatory Compliance Support
  • Stakeholder Collaboration

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Commercial Loan Servicing Specialist to join Commercial Banking Operations on the Capital Finance Operations (CFO) team within Wholesale Operations.

title: Host/Hostess
description:

Laid-back luxury meets bucket-list adventure on this undiscovered east cape of Los Cabo. The Host/Hostess is responsible for greeting guests upon arrival, managing reservations, and ensuring a smooth flow of patrons into the dining area. The Hostess plays a crucial role in creating a welcoming environment and ensuring guests are seated comfortably. This role requires excellent customer service skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

​

title: Chart Management Coordinator II
description:
The rewards at Healogics are immense, starting with the important work we do to change patients’ lives. We also understand that meaningful work is hard work, and we are committed to supporting and compensating our employees for the tremendous service they provide.

Think you are a great fit? Learn more about this role here:

Healogics is the largest provider of advanced wound care services in the United States, treating more than 300,000 chronic wound patients annually across over 600 sites. With an aging society, obesity and diabetes on the rise, and an uptick in surgical procedures, the number of patients with non-healing wounds that would benefit from expert care is dramatically increasing. As a result, the company is working to provide our differentiated, quality outcomes to as many patients that would benefit through our out-patient clinic partnerships.

The Chart Management Coordinator II (CMC) performs a variety of Health Information Management (HIM) administrative duties to include medical record retrieval, storage, and maintenance. Additionally, the individual in this role assists with claim scrubs, rejections, and related billing operations to ensure correct claims submission.

All Healogics employees must perform their job responsibilities according to all Healogics policies, Hospital policies, as well as to accrediting organizations, federal and state regulation, and to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) guidelines, as applicable.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities:

  • Pulls and retrieves medical records and associated encounter documents from disparate Hospital Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems for coding and billing processing

  • Manages and maintains Hospital EHR accesses and assures HIPAA and information security compliance to each hospital’s business agreement and access privileges

  • Works with our Internal Practice Management Software for Medical Record retrieval

  • Coordinates and completes requests for the release of medical records to both internal and external customers, patients, and agencies

  • Compiles medical record requests for insurance carrier audits and appeals

  • Coordinates attorney and subpoena requests with Healogics Office of the General Counsel

  • Troubleshoots missing and/or incomplete medical documentation

  • Identifies corrective actions and coordinates directly with providers, Program Directors, Revenue Cycle Managers, and other Operations resources

  • Reviews E-Print Chart Management Report daily for scanning and uploading of medical documentation (EHR) to our Practice Management Software systems for billing

  • Assists and research coder identified “Deficiencies” within the LightSpeed Vericode platform; facilitates corrective actions to complete the coding of encounters

  • Responds to inquiries from Program Directors and other Operations personnel with regard to chart management, EHR systems, etc.

  • Maintains a thorough knowledge of Chart Management processes and Practice Management

  • Performs billing functions to review and take necessary actions to resolve billing errors ensuring clean claim submission

  • Works directly with payers, internal and external customers, toward effective and efficient claims resolution

  • Communicates with providers/wound centers regarding incomplete documentation

  • Responds to Customer Service inquires

  • Meets departmental productivity and quality assurance standards in accordance with departmental policies

  • Maintains knowledge of, and complies with, all relevant laws, regulations, policies, procedures and standards

  • Actively participates in creating and implementing improvements

  • Performs charge corrections per departmental requests

  • Maintains a thorough knowledge of billing and collection requirements for payers assigned

  • Performs other duties as required

Required Education, Experience and Credentials:

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED)

  • Minimum of three (3) years’ medical office experience in a Physician’s office preferred

  • Combination of experience in other settings and advanced education will be considered

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Excellent attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team setting

  • Ability to multi-task and follow-up on tasks

  • Must be able to demonstrate teamwork and display excellent communication skills

  • Microsoft Excel and Word experience

  • #LI-RS1

The hourly rate for this role is 20.00 - 22.50 USD Hourly

title: Anläggare / Rör läggare till etablerat VA-företag
description:
Anläggare / Rörläggare till etablerat VA-företag

Vill du ha ett praktiskt och varierande arbete där du får lösa problem, ta ansvar och arbeta tillsammans med ett härligt och erfaret team?

Prowork söker nu för vår kunds räkning en anläggare och rörläggare till ett väletablerad och växande företag inom VA och ledningsrenovering. Här får du arbeta med samhällsviktiga projekt runt om i Mälardalen – i ett företag med stark laganda, låg personalomsättning och goda möjligheter att utvecklas.


Om rollen:

Som yrkesarbetare blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat team som arbetar med vatten, avlopp och anläggning. Projekten varierar i både storlek och längd och finns främst runt Stockholm och Mälardalen.

Det här passar dig som gillar ett arbete där ingen dag behöver se exakt likadan ut som den förra. Du arbetar praktiskt, löser problem på plats och får stor frihet under ansvar.

Arbetet innebär:

  • Rörläggning och VA-arbeten
  • Schaktarbete och återställning
  • Arbete efter ritningar
  • Lägga provisoriska vattenledningar
  • Relining
  • Bygga och montera schaktboxar
  • Platssvetsning av mindre ledningar och VA-detaljer
  • Anslutningar till fastigheter
  • Samarbete med grävmaskinister och andra yrkesarbetare

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker framför allt rätt person med rätt inställning.

Du behöver ha erfarenhet från anläggning och/eller rörläggning, men du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett. Viktigare är att du är praktiskt lagd, tar ansvar och gillar att hitta lösningar när förutsättningarna förändras.

Vi ser att du:

  • Har erfarenhet av anläggning och/eller rörläggning
  • Har B-körkort
  • Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift
  • Trivs med ett fysiskt arbete utomhus året runt
  • Är självgående, flexibel och lösningsorienterad
  • Är en lagspelare som bidrar till ett bra arbetsklimat

Det är starkt meriterande om du har erfarenhet av PE-svetsning.

Även utbildningar som APV, Säkra lyft, Schakta säkert, hygienkurs, motorsåg eller maskinvana är meriterande.

Därför ska du söka:

Här får du möjlighet att komma till en stabil arbetsgivare som satsar långsiktigt på sin personal. Teamet består av både mycket erfarna yrkesarbetare och yngre kollegor, och kulturen präglas av att man hjälper varandra och delar med sig av sin kunskap.

För rätt person finns också goda möjligheter att utvecklas och ta mer ansvar över tid – flera medarbetare har gjort resan från yrkesarbetare till exempelvis arbetsledande roller.

Du erbjuds bland annat:

  • Konkurrenskraftig lön utifrån erfarenhet, kompetens och ansvar
  • Friskvårdsbidrag
  • Privat sjukvårdsförsäkring
  • Företagshälsovård och hälsoundersökningar
  • Kollektivavtal
  • Arbetstidsförkortning
  • Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter
  • En arbetsgivare med stort fokus på laganda, trygghet och work-life balance

Praktisk information:

Placering: Mälardalen, med projekt framför allt i Stockholmsområdet och södra Mälardalen

Omfattning: Heltid

Arbetstider: Primärt dagtid

Start: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse

Vissa projekt kan innebära resor och övernattningar, men merparten av arbetet sker i regionen och ambitionen är att hitta projekt så nära medarbetarnas hem som möjligt.

Låter det som något för dig?

Vi på Prowork hjälper kunden med rekryteringsprocessen, skicka därför din ansökan till Prowork Kompetens via länken.

För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta: viktoria.janmicks@prowork.se 073 506 72 31

Vi arbetar löpande med urval och intervjuer, så vänta inte med att söka.

Här får du ett jobb där erfarenhet är värdefull – men där inställning, problemlösning och viljan att göra ett riktigt bra jobb väger minst lika tungt.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Product Manager within the Commercial Bank to serve as a Product Owner responsible for driving execution of strategic product initiatives and delivering customer and business value through agile product teams. This role will partner closely with Product Managers, Technology Leaders, Architects, Operations, Risk, and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into actionable product capabilities, ensuring successful delivery of solutions that meet customer needs, regulatory requirements, and operational objectives.


In this role, you will:

  • Lead one or more product teams in delivering business and customer value through execution of product initiatives aligned with established product strategies and roadmaps.
  • Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, risk requirements, and regulatory commitments.
  • Collaborate with L2/L3 Product Managers and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, product reviews, and demonstrations to ensure effective execution and delivery.
  • Partner with technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to define solutions and ensure successful implementation of product enhancements and capabilities.
  • Facilitate prioritization decisions across competing demands while balancing customer value, operational efficiency, technical dependencies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage cross-functional dependencies, identify delivery risks, remove impediments, and drive timely resolution of issues impacting product delivery.
  • Validate business requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure delivered solutions meet customer expectations, quality standards, and business objectives.
  • Monitor product area performance, user adoption, operational outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support process automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and modernization initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Control partners to ensure solutions adhere to enterprise policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
  • Communicate product priorities, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and Agile best practices across the product team.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior Product Owners and team members while promoting effective product management practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Product Management, product development, strategic planning, process management, change delivery experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Job Expectations:

  • 5+ years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience leading Agile product delivery teams and managing backlogs within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and release planning activities.
  • Experience working closely with engineers, architects, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments across multiple workstreams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to influence outcomes and drive execution in matrixed organizational environments.


Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience in Commercial Banking, Supply Chain Finance, Lending, Receivables Finance, Treasury Management, Payments, or related banking domains.
  • Experience supporting platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of banking regulatory, risk, and control frameworks.
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, data analytics, and reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven product decision making.
  • Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern product operating models.

title: Bill of Materials Specialist
description:
Who will you be working with?

This role is part of the Engineering organization and collaborates closely with Services, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, IT, and other internal Wabtec teams to help execute the organization’s vision and strategy aligned with the Wabtec Transportation Services Philosophy.

How will you make a difference?

As a BOM Specialist, you will support strategies that enable efficient maintenance and repair operations for Wabtec’s railroad, mining, and OHV products. Working within a collaborative, cross-functional environment, you will help define and maintain Bills of Materials within Teamcenter, for both new and existing products.

In this role, you will support locomotive, mining and OHV maintainability by enabling the creation and maintenance of accurate parts bulletins and catalogs used by field service teams. You will play a key role in ensuring data accuracy, governance, compliance, and operational readiness while supporting continuous improvement across service operations.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Associates degree in a technical or business-related field.

  • Bachelors degree in Engineering preferred

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in renewal parts provisioning or a technical publishing environment.

  • Proficiency in BOM management concepts and related IT tools, with knowledge of Oracle ERP preferred.

  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and ability to manage large, complex datasets.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and locomotive lists, drilling down from top-level assemblies to individual components.

  • Experience with Parts Catalogs, Wabtec SBOM, and cross-functional collaboration with Materials, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Field Service.

  • Familiarity with PLM systems and configuration management tools (e.g., Teamcenter).

  • Advanced Excel and Power BI skills for reporting, analysis, and data governance.

  • Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement and technical documentation support.

  • Occasional travel to distribution centers and field service locations.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Read and interpret engineering drawings and associated bills of material to identify serviceable parts.

  • Create and revise Bills of Materials in Teamcenter.

  • Provide direction to graphic artists for the creation of exploded views and illustrations as required.

  • Identify problems and seek clarification as required relating to serviceable parts in BOM.

  • Identify renewal parts that must be included in a parts catalog from an Engineering BOM.

  • Research to identify existing PBs used in a current requisition and to identify new PBs that must be created.

  • Revise Bills of Materials from loco list changes, ECR/ECN changes and supersedures.

  • Communicate with cross functional and global teams on status of current deliverables.

  • Research and respond to all feedbacks, e-mails and phone requests concerning parts catalog issues.

  • Verify quantities, format required and customer information (including name, road numbers and shipping instructions) are correct for delivery to end customer.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, is available at mywabtecbenefits.com.

Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

title: Asset Protection Coordinator---Full Time
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: The Asset Protection Coordinator is an hourly position that directly reports to the Market Asset Protection Manager and will maintain and monitor all asset protection, security, compliance, and safety related functions within a facility. The mission of the Asset Protection team is aimed at reducing shrink, maintaining accurate inventory, maintaining compliance, and ensuring a safe and secure environment for our employees and customers. This mission is achieved through administrative reviews of reports, availability on our sales floor to observe and educate for best practices, and through monitoring compliance with established safety, inventory, and shrink directives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Assists in driving training and continued development for all Outfitters on all shrink, safety, and security related functions within a store.

  • Cascades as appropriate, all Asset Protection related directives and initiatives to store leadership and other Outfitters as required.

  • Demonstrates exceptional customer service during times where a customer or outfitter may appear in need or if acting in a suspicious manner. This position is a uniform required position that will spend time on the sales floor and interact with customers.

  • Identifies root causes of shrink through analyzing cycle counts, trailer audits, known loss, and vendor compliance opportunities or other exception reporting.

  • Uses data to review inventory adjustments to ensure appropriate accountability of inventory and investigate potential causes if / when discrepancies occur. Additionally, confirms all over / short shipments are investigated and resolved between DC and Store for inventory accuracy.

  • Encourages a strong level of commitment to asset protection programs with all outfitters and vendors.

  • Drives education to ensure merchandise protection tools have been removed and product has been paid for at point of purchase locations. Additionally, monitors and maintains all physical security and merchandise protection standards within the store.

  • Monitors facility property/parking area to ensure a safe and secure environment for our outfitters, customers, or vendors.

  • Conducts known loss investigations and exception report reviews.

  • Assists with investigations into criminal activity, policy violations, illicit behavior, workplace accidents, workplace violence and instances of operational or nefarious loss.

  • Monitors criminal cases, appear in court, and testify as warranted.

  • When assigned or authorized, may conduct information gathering and integrity interviews.

  • Assists in investigating irregularities to our Firearms protocols relating to compliance or process concerns.

  • Ensures all asset protection and security related systems are maintained & working appropriately.

  • Assists Store leadership by promoting safety programs to ensure a safe work environment, support safe work procedures, participate on safety committee.

  • Prepares detailed and accurate reports in a timely manner.

  • Must possess or be able to obtain any / all certifications / licenses required by applicable law.

  • ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: High School Diploma or Equivalent

  • Preferred Degree: Associate Degree or Bachelor Degree in Criminal Justice, Security Management or a related field from an accredited institution

  • Certificate(s) or License(s): As required by local jurisdiction

  • Years of experience: Previous experience in security, asset protection, and safety preferred or Retail inventory background.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting criminal or internal or related investigations

  • Experience in using physical security systems (CCTV, EAS, etc.)

  • Experience conducting quality reviews / audits

  • Current AHA First Aid / CPR / AED certification is preferred

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Travel is not an essential function of the job, if requested would be less than 10%

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Regularly performs computer work, walks, stands, and lifts up to 50lbs.

  • Occasionally sits.

INDEPENDENT JUDGEMENT:

  • Performs duties within scope of general company policies, procedures, and objectives. Analyzes problems and performs needs assessments. Uses judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired result. Regular exercise of independent judgment within accepted practices. Makes recommendations that affect policies, procedures, and practices.

  • Day-to-day work and decisions do not require direction or review by immediate supervisor. End results are reviewed by supervisor.

description:
