title: Lead Integration
description:
Responsibilities:

Integration Lead – Healthcare Data & Automation


Location: Pune

Experience: 8+ years

Employment Type: Full-time, In-office

Domain: Healthcare Technology / Value-Based Care


About Fold Health


Fold Health is building an AI-powered operating layer for value-based care — unifying data, workflows, and intelligence across healthcare organizations.


Our platform enables seamless interoperability between EHRs, CRMs, claims systems, HIEs, and AI/analytics engines — helping providers, payers, and care teams deliver better outcomes at lower costs.


We’re redefining healthcare interoperability by combining modern APIs, FHIR-based data models, and intelligent automation (RPA + AI). Join us to build the integration fabric that powers the next generation of healthcare delivery.


Role Overview


As the Integration Lead, you’ll architect and scale Fold’s interoperability layer — connecting diverse healthcare systems, payers, and data sources into one cohesive data fabric.

You’ll lead the design and implementation of cloud-native integrations, RPA workflows, and real-time data exchanges that power patient 360s, AI-driven insights, and care coordination.


This role blends deep healthcare integration expertise with a modern automation mindset — ideal for someone who can think beyond interfaces and architect an intelligent, scalable ecosystem.



Core Responsibilities:


  1. Integration Architecture & Development
  • Lead the design and development of high-performance, cloud-native integration pipelines across diverse healthcare systems (EHRs, claims, labs, CRM, patient engagement, wearables).
  • Build and maintain FHIR-based APIs, HL7 listeners, and webhooks using tools like Mirth Connect, Airbyte, AWS Lambda, and n8n.
  • Implement bidirectional data exchange with EHRs (Elation, eCW, athenahealth, Epic, Cerner, NextGen, etc.) and 3rd-party services using REST, GraphQL, and secure messaging protocols.
  • Collaborate with data and AI teams to ensure integrations feed into Fold’s data fabric and AI agents.


  1. Automation & Workflow Integration:
  • Design and deploy RPA-driven workflows (e.g., UiPath, Python/Selenium, or n8n automations) to interface with systems lacking APIs or HL7/FHIR endpoints.
  • Integrate data from legacy portals, fax systems, and PDFs using OCR/NLP pipelines for ingestion into the Fold Data Fabric.
  • Partner with AI and data science teams to transform unstructured data (documents, notes, scanned forms) into standardized, actionable formats.


  1. Data Quality, Compliance & Observability
    • Establish robust data validation, transformation, and monitoring frameworks to ensure accuracy, lineage, and reliability.
    • Maintain HIPAA, PHI/PII, and SOC2-compliant practices with secure credential management and audit trails.
    • Implement observability using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or Stackdriver to monitor integration performance.


  1. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment
    • Work closely with the Product, Data, and AI/LLM teams to translate clinical and operational requirements into technical integration workflows.
    • Collaborate with customer engineering to deliver configurable integration templates that can be reused across clients.


  1. Scalability & Continuous Improvement
    • Define integration best practices, documentation, and playbooks for the engineering org.
    • Lead and mentor integration engineers to establish reusable patterns and frameworks.
    • Continuously optimize cost, performance, and reliability of the integration layer.





Requirements

Must Have:

  • 6+ years of experience in healthcare integrations, interoperability, or health data platforms.
  • Deep understanding of HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI, CCD/CCDA, and related data models.
  • Hands-on experience with Mirth Connect, Airbyte, AWS Lambda, or similar middleware/integration tools.
  • Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for scripting, APIs, and data transformation (JSON, XML, CSV).
  • Familiarity with EHR APIs and integrations (eCW, Epic, Cerner, NextGen, etc.).
  • Strong knowledge of HIPAA security, OAuth2, and role-based access models.
  • Proven experience designing high-volume, low-latency integrations on cloud environments (AWS or GCP).


Benefits

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to build and scale an AI-powered healthcare platform impacting millions of lives.
  • Work with modern technologies in a mission-driven environment.
  • Collaborative and innovative culture with growth opportunities.

description:
Job Description

Department:

Strength and Conditioning - Staff

Pay Rate Type:

Salary

Employee Type:

Job Summary:

Colby is a member of the New England Small College Athletic Conference (NESCAC) and has 32 intercollegiate sports that compete at the Division III level. The department also includes the campus recreation program and hosts a variety of club and intramural sports. More than one-third of Colby’s 2,200 students participate in intercollegiate sports and, in total, nearly three-quarters are involved in fitness and recreation activities in the department.

With an investment of over $250 million into Athletics in the last decade, Colby’s state-of-the-art athletics complex makes the facilities on Mayflower Hill a benchmark for all Division III institutions across the country. The Harold Alfond Athletics and Recreation Center is the central hub of Colby athletics. The 350,000 square-foot athletics center includes basketball and volleyball courts, an indoor track and field competition center, aquatic center with Maine’s first 50-meter pool, squash center, hockey arena, a tri-level strength and fitness center, training rooms, and coaching suites. Additionally, the College opened a 70-acre-plus outdoor competition center that consists of eight competition and recreational fields that are also among the finest outdoor venues in Division III. The College has seen dramatic improvement in the Learfield Director’s Cup standings since the opening of the Harold Alfond Athletics and Recreation Center, elevating to the top-6% of Division III institutions in the yearly standings.

An additional distinguishing feature of Colby College’s Athletic Department is its Peak Performance Program, a comprehensive high-performing model designed to optimize student well-being and performance. Peak Performance integrates sports medicine, strength and conditioning, mental performance, nutrition and sports sciences.

Located in central Maine, the College has incredible access to other outdoor venues such as the Belgrade Lakes and Sugarloaf Mountain Resort, one of the premier ski destinations on the east coast.

The Colby College Department of Athletics is seeking a full-time, 10 month appointed assistant strength and conditioning coach. Reporting to the Dawn Strout head strength and conditioning coach, the assistant strength and conditioning coach is responsible for the development, implementation, and management of individual and group strength training programs for student-athletes participating in the intercollegiate athletics program.

The hiring rate for this position is $42,966 ($51,500 annualized).

Essential Functions

To be successful in this position, an individual should be able to perform the essential duties and bring the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities that support the role. This list of duties is intended to be representative rather than exhaustive, and additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

  • Empower student-athletes to perform to their physical potential in their sport through the development and management of year-round strength and conditioning programs

  • Develop programs by evaluating athletes as part of the greater Peak Performance initiative; have varied knowledge of training modalities in order to develop appropriate training programs for a variety of sports

  • Appropriately prescribe exercises, strength and conditioning programs for assigned teams

  • Work in conjunction with head coach in scheduling both group and individual training sessions

  • Demonstrate proper technique of exercises, and appropriately modify and/or correct technique as needed

  • Manage programs by monitoring progress and provide an assessment of development using various methods including subjective and objective measurement tools

  • Provide guidance and education to coaches in meeting the strength and conditioning needs of their programs both individually and as part of the Peak Performance team

  • Work with sports medicine personnel and/or athletic trainers in the return of athletes to participation in the off-season and in-season

  • Abide by and comply with National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) and New England Small College Athletic Conference (NESCAC) rules, academic standards, requirements, policies of the College, and all guidelines and policies of the Athletics department; report any concerns of compromise or violation of rules, standards, guidelines or policies to the appropriate personnel

  • Contribute to a work environment that encourages knowledge of, respect for, and development of skills to engage with a diverse community

  • Position is part of the Peak Performance team working closely with other members, analyzing data from force plates, wellness questionnaires, and other technologies in the training space

  • Contribute to the overall success of the College’s intercollegiate program by performing all other duties and responsibilities as assigned; duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice

  • Demonstrate understanding of the importance of a diverse workforce to the college’s overall success

  • The scope of the position may require weekend, evening, and/or early morning work

Position Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or the equivalent in education and experience; emphasis in Exercise Science, Exercise Physiology, Physical Education, or Masters Degree in related field preferred

  • Minimum of two years of experience is required in positions involving the development and management of sport-specific individual and group strength training programs, experience with contact or collision sports preferred

  • Current certification as a Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) or Strength and Conditioning Coach Certified (SCCC) is required for the duration of employment

  • Current CPR/First Aid certifications required for the duration of employment

  • Experience with development and management of strength training programs at the college/university level, management of a health/fitness or weight training facility, or student-athlete experience, in any sport at the collegiate level, preferred

  • Previous experience with equipment maintenance is preferred

  • Previous experience with data collection, analysis, and use of sport science software is preferred

  • Excellent communication skills, supervisory, and management skills are required

  • Ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with coaches, sports medicine staff, administration, and students

  • Previous experience with coordinating an effective internship program

  • Scope of the position requires the ability to perform and/or demonstrate various physical strength exercises and to assist others performing those exercises individually or in a group setting

  • Demonstrated commitment to supporting the development of student athletes from varied backgrounds.

Physical/Mental Demands

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform essential functions of this position and/or may be encountered while performing essential functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • To successfully perform the essential functions of this position, an employee must be able to maintain appropriate confidentiality with regard to employee data, documents, issues, etc., and respect privacy needs of employees and past employees with regard to the same.

  • The ability to comply with highly inflexible deadlines is required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position; there will be multiple occurrences of sudden, urgent task completion required.

  • There may be occurrences of employees, past employees, members of the general public, and others who express opinions, may exhibit strong emotions, which will require the employee to interact professionally, diplomatically, and appropriately in such situations.

  • While performing the essential duties of this position, an employee would frequently be required to move around on grass, turf, courts, gymnasium, and training rooms.

  • There may be multiple/daily instances of prolonged personal computer use which would include keyboard and/or mouse usage as well as viewing a computer monitor.

  • An employee must frequently lift large amounts of weight to perform essential position functions.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus.

  • The overall work environment requires the mental ability to shift focus quickly due to interruptions; an employee must be able to mentally track multiple projects and tasks as well.

  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate; however, there may be unexpected instances of somewhat loud sounds.

  • Frequent travel and early morning/evening/weekend work is required.

Colby College supports the Americans with Disabilities Act and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Interested candidates should apply electronically by clicking the “Apply Now” button on the Colby College website. Please upload a cover letter and resume to your application.

title: Inventory Control Specialist
description:
Armacell provides numerous and diverse career opportunities. Add your talent to ours and make a difference around the world!

The year 1954 marked a significant milestone in thermal insulation history. Armstrong’s R&D Project Number 54013, developed by three innovators, evolved into ArmaFlex, the world's first flexible, closed-cell elastomeric foam for equipment insulation. This product revolutionized the insulation industry. Today, more than 70 years later, ArmaFlex continues to be a pillar of Armacell's success.

The Inventory Control Specialist plays a key role in supporting Supply Chain operations at our Mebane manufacturing facility by ensuring the accuracy and integrity of plant inventory. This position is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory records, performing cycle counts, investigating and resolving inventory discrepancies, and ensuring inventory transactions are accurately reflected within SAP.

The Inventory Control Specialist works cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Purchasing, Production Planning, Engineering, Quality, and Warehouse teams to identify and resolve material issues while supporting the efficient flow of materials throughout the facility.

What Armacell can offer you

  • Healthcare benefits including medical & prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, and mental health & wellbeing.

  • Financial programs such as 401(k), life insurance, short & long- term disability coverage, and opportunities for performance-based salary incentive programs

  • Generous paid time off including 12 holidays

  • Training and educational resources in our learning management system

  • Giving & volunteer opportunities, and discounts on retail products, services & experiences

Job Responsibilities

  • Maintain inventory accuracy and integrity by performing regular physical cycle counts and reconciling inventory against system records

  • Process and maintain accurate inventory transactions and stock transfers within SAP, including Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), and applicable warehouse management systems.

  • Investigate inventory discrepancies, transaction errors, and material variances to identify root causes and implement appropriate corrective actions.

  • Verify material consumption and monitor inventory activity, including yield, scrap, and other transactions impacting inventory accuracy.

  • Review and resolve SAP error logs, including COGI transactions, to support accurate inventory reporting and month-end close activities.

  • Generate and maintain inventory documentation, stock logs, tracking reports, and other inventory performance reporting as required.

  • Monitor inventory levels and material availability to help prevent production disruptions while minimizing excess inventory, waste, and material obsolescence.

  • Partner with Purchasing, Production Planning, Engineering, Quality, Warehouse, and other cross-functional teams to resolve material shortages, inventory discrepancies, and delivery issues.

  • Support the creation and maintenance of material and inventory-related master data within applicable systems.

  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement related to inventory accuracy, material flow, transaction processes, and overall Supply Chain effectiveness.

  • Support additional Supply Chain and inventory control activities as needed.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications and Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in Supply Chain, Business, Logistics, or a related field preferred.

  • 3–5 years of experience in inventory control, materials management, supply chain, or a related function within a manufacturing or plant environment preferred.

  • Hands-on experience working within an ERP system required; SAP experience strongly preferred.

  • Experience with SAP MM and/or PP modules and S/4HANA preferred.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.

  • Ability to effectively prioritize multiple responsibilities and work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

August 25, 2026 - September 9, 2026

The expected compensation range for this role is $65,000.00 -$73,000.00.

Job Description:

The Program Security Representative’s primary function is to provide multi-discipline security support for one or more of the customer’s Special Access Programs (SAPs).   • Ensure strict adherence to the provisions of the NISPOM, its Supplement, the DoD Overprint, DCID, ICD, and SAP policy.

  • Assist in developing and executing approved policies and procedures for safeguarding Special Access.

  • Program (SAP), Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and collateral data in support of US military operations.

title: Principal Salesforce Developer
description:
Ready to lead the technical side of a Salesforce platform in the middle of a real transformation - not just keep the lights on? From consolidating onto Data Cloud to partnering directly with the business on new AI use cases, this is a hands-on lead role where your decisions shape what gets built next.

About the Role

CFA Institute's Salesforce platform is at the center of a major transformation. We're consolidating onto Data Cloud, modernizing our marketing stack, and shaping some of our earliest agentic AI use cases in partnership with sales, marketing, and customer service. As Principal Developer, you'll be a senior, hands-on technical leader - writing code, reviewing it, and mentoring others - while also partnering directly with Product Owners to turn complex business needs into scalable, secure solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Data Cloud.

This is a lead technical contributor role, not a people-management position. You'll report to the Platform Owner, Salesforce, and work closely with the wider Application Development team. This position may be based in eligible jurisdictions in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Data Cloud.

  • Stay genuinely hands-on: coding, integrations, testing, deployments, and production support.

  • Lead code reviews and pull requests and mentor other Salesforce developers.

  • Partner directly with Product Owners across groups like contact center, sales, and marketing - leading technical discovery and discussions, not just taking direction.

  • Assist in planning wider development strategy and operations, including implementation of modern practices, assessment of platforms and software, helping decide vendor qualifications, etc.

  • Contribute to platform governance, roadmap planning, release management, and continuous improvement.

  • Help shape CFA Institute's emerging agentic AI use cases on the Salesforce platform.

  • Support our move to Data Cloud as the foundation for future Salesforce initiatives.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of overall IT experience, including 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development.

  • Strong expertise in Apex and Lightning Web Components, Flows, Salesforce APIs, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce security.

  • A track record of leading code reviews and mentoring developers.

  • Real experience partnering with, and leading technical conversations with, Product Owners or business stakeholders - this isn't a role for someone who has only taken direction from others.

  • Genuine, enterprise-scale cross-functional and cross-geography collaboration experience - not experience limited to small teams.

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (required).

  • Experience with Agile delivery and DevOps practices.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II.

  • Additional Salesforce architecture or Data Cloud certifications.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a Salesforce platform team in the middle of a genuine transformation - Data Cloud, and early agentic AI initiatives.

  • Growing scope as the platform and the team grow.

  • A structured first 30/60/90 days, including direct knowledge transfer from the current tech lead.

  • Work across multiple business areas - sales, service, marketing, and more - rather than a single narrow product.

This position may be based in eligible jurisdictions in the United States.

At this time, we are unable to provide sponsorship for this role. No agencies, please.

Department Introduction

The Systems Integration Group (SIG) develops advanced test solutions that support semiconductor manufacturing and product quality. The team partners across engineering, operations, procurement, and external suppliers to design, build, and deploy innovative hardware platforms that enable reliable testing and validation of semiconductor devices.

Join the team building semiconductor memory test platforms for tomorrow’s AI infrastructure.

Position Overview

As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will design and develop electronic hardware used in advanced semiconductor test systems. You will apply electrical engineering principles to create analog, digital, and mixed-signal solutions that support manufacturing and product development. This role spans the full hardware development lifecycle, from concept and design through validation, deployment, and sustaining support. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams around the world to deliver reliable, high-quality test solutions.

  • Evaluate and select electronic components to meet system performance, reliability, and cost objectives

  • Develop schematics and collaborate with PCB designers to create optimized board layouts

  • Debug, test, and validate PCB assemblies using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, and electronic loads

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including specifications, design documents, test plans, and validation reports

  • Develop scripts and automation solutions to improve design efficiency, data analysis, and engineering workflows

  • Support prototype deployment, customer validation activities, issue resolution, and design enhancements

  • Experience using circuit simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, or comparable applications

  • Experience operating laboratory test equipment, including digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and electronic loads

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related technical field

  • Experience designing mixed-signal systems for test, manufacturing, or semiconductor applications

  • Experience supporting products through prototype development, deployment, and sustaining engineering activities

  • Programming or scripting experience for design automation, test automation, or data analysis

  • Familiarity with AI tools and large language model (LLM) prompting techniques to improve engineering productivity and workflows

title: Research Assistant, AI Algorithm and Software Development
description:
Roles & Responsibilities

The Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine (LKCMedicine) trains doctors who put patients at the centre of their exemplary care. The School, which offers both undergraduate and graduate programmes, is named after local philanthropist Tan Sri Dato Lee Kong Chian. Established in 2010 by Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in partnership with Imperial College London, LKCMedicine aims to be a model for innovative medical education and a centre for transformative research. The School’s primary clinical partner is the National Healthcare Group, a leader in public healthcare recognised for the quality of its medical expertise, facilities and teaching. The School is transitioning to an NTU medical school ahead of the 2028 successful conclusion of the NTU-Imperial partnership to set up a Joint Medical School. In August 2024, we welcomed our first intake of the NTU MBBS programme, that has been recently enhanced to include themes like precision medicine and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, with an expanded scope in the medical humanities. Graduates from the five-year undergraduate medical degree programme will have a strong understanding of the scientific basis of medicine, with an emphasis on technology, data science and the humanities. The Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DS/AI) Group within LKCMedicine is a multidisciplinary academic unit focused on advancing the application of data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in medical education, biomedical research, and healthcare delivery. The key objective is to support efforts to develop innovative, data-driven solutions that improve patient outcomes, enhance healthcare systems, and strengthen the future readiness of medical training and research. For more details, please view We are looking for a Research Assistant /Associate to develop hospital-at-home projects. The role will focus on designing, implementing, and evaluating innovative care models that enable safe, high-quality acute care delivery in patients’ homes. Responsibilities include supporting clinical operations research, data collection and analysis, workflow optimization, stakeholder engagement, and project coordination across multidisciplinary teams to improve patient outcomes, experience, and system efficiency. Key Responsibilities: • Support the design, implementation, and day-to-day coordination of hospital-at-home pilot projects and service initiatives. • Collect, manage, and analyse clinical, operational, and patient experience data to evaluate programme outcomes. • Engage clinicians, administrators, community partners, and other stakeholders to optimise workflows and care pathways. • Prepare reports, presentations, and research outputs, and contribute to grant applications, publications, and continuous improvement activities. description:

Project Title

Intelligent Equipment Health Monitoring and Reliability Analytics Using Artificial Intelligence

Project Description

This project provides the intern with practical exposure to manufacturing equipment reliability, data analytics, machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, and engineering visualization.

The intern will develop a prototype that analyzes equipment alarms, downtime, maintenance, and performance data to identify equipment health trends and emerging reliability concerns. The intern will also explore AI-Enabled and natural language capabilities for communicating analytical insights to engineering stakeholders.

Objective of the Project

The objective is to develop an AI-Enabled equipment health analytics framework that:

  • Monitors equipment health and reliability trends.

  • Detects abnormal equipment behavior and emerging concerns.

  • Identifies when performance degradation began.

  • Highlights the main factors associated with degradation.

  • Communicates findings through dashboards and analytical summaries

Opportunities for Full Time Employment

Consideration for future internship or full-time employment opportunities will be subject to business needs, position availability, and the applicable selection process.

Project Scope

The intern will be given the opportunity to:

  • Analyze equipment alarm history, downtime records, maintenance activities, and operational performance data.

  • Develop equipment health indicators and monitoring methodologies to evaluate reliability trends.

  • Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to identify abnormal equipment behavior and emerging reliability concerns.

  • Develop an Intelligent Equipment Health Monitoring Agent and interactive dashboard to communicate trends and key contributors.

  • Document and present the methodology, findings, limitations, and recommendations to engineering stakeholders.

Learning Opportunities

The intern will have the opportunity to:

  • Gain practical experience in manufacturing data analytics and equipment reliability engineering.

  • Apply data preparation, trend analysis, anomaly detection, and machine learning techniques.

  • Learn to develop equipment health indicators and evaluate their effectiveness.

  • Explore AI-Enabled Agents and natural language capabilities for engineering analytics.

  • Strengthen technical documentation, visualization, problem-solving, and presentation skills.

Deliverables

The intern is expected to deliver:

  • A prototype of an Intelligent Equipment Health Monitoring Agent.

  • A documented equipment health scoring methodology and set of reliability indicators.

  • Automated models for detecting alarm spikes, downtime excursions, and equipment health degradation.

  • An interactive dashboard showing equipment health trends, abnormal trend start points, and key contributors.

  • A final technical report and presentation covering findings, limitations, recommendations, and future opportunities.

Impact of the Project

The project is intended to:

  • Improve visibility into equipment health and reliability trends.

  • Enable faster identification of potential contributors to downtime and alarm excursions.

  • Improve early detection of emerging equipment reliability concerns.

  • Provide data-driven insights for proactive reliability improvement.

  • Establish a scalable AI-Enabled analytics framework for future development.

Skillsets Required

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Programming knowledge in Python, Structured Query Language, or equivalent analytical tools.

  • Understanding of data analytics, statistics, trend analysis, and data visualization.

  • Familiarity with machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, anomaly detection, or data science concepts.

  • Familiarity with AI tools, AI-Enabled workflows, Generative AI, or Agent-based analytics.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical communication, and documentation skills.

Course of Interest

The ideal candidate should be pursuing a degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

Duration of Period

The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of at least 5 months.

title: Exec. Director, US Market Access
description:
COMPANY:

At BioCryst, we share a deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with hereditary angioedema (HAE) and other rare diseases. We leverage our expertise in structure-guided drug design to develop first-in-class or best-in-class oral small-molecule and injectable protein therapeutics. Our global headquarters is in Durham, North Carolina, we have a regional office in Boston, Massachusetts, and our employees span the globe across sites in multiple countries. We are proud of our culture of engagement and accountability that rewards people for innovative thinking and achievement of key objectives. For more information, please visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.


JOB SUMMARY:

Reporting to the Vice President, Market Access & Patient Services, the Exec. Director, US Market Access will lead a team of Market Access Directors in access and pull-through strategies. In addition, this role has the added responsibility as managed care and coverage lead for National and Regional accounts in an assigned region of the United States. This position is responsible for driving US Market Access strategy, managing business relationships within her/his assigned geography and guiding pull-through efforts for BioCryst products in aligned geography/accounts. #LI-REMOTE

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coach and develop a team of Market Access Directors to ensure access and pull-through strategies are executed across all regions for optimal coverage of BioCryst products.
  • Develop overarching strategy with VP market access and a cross-functional team
  • Develop and presents strategic account plans for assigned payer vertical
  • Work with assigned account(s) to prepare for future product launches
  • Assist in building and leading a high performing team to ensure access to BioCryst products and execute pull through strategies that maximize patient access, revenue and profitability.
  • Work with sales, marketing, patient services, specialty pharmacy(s) and finance teams, recommend and execute a US managed care marketing strategy for payer and distribution channels, including commercial insurers, Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), Integrated Health Networks (IHN), specialty pharmacy and distribution, State Medicaid, Medicare, and Federal VA/DoD channels.
  • Collaborate with the Patient Services and Value and Access teams to create pull-through materials for US payers.
  • Initiate and lead interactions with US payers to build awareness of BioCryst products.
  • Monitor trends and potential coverage and reimbursement issues, existing and emerging government and payer policies, competitive pricing and contracting strategies, and potential barriers to provider and patient access.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, financial acumen, motivated by start-up environment with the ability to deal with ambiguity.

title: New College Grad - Wet Etch/CMP/Bond Shift Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Manufacturing Development Engineering (MDE) Shift Engineer in Wet Etch/CMP/Bond, you will play a critical role in enabling 24/7 process development for next-generation DRAM technologies within the Wet Etch/CMP/Bond Process Areas. This position operates on a 12-hour rotating shift schedule and serves as the primary engineering decision-maker for development activities occurring during off-hours for one of the three listed areas while also supporting the other two areas as needed. You will work closely with Process Development, Process Integration, Equipment Development, Manufacturing, and Shift Operations teams to ensure uninterrupted development execution, increase learning velocity, and support technology roadmap objectives.

Unlike traditional manufacturing shift engineering roles, this MDE Shift Engineer operates in a highly dynamic development environment where process conditions, specifications, and experimental flows frequently evolve. This role requires strong engineering judgment to disposition development wafers, make real-time process decisions, troubleshooting process and equipment issues, and appropriately balance execution needs with development objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary off-shift engineering decision-maker for development activities, using sound engineering judgment to disposition wafers, release or hold tools, define actions on development targets, respond to process deviations, handle execution risks, and maintain development momentum.
  • Partner closely with Wet Etch/CMP/Bond Process Development, Process Integration, Equipment Development, Manufacturing, and Shift Operations teams to troubleshoot process and equipment issues, resolve output constraints, support experimental processing, and remove barriers to development execution.
  • Apply SPC, E3, and other fault detection (FD) systems, and data analysis to investigate excursions, identify root causes, improve process performance, drive defect reduction and yield improvement, and support qualification and optimization activities.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, reaction plans, recipes, and process procedures while ensuring effective cross-shift communication, change control, and timely escalation of issues that could impact safety, cycle time, yield, or operational performance.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by leading or participating in development projects, PMI data collection, audits, benchmarking activities, and implementation of best-known methods that improve development efficiency, execution quality, and organizational capability.
  • Leverage the Model Based Problem Solving methodology, data analytics, and AI-enabled tools to enhance decision quality and operational productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related engineering field. OR Bachelors of Science with proven experience in Semiconductor Manufacturing or Process Development.
  • Ability to work a 12-hour rotating shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays as the need arises.
  • Solid understanding of either Wet Process, CMP, or Bond semiconductor manufacturing, process control methodologies, and engineering problem-solving techniques.
  • Understanding of SPC, DOE, E3 FD, and data-driven decision-making methodologies.
  • Solid understanding of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word).
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in area-specific process development (Wet Process, CMP, Bond) with understanding of fundamental sciences (chemistry, physics, mechanical engineering, etc.) associated with that area
  • Experience in Manufacturing Development Engineering, and/or High-Volume Manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor process integration, process control systems, and advanced manufacturing practices.
  • Experience dispositioning lots, supporting development experiments, and making engineering decisions in a process development environment.
  • Experience with equipment troubleshooting, database tools, analytics, and AI-enabled engineering solutions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, prioritization, and time-management skills with the ability to work independently in a constantly evolving environment.

title: Vil du være med til at udvikle en specialskole med høje ambitioner? Afdelingsleder til Svendborg Heldagsskole
description:
Brænder du for ledelse, special pædagogik og skoleudvikling? Kan du skabe retning og samtidig være en nærværende leder tæt på medarbejdere, elever og familier? Så er du måske den afdelingsleder, vi søger.

En skole i udvikling

Svendborg Heldagsskole er en specialskole for børn og unge med socioemotionelle vanskeligheder. Vi har omkring 40 elever og en engageret medarbejdergruppe bestående af 10 lærere og 12 pædagoger, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe de bedste udviklings- og deltagelsesmuligheder for vores elever.

Vi er en del af Vestermarkskolen og indgår i et fælles ledelses- og administrationsfællesskab med et tæt fagligt samarbejde.

De seneste år har vi gennemgået en markant udvikling – fra behandlingsskole til specialskole med fokus på undervisning, trivsel, deltagelse og stærke fællesskaber. Vi er stolte af den udvikling, vi har skabt, og samtidig er vi fortsat optagede af at udvikle vores fælles praksis og skabe endnu bedre muligheder for vores elever.

Din vigtigste opgave

Som afdelingsleder bliver din vigtigste opgave at skabe retning og udvikling tæt på den pædagogiske praksis. Du skal understøtte medarbejdernes faglige udvikling, sikre høj kvalitet i undervisningen og være en synlig leder i en hverdag, hvor relationer, struktur og samarbejde er afgørende for elevernes trivsel, læring og udvikling.

Du får blandt andet ansvar for at:

  • lede personalet på mellemtrin og i udskolingen
  • skabe følgeskab gennem nærværende personaleledelse, sparring og faglig udvikling
  • sikre kvalitet i undervisning og pædagogisk praksis
  • bidrage til skolens drift, visitation, planlægning og økonomi
  • udvikle skolens faglige fællesskaber og tværgående samarbejde
  • samarbejde tæt med elever, familier og tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere
  • indgå aktivt i den samlede udvikling af Svendborg Heldagsskole.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab

Du bliver en del af et ledelsesteam på fem ledere. På Svendborg Heldagsskole arbejder du tæt sammen med afdelingslederen for børnemiljøet, samtidig med at du indgår i det fælles ledelsesteam med Vestermarkskolen.

Vi tror på, at god ledelse skabes sammen. Vi sparrer, deler ansvar og bruger hinandens styrker – både i hverdagen og når opgaverne er komplekse.

Du kommer desuden til at arbejde tæt sammen med PPR, Familieafdelingen, CBUF og andre tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere omkring børnene og deres familier. Samtidig prioriterer vi ekstern supervision, fordi vi tror på, at refleksion og faglig sparring styrker både medarbejdere, ledelse og kvaliteten i vores arbejde.

Vores pædagogiske ståsted

Relationer er fundamentet for vores arbejde. Vi tror på, at alle børn kan udvikle sig, når de mødes med tydelige voksne, passende forventninger, trygge rammer og undervisning, der giver mening.

Vi arbejder for, at alle elever oplever deltagelse, mestring og stærke fællesskaber. Det gør vi gennem et tæt samarbejde med familier og samarbejdspartnere og med en vedvarende nysgerrighed på, hvordan vi sammen skaber de bedste muligheder for hvert enkelt barn.

Vi leder efter en afdelingsleder, som

  • er en autentisk og tillidsvækkende leder, der skaber retning, engagement og følgeskab
  • er synlig, nærværende og tilgængelig for medarbejdere, elever, forældre og samarbejdspartnere
  • har erfaring med personaleledelse og motiveres af at udvikle mennesker, faglighed og stærke fællesskaber
  • har en lærer- eller pædagogfaglig baggrund og gerne erfaring fra specialområdet – eller en stærk motivation for at arbejde inden for det
  • ser relationer som fundamentet for både ledelse, læring og udvikling
  • bidrager aktivt til et trygt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, trivsel og faglig refleksion går hånd i hånd
  • har selvindsigt, er nysgerrig på egen ledelsespraksis og bruger sparring aktivt – både ved at give og bede om hjælp
  • kan skabe overblik, træffe beslutninger og bevare roen i en kompleks hverdag
  • trives i et tværfagligt samarbejde og motiveres af at udvikle en skole i bevægelse.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Hos os får du et meningsfuldt lederjob med stor mulighed for at præge udviklingen af en specialskole med høje ambitioner.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab, hvor vi deler ansvar, sparrer med hinanden og lykkes sammen. Du får engagerede medarbejdere med høj faglighed, et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og en arbejdsplads præget af tillid, humor og udvikling.

Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når mennesker udvikler sig sammen – og vi investerer derfor både i vores elevers, medarbejderes og lederes udvikling.

Vil du høre mere eller besøge os?

Kontakt skoleleder Nikolai Stougaard Skibdal på telefon 51 34 46 91 eller afdelingsleder for børnemiljøet Jeanette Juncher Madsen på telefon 24 34 04 48

Ansættelsesforløb

  • Ansøgningsfrist: søndag den 13. september 2026
  • 1. samtalerunde: fredag den 18. september 2026
  • 2. samtalerunde: mandag den 28. september 2026

Mellem 1. og 2. samtale vil der blive lavet en personprofil.

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med tiltrædelse den 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse. Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest forud for ansættelsen.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling mellem 61.094 og 64.886 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Retirement Plan Consultant - Tampa, FL
description:
Who We Are

At Corebridge Financial, we believe action is everything. That’s why every day we partner with financial professionals and institutions to make it possible for more people to take action in their financial lives, for today and tomorrow.

We align to a set of Values that are the core pillars that define our culture and help bring our brand purpose to life:

  • We are stronger as one: We collaborate across the enterprise, scale what works and act decisively for our customers and partners.
  • We deliver on commitments: We are accountable, empower each other and go above and beyond for our stakeholders.
  • We learn, improve and innovate: We get better each day by challenging the status quo and equipping ourselves for the future.
  • We are inclusive: We embrace different perspectives, enabling our colleagues to make an impact and bring their whole selves to work.

Who You'll Work With

Corebridge Financial is an industry-leading provider of financial planning tools for community members who work in healthcare, higher education, K-12, government, and other not-for-profit institutions. We love what we do, and we believe you will too.

About the Role

The Retirement Plan Consultant will provide objective guidance that is aligned with the needs of plan sponsors and employees eligible for the applicable retirement savings plan. Incentive bonus opportunity is available based on factors including the achievement of pre-defined plan metrics and will also be evaluated on client satisfaction ratings.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct individual and group presentations, in person or via video technology, to improve awareness of plan features and to grow plan assets. Presentations include enrollment meetings, age-based financial education meetings, and sophisticated financial literacy meetings as requested by the plan sponsor or determined by the applicable communication and education plan.

  • Actively participate in benefit fairs and new employee orientations.

  • Participate in the annual plan review and financial education planning process.

  • Assist Relationship Manager and/or District Vice President with targeted education campaigns to increase participation and deferral rates

  • Meet with participants and eligible employees to educate employees regarding plan participation.

  • Travel dependent on your territory may be required for new plan enrollments.

To help you get started, we offer you the resources needed to build your own success:

  • This is a salary paid position with bonus potential

  • Competitive benefits package with immediate access to medical, dental, vision, life insurance and 401(k) plan with match

  • Company-provided technology, including equipment, helpdesk assistance, client management and financial planning tools

  • Company-paid E&O, licensing fees, continuing education and compliance support

Skills and Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; Bachelor's Degree preferred

  • Series 7, Series 66 preferred and appropriate state insurance licenses required

  • CFP, ChFC or similar designations desirable

  • Must have excellent presentation skills

  • Bilingual Spanish/English skills a plus

Work Location

  • This position is currently designated as remote.

Estimated Travel

  • May include up to 25% travel.

This role is deemed a “covered associate” under SEC Rule 206(4)-5, 17 CFR § 275.206(4)-5, Political contributions by certain investment advisers, and other federal and state pay-to-play rules. Candidates for the role must not have made any political contributions that, under 17 CFR § 275.206(4)-5 or other federal or state pay-to-play regulations, would disqualify the candidate or Corebridge Financial from conducting Corebridge Financial’s business, or that would otherwise create a conflict of interest for Corebridge Financial. Applicants who are selected to move forward with the application process will be required to disclose all U.S. political contributions they and their household family members have made over the past two years.

Why Corebridge?

At Corebridge Financial, we prioritize the health, well-being, and work-life balance of our employees. Our comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to support employees both personally and professionally, ensuring that they have the resources and flexibility needed to thrive.

Benefit Offerings Include:

  • Health and Wellness: We offer a range of medical, dental and vision insurance plans, as well as mental health support and wellness initiatives to promote overall well-being.
  • Retirement Savings: We offer retirement benefits options, which vary by location. In the U.S., our competitive 401(k) Plan offers a generous dollar-for-dollar Company matching contribution of up to 6% of eligible pay and a Company contribution equal to 3% of eligible pay (subject to annual IRS limits and Plan terms). These Company contributions vest immediately.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Confidential counseling services and resources are available to all employees.
  • Matching charitable donations: Corebridge matches donations to tax-exempt organizations 1:1, up to $5,000.
  • Volunteer Time Off: Employees may use up to 16 volunteer hours annually to support activities that enhance and serve communities where employees live and work.
  • Paid Time Off: Eligible employees start off with at least 24 Paid Time Off (PTO) days so they can take time off for themselves and their families when they need it.


Eligibility for and participation in employer-sponsored benefit plans and Company programs will be subject to applicable law, governing Plan document(s) and Company policy.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer

Corebridge Financial, is committed to being an equal opportunity employer and we comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws. All applicants will be considered for employment based on job-related qualifications and without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, neurodivergence, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. The Company is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. At Corebridge Financial, we believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to building a creative workplace that leads to innovation, growth, and profitability. Through a wide variety of programs and initiatives, we invest in each employee, seeking to ensure that our colleagues are respected as individuals and valued for their unique perspectives.

Corebridge Financial is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees, including any accommodations needed on the basis of physical or mental disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to complete any part of the application or hiring process, please send an email to TalentandInclusion@corebridgefinancial.com. Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case-by-case basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law.

Responds to emergencies, fire alarms, hazardous material incidents. Deals with conflict, confrontation, and stressful situations on a routine basis.   • Performs emergency and hazardous material response services in accordance with training, policy and equipment capabilities.
  • Performs security and emergency services related to site emergency management plans.
  • Trains in relation to Hospital Emergency Incident Command System job roles.
  • Performs set up duties related to Emergency Operations Center.
  • Investigates employee, visitor, and patient complaints; works cooperatively with local police departments and authorities.
  • Completes detailed reports on incidents, thefts, losses.
  • Responds to requests for assistance involving patients in the assigned locations; assists in locating patients; assists Life Flight with unloading patients and equipment, as necessary.

  • Assists and directs patients and visitors to areas within the Medical Center; furnishes information, as requested; may provide assistance to handicapped, wheelchair, and elderly persons upon arrival and departure from the Medical Center; assures an adequate supply of wheelchairs at the hospital entrance.

description:

Job Description

Job Description: Head of Cell Line Development (Director)

About the Role:

The Director, Head of Cell Line Development (CLD) provides leadership for mammalian cell line development to enable a biologics portfolio including monoclonal antibodies, bi-specifics, and adjacent molecular formats. This role sets CLD strategy, leads a team of cell and molecular biologists, and delivers high-performing production cell lines. The role enables programs from early development through IND/IMPD, with lifecycle support for commercial cell lines, as needed. This role is accountable for oversight of GMP cell banking activities (MCB/WCB readiness and governance).

How you will contribute:

  • Define CLD vision, platform strategy, and roadmap aligned to portfolio demand (including complex/next-gen antibody formats).
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of ~10 responsible for clinical cell line delivery and technology evaluation; drive hiring, capability development, and succession planning.
  • Own functional budget, cell line timelines, and vendor governance for CRO/CDMO support where used.
  • Provide technical and operational oversight of end-to-end mammalian cell line development: vector/transfection strategy, selection systems, single-cell cloning, clone screening, stability assessment, and candidate cell line nomination.
  • Ensure fit-for-purpose characterization packages (growth, productivity, stability, and product quality) in collaboration with upstream process development.
  • Lead risk-based strategies for difficult-to-express and complex molecules (e.g., bi-specifics), including mitigation plans and decision criteria.
  • Ensure robust documentation of cell line history, clonality rationale, traceability, and data integrity to support filings and audits. Contribute to regulatory submissions and responses (e.g., IND/IMPD; later-stage support as needed).
  • Accountable for cell banking strategy and execution, including readiness for MCB/WCB generation. Ensure clear, compliant handoffs and documentation for cell bank production (internal or external), including batch records/data packages and deviations/investigations support as applicable.
  • Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of new CLD technologies (host cell/selection systems, single-cell tools, automation, analytics, digital/AI-enabled screening, etc.). Work closely with upstream process development to ensure platform fit of changes/optimization to the host cell line/vectors and/or workflow.
  • Build external collaborations with technology providers and academic/industry partners to maintain competitive CLD capabilities.

Skills and qualifications:
* Recognized expert in Cell Line Development, with a demonstrated track record of delivering clinical production cell lines with strong documentation and tech transfer packages.

* Possesses deep expertise in cell biology, host cell engineering, and expression vector design. Recognized as a subject matter expert with broad awareness of emerging technologies and trends across the industry.

* Strong understanding of how CLD decisions impact product quality and manufacturability, particularly for bi-specifics and complex proteins.
* Recognized as an expert in influencing, able to manage in a matrix environment, collaborate across functions, and communicate effectively to senior stakeholders.
* Extensive experience in managing and coaching a team of scientists at all levels and establishing strong career development plans.

* Experience supporting commercial cell lines and lifecycle management (e.g., investigations, comparability/change control inputs) with an understanding of the regulatory and quality requirements for establishment of MCB/WCBs and IND/BLA submissions.

* Demonstrated success implementing automation/high-throughput screening and collaborating with analytical colleagues to improve cycle times.

* Recognized expert in troubleshooting, able to solve strategic problems, and coaching others.

As a recognized expert within Takeda globally, you possess in-depth expertise in your discipline and knowledge across related areas. You're adept at anticipating internal/external challenges, recommending improvements, and solving unique technical and strategic problems. Your role involves working on complex issues, contributing to BPD strategy, and serving as the primary contact for cell line related contracts and operations and conducting briefings and meetings with management.

OUR COMPANY

Iron EagleX (IEX), a wholly owned subsidiary of General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), delivers agile IT and Intelligence solutions. Combining small-team flexibility with global scale, IEX leverages emerging technologies to provide innovative, user-focused solutions that empower organizations and end users to operate smarter, faster, and more securely in dynamic environments.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Iron EagleX is seeking a SME Cyber Network Analyst to join our fast-paced technical team. In this role, you will analyze, engineer, and troubleshoot complex network environments while supporting the integration and operationalization of advanced cyber capabilities. You will work at the intersection of traditional network engineering, systems administration, cyber analysis, and capability development using your understanding of network architectures, protocols, configurations, and infrastructure to characterize cyber outputs and translate them into actionable operational capabilities.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As a SME Cyber Network Analyst, you will use your understanding of network architectures, configurations, protocols, and systems to help teams understand, validate, and operationalize cyber-derived information and capabilities. Your work will include reconstructing and analyzing network environments, investigating complex network behavior, developing repeatable technical workflows, and collaborating with analysts, developers, and engineers to transform technical outputs into mission-relevant capabilities. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, work across a diverse range of network and systems technologies, expand your cyber and engineering expertise, and directly support missions where technical accuracy and operational effectiveness matter.

JOB DUTIES (INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO)

  • Conduct network surveys and technical assessments to identify, document, and characterize network architectures, configurations, systems, services, and communications pathways.

  • Build and maintain representative laboratory environments to reproduce network configurations, validate technical findings, evaluate cyber outputs, and support capability development and testing.

  • Analyze and map complex network environments, including network devices, hosts, services, routing relationships, protocols, access paths, and other infrastructure dependencies.

  • Analyze cyber-derived technical outputs and translate them into understandable network, system, and operational context for use by analysts and engineers.

  • Examine network configurations and communications pathways to identify relationships, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and potential operational access paths.

  • Perform packet, protocol, traffic, and configuration analysis to characterize network behavior and troubleshoot complex connectivity or interoperability issues.

  • Configure, administer, and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and other network infrastructure within operational and laboratory environments.

  • Develop Python scripts and other lightweight automation tools to support network analysis, data processing, environment configuration, monitoring, testing, and recurring administrative workflows.

  • Build, configure, and maintain Linux and Windows systems supporting network analysis and laboratory environments.

  • Deploy and administer virtualized environments using common hypervisor and virtualization technologies.

  • Develop technical documentation, diagrams, network maps, configuration references, and other artifacts that clearly communicate complex network architectures and technical findings.

  • Identify technical limitations, dependencies, and integration requirements associated with transitioning cyber-derived capabilities into operational environments.

  • Collaborate with analysts, software developers, systems engineers, and network engineers to investigate technical problems and develop solutions supporting advanced operational requirements.

  • Apply disciplined configuration management, documentation, and testing practices to ensure technical environments and workflows are repeatable and maintainable.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Strong practical understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, subnetting, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, and common network protocols.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, upgrading, migrating, and troubleshooting enterprise or operational network infrastructure.

  • Ability to analyze complex network configurations, communications pathways, routing relationships, and system dependencies to understand how traffic and capabilities traverse an environment.

  • Proficiency with Python or a similar scripting/programming language for technical analysis, workflow automation, data manipulation, or tool development.

  • Strong working knowledge of Linux operating systems, including command-line administration, networking utilities, services, permissions, processes, and troubleshooting.

  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows systems and understanding their interaction within enterprise network environments.

  • Ability to build, configure, and troubleshoot representative network and systems environments for testing, analysis, validation, or capability development.

  • Demonstrated ability to systematically investigate complex technical problems across networking, operating systems, applications, and infrastructure.

  • Ability to document network architectures, configurations, technical findings, and troubleshooting processes clearly for both technical and operational audiences.

  • CCNA certification or demonstrated equivalent networking knowledge and practical experience.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing virtualized environments using technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or similar platforms.

  • Experience building, deploying, or troubleshooting containerized applications and services using Docker or similar technologies.

  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and cloud-native technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with Git and standard version-control practices for managing scripts, configuration files, automation, and technical documentation.

  • Experience producing network diagrams, architecture documentation, technical procedures, test plans, or engineering documentation for complex environments.

  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, Security+, Network+, Linux+, RHCSA/RHCE, or equivalent technical certifications are a plus.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Experience: 15+ years of related experience

description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Commercial Loan Servicing Specialist to join Commercial Banking Operations on the Capital Finance Operations (CFO) team within Wholesale Operations.

Capital Finance delivers comprehensive asset-based lending solutions, including sole lender, agented, and syndicated structures. These solutions serve asset-rich companies across the U.S., U.K., and Canada, spanning a wide range of industries.

This role sits within the Lending Servicing function and is responsible for end-to-end life-of-loan servicing activities. The scope includes client loan servicing, syndicated facilities, bought participations, and payoffs for Asset-Based Lending (ABL) portfolios. The role supports revolving and term loan facilities, as well as accounts payable activities, including pass-through expense billings such as field exams, appraisals, and legal fees.

Success in this role requires strong experience in:

title: Research Advisor - K12

Research Advisor - K12 Revenue Team

Hanover Research

Arlington, VA/Remote

The position requires strong communication, deep research methodology knowledge, project management, and K-12 education expertise. We are seeking highly-motivated applicants with the right combination of research experience and practical K12 experience, commercial interest, and communication skills. A successful candidate will be interested in making a long-term contribution to a growing organization. This position will report directly to the Senior Research Advisor. Applicants must be willing to travel domestically up to three (3) times a quarter.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to net K-12 revenue and gross profit margin through activities related to new business (NBBs), additional business (ABBs), and renewals (RBB)

  • Scope customized research projects and advisory supports on various topics for K-12 prospects;

  • Understands full range of K-12 services portfolio – Advisory, Digital, Custom, ELC

  • Draft and review proposals, including RFPs and Membership Action Plans

  • Help to drive urgency through project timelines and content impact

  • Effectively communicate and explain Hanover’s methodologies and consultative supports and findings to prospects;

  • Deliver actionable insights and strategic recommendations to prospects and leadership;

  • Collaborate with directors and associates to develop effective revenue strategies;

  • Identify areas of improvement internally to increase commercial efficiency and optimization;

  • Support other internal initiatives related to growth including:

    • Drafting, reviewing and editing marketing material;

    • Helping to curate the K-12 Project Description Library and Advisory Description Library;

    • Designing and running internal trainings;

    • Collaborate with Content leadership on new offerings and project updates;

    • Create scripts and scoping guides for Revenue teams;

    • Identify trends and recently delivered member reports for redactions.

Desired Skills and Attributes

  • Deep knowledge of the K-12 education including trends and challenges

  • Strong command of all methodologies, research processes, and K12 practical landscape;

  • Exceptional communication skills scalable from 1v1 interactions, formal presentations, and external call presence;

  • Highly responsive to internal and external needs to capitalize on commercial urgency;

  • Ability to translate goals, issues, and initiatives into a well-defined sequenced research and/or advisory plan

  • Desire to work directly with prospective clients and ensure their satisfaction and retention;

title: Senior Analyst, Operations Finance
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Senior Analyst, Operations Finance

The Senior Analyst, Operations Finance will collaborate with the Director, Operations Finance to Property Finance Business Process Management and outsourcing.

Business Process Management (BPM) includes standardizing and automating tasks, developing best practice processes, tools, and templates, and facilitating their deployment across the global portfolio alongside property teams and the business process outsourcing (BPO) partner, with the aim to drive efficiency of accounting processes globally.

The Senior Analyst, Operations Finance will support compliance of the core accounting functions, with both transactional actuals as well as planning (budgeting and forecasting).

The Senior Analyst, Operations Finance will support the implementation of systems, policy and process, ensuring property teams are leveraging the established Standard Operating Procedures. They will also assist with ad hoc requests as requested by Senior Management and other stakeholders.

Strong attention to detail, organization, process knowledge, critical thinking and problem-solving skills are necessary for successfully achieving deadlines and requirements of multiple workstreams across a range of properties. The ideal candidate is analytical and proactive, with strong business acumen and a passion for process improvement and standardization.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Process Efficiency & Governance

  • Drive adoption of best practices and standards.
  • Maximize the use of standardized tools and templates by the properties.
  • Monitor and improve KPI’s within the Service Level Agreements.
  • Minimize Capgemini errors reported by the properties.
  • Maximize efficiency of onsite processes.
  • Assist in establishing/enforcing policies, rules, internal controls and safeguards.
  • Continuously deliver the highest level of service with respect to property support and maximize property satisfaction of outsourced services.
  • Provide hotel users with support for standard tools, templates and processes.

Regional Oversight

  • Support leadership decisions through reporting and data-driven insights.
  • Demonstrate proficiency as a lead/power-user of company financial systems and regional practices.
  • Provide regular status reporting as required.

Insights and Innovation

  • Transform complex data into summarized meaningful and actionable insights.
  • Present and provide meaningful commentary to stakeholders on past, current and future state across all identified areas of responsibility.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Collaborate with Operations Finance, property teams and business process outsourcing partner to ensure timeliness and integrity of financial processes.
  • Represent both Operations Finance and the properties on cross-functional projects and requests.
  • Leverage Microsoft 365 suite of software including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams to enhance communication, reporting, organization and collaboration within the team and other groups.

What You Bring:

  • 3-5 years of experience in a related hospitality accounting or shared services role.
  • Field experience with hands on knowledge of PMS/POS environments, Income Audit, and GL processes.
  • Familiar with detailed workflows and system navigation, the clicks, the sequences, and the practical application.
  • CPA or university degree in hospitality, accounting or finance preferred.
  • Multilingual is an asset.

Key Skills/Who You Are:

Behavioral

  • Proven leadership skills in a property and/or corporate office environment.
  • Highest level of integrity and transparency, and ethical approach to influence the outcome of situations.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills to work with cross-functional teams, negotiate for resources, influence stakeholders, and gain acceptance of and commitment to plans, ideas and initiatives.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative and use sound judgement.
  • Promotes a continuous learning environment that creates an atmosphere for professional development opportunities.
  • Ability to meet various deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work in a safe, prudent and organized manner.

Functional

  • Strategic and analytical, with solid business acumen and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong multi-tasking and project management skills.
  • Attention to detail with a focus on solutions, results and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to deal with confidential information in a professional manner.

Technical Skills & Knowledge

  • Working technical knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles.
  • Ability to read, write and speak English fluently; additional languages an asset.

Travel:
