Job Description:

SME SOLUTION ARCHITECT

Support mission-critical initiatives and enable the growth of our business as a Solution Architect at GDIT. Here, you’ll become an integral part of how GDIT is able to ensure the safety and security of our nation.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Solution Architect, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of Federal Financial Agencies. You will play a crucial role and conduct continuous operational analysis of our client’s business processes, leverage the knowledge with your technical expertise in architectural design and applications functionality and provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for the transition of mission-critical financial applications from IBM Mainframe platforms to modern, cloud-enabled, and server-based architecture.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Become a trusted Subject Matter Expert by reviewing client’s current mainframe, Mid-range system architecture, including interfaces, data models, and batch processing frameworks to understand current state business processes.

  • Propose future state business processes and architectural solutions featuring industry best practices and technical design by operating efficiently and effectively in an multifaceted organization environment

  • Lead the implementation of modern technical solutions by supporting design and solutioning activities with the client’s financial agent and enhance user experience by utilizing advanced mapping tools and software architectural analysis methods.

  • Collaborate with client’s financial agent to develop efficient and effective business workstreams and provide technical drawings providing detailed design and generating proof-of-concept solutions for adoption.

  • Communicate and articulate requirements to financial agent oversight and development teams that will draft agile stories to implement adopted design decisions.

  • Work with partner organizations and multiple development teams to ensure technical workflow solutions align with federal financial, security, and compliance requirements.

  • Utilize expertise of process mapping workflow software such as MicroSoft Visio or other industry standard tools to effectively map and present business workflows.

  • Develop strategies for migrating legacy mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2, VSAM) to modern server and cloud environments.

  • Provide architecture-level recommendations for integration, performance optimization, and data migrations.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, while contributing to modernization of roadmaps and data migration plans.

  • Lead development teams in applying modern design patterns, cloud-native principles, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Support testing, validation, and deployment of new and reengineered applications across environments.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your initiative and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Senior Solution Architect position requires expertise in mapping clients’ business processes and technical architecture using industry standard tools common to senior business analysts and information technology systems architects.

  • Candidates must demonstrate experience applying these tools to design cloud-based solutions involving complex applications, databases, and interfaces.

  • Candidates should have a proven track record in developing modernization strategies for hybrid environments that combine mainframes with custom applications from multiple vendors.

  • Candidates be able to relate their mapping experience and tools used during the interview process and should be able to demonstrate their skills and experience in this area.

  • The ideal candidate will analyze client operations and propose strategies that move away from mainframe systems, offering front-end and back-end solutions that align with GDIT’s goals of improving efficiency and strengthening trust with financial partners.

Success in this role includes contributing to winning proposals and implementing cloud-based solutions leveraging modern technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, APIs, microservices, and cloud platforms.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

Required Experience:

  • 10 years of experience in enterprise application architecture, systems design, and implementation.

Required Technical Skills:

  • Familiar with Mainframe technologies, including COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2, and VSAM.

  • Proven experience with modern web/server technologies, including: Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, Postgres, Tomcat/WebLogic, and Linux.

  • Hands-on experience with modernization or migration of legacy mainframe applications to distributed or cloud-based systems.

  • Strong understanding of system integration, data migration, and application interoperability between legacy and modern platforms.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting federal financial systems.

  • Expertise with financial application architectures (e.g., general ledger, disbursement, or reconciliation systems) that support disbursement operations.

POSITION SUMMARY: The Asset Protection Coordinator is an hourly position that directly reports to the Market Asset Protection Manager and will maintain and monitor all asset protection, security, compliance, and safety related functions within a facility. title: Market Risk Specialist, Corporate and Investment Banking Risk
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Market Risk Specialist to join the Market Risk Cross Functional Oversight team within the Corporate Market Risk Group (CMRG). The team supports trading desk oversight, regulatory initiatives, market risk reporting, governance processes, and cross-functional programs across multiple product areas. Additionally, this role will support the implementation and ongoing execution of the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) framework, including trading desk governance, regulatory compliance activities, risk measurement processes, control execution, documentation, and stakeholder coordination.

Learn more about career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com.


In this role, you will:

  • Develop and maintain analytics, reporting, and process support solutions that improve risk transparency, monitoring effectiveness, governance consistency, and management decision-making.
  • Prepare analysis, summaries, and supporting materials related to market risk, regulatory, and control initiatives for management review and stakeholder discussions.
  • Support cross-functional regulatory initiatives and remediation activities by coordinating assigned workstreams, tracking deliverables, and assisting with execution across Front Office, Risk, Finance, Technology, and Control partners.
  • Provide analytical support for independent oversight activities across trading desks and market risk programs, including FRTB implementation, Profit and Loss attribution (PLA), regulatory compliance monitoring, and identification of risks or control issues requiring escalation.
  • Support FRTB-related processes, including trading desk governance, model eligibility and performance monitoring, market risk capital methodologies, attribution analysis, and regulatory reporting readiness.
  • Contribute to governance activities for market risk methodologies, controls, processes, regulatory obligations, and remediation efforts through analysis, documentation, and issue tracking.
  • Maintain documentation, governance records, and supporting evidence for market risk oversight activities, regulatory engagements, internal audits, issue remediation, and control effectiveness reviews.
  • Review and summarize key risk indicators, policy exceptions, control gaps, and emerging issues in accordance with governance standards and established escalation protocols.
  • Collaborate across trading, finance, risk, technology, and control functions to support risk identification, assumption review, process improvement, and sustainable control outcomes.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of market risk, Capital Markets, desk analyst, trading, interest rate risk or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Engineering, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using Python, SQL, or similar tools to analyze, automate, and present risk-related information.
  • Experience with business intelligence and productivity tools such as Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting platforms.
  • Knowledge of derivative products, pricing concepts, and market risk measures such as Value-at-Risk (VaR), stress scenarios, risk factor sensitivities, and related analytics.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage assigned deliverables, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in a dynamic risk management environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to summarize market risk, regulatory, and control-related information clearly for stakeholders and management.
  • Familiarity with market risk capital rules, trading desk governance, market risk measurement methodologies, profit and loss attribution concepts, and related governance expectations.

title: Senior Business Process Engineer
description:
Position Summary:

Direct Supply is building the future of healthcare technology with industry-leading products, solutions and platforms to help improve the lives of millions of seniors and those who care for them.

In the Senior Business Reinvention Engineer position, you’ll lead high-impact, cross-functional transformation initiatives that reimagine how Direct Supply operates. You’ll turn complex business challenges into scalable solutions, own transformation roadmaps, and apply AI, automation, and data to redesign critical workflows and deliver measurable business value.

Skills Needed:

  • Learn & Adapt - Continuously grow and adapt as technology, customer needs, roles, and work systems evolve. Stay curious, learn beyond your core specialty, experiment with new approaches, use AI to accelerate learning, and improve through feedback and setbacks.

  • Systems Thinking & Problem Solving - Identify the right problems to solve by understanding the broader system – customers, stakeholders, processes, data, technology, and AI. Connect root causes, dependencies, tradeoffs, and upstream and downstream effects to develop practical, scalable solutions that improve the whole.

  • Influence & Collaborate - Build trust, communicate clearly, and work across boundaries to drive action and shared outcomes. Seek and integrate different perspectives, contribute ideas, work through dependencies, and help teams make progress together through change and ambiguity.

  • Apply Judgment - Make sound decisions by evaluating data, context, assumptions, risk, and outcomes. Critically assess ideas and AI-generated outputs, consider interdependencies, voice a clear point of view, and own the results and impact.

  • Create & Shape Ideas - Generate, test, and develop new ideas into useful, high-quality solutions and experiences. Use creativity, curiosity, technology, and different perspectives to see around the corner, innovate and develop ideas into outcomes that create value and scale.

What You’ll Do and Impact:

  • Transform ambiguous business challenges into clearly defined opportunities, future-state designs, business cases, and executable transformation plans.

  • Design and deliver complex, technology-enabled solutions that reimagine end-to-end business capabilities and workflows and drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Own transformation roadmaps by defining priorities, sequencing initiatives, managing dependencies, and aligning business and technology teams.

  • Influence senior leaders to align priorities, secure sponsorship, make key decisions, and remove barriers to transformation.

  • Leverage data, performance insights, and business outcomes to identify opportunities, measure impact, and continuously improve solutions.

  • Drive visibility, stakeholder alignment, and accountability from initial concept through implementation and adoption.

Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional business transformation, product, process, or technology-enabled initiatives, including defining future-state solutions and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience implementing intelligent automation, AI use cases, or integrated technology solutions across business functions such as supply chain, finance, or customer operations.

  • Experience applying AI, automation, workflow platforms, low-code solutions, and other emerging technologies to solve complex business problems.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and present business cases tied to operational improvements, measurable value, and ROI.

  • Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery methodologies, including iterative development and stakeholder engagement.

Additional Items of Interest:

  • Experience developing strategic transformation roadmaps and leading initiatives from concept through adoption.

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business implications and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience scaling automation or technology-enabled transformation initiatives across an organization.

  • Lean Six Sigma, automation technology, or related certifications.

Responsibilities
The Director, Information Technology Group, Wadsworth Center will provide overall vision, leadership, and strategic planning in the direction, development, and implementation of all aspects of the information technology (IT) program at the Wadsworth Center (the New York State Department of Health’s public health laboratory). The incumbent will work with key stakeholders to advance the IT needs of the Wadsworth Center, including regular coordination with Wadsworth Center executive leadership, Health Commissioner IT staff, the New York State Office of Information Technology Services (ITS), Wadsworth Center public health program leads, and with staff managing grant-funded projects with substantial IT deliverables. The incumbent will supervise IT staff that support hardware and networking systems, software development (particularly laboratory information systems), IT project management, and instrumentation integration. The incumbent will also direct and oversee IT budgets and expenditures and work directly with Wadsworth Center and Health Department executive staff to coordinate IT investments across the Center. Occasional night/weekend work may be expected.

This position will be part of a dynamic team serving the Wadsworth Center’s mission in the New York State Department of Health’s efforts to protect and promote the health of New York’s citizens. Come be a part of Science in the Pursuit of Health®!

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Technology, Information Technology, Health Informatics or another applicable math, science, or public health major and seven years of experience in the direction and management of an IT program in a scientific environment; OR an Associate’s degree in a related field and nine years of such experience; OR eleven years of such experience. At least five years of experience must have included supervision of staff. A Master’s degree in a related field may substitute for one year of experience in the direction and management of an IT program in a scientific environment.

title: Director, Distribution Center Maintenance & Asset Reliability
description:
Position Summary

The Director, Distribution Center Maintenance & Asset Reliability provides enterprise leadership for maintenance, facilities, asset reliability, and capital planning and construction programs across the distribution network. This role is responsible for developing and implementing maintenance strategies, standards, policies, and performance expectations that support safe, reliable, and cost-effective operations.

This Director leads a team of Regional Maintenance Managers, Asset Reliability Analysts and serves as the function leader for Distribution Center Maintenance Managers through a matrix reporting structure and partners closely with Distribution Center General Managers, Engineering, Finance, Safety, and Supply Chain leadership. The role is responsible for advancing maintenance excellence, optimizing asset performance, guiding capital investment strategies, and ensuring the organization's facilities and equipment can support current and future business needs.

The Director is accountable for maintenance workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, asset lifecycle management, and reliability initiatives across the network. The role establishes maintenance standards, staffing models and role-level expectations while leading the planning, construction, expansion and execution of distribution center capital projects.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

Maintenance Strategy & Asset Reliability

Develop and execute the enterprise maintenance and asset reliability strategy for the distribution network, ensuring alignment with operational, financial, and business objectives. Establish and govern preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for building systems, material handling equipment, rolling stock, racking, HVAC, and other facility infrastructure. Monitor reliability and maintenance performance through established KPIs, analytics, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure effective utilization and governance of CMMS, maintenance systems, asset management processes, and reporting tools.

Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness

Lead and develop Regional Maintenance Managers and support personnel while providing functional leadership to Distribution Center Maintenance Managers through a matrix reporting structure. Establish maintenance organizational standards, staffing models, role leveling criteria, competency requirements, and workforce development strategies across the distribution network. Partner with Distribution Center leadership to ensure maintenance organizations are appropriately staffed, capable, and positioned to support current and future business needs.

Capital Planning & Asset Lifecycle Management

Lead maintenance-related capital planning and long-range asset replacement strategies, including project prioritization, business case development, ROI analysis, and capital governance. Direct the planning, design, construction, startup, expansion, and commissioning of new distribution centers and major capital improvement projects. Oversee all phases of capital project execution, including scope development, budgeting, scheduling, contractor management, commissioning, project closeout, and financial reporting. Evaluate facility and equipment performance and recommend upgrades, modernization initiatives, automation investments, and infrastructure improvements to enhance operational performance and reliability.

Facilities, Safety & Compliance

Ensure maintenance programs support compliance with OSHA, environmental, fire protection, hazardous materials, and other applicable regulatory requirements. Partner with Safety and Operations leadership to promote a culture of safety, risk reduction, and regulatory compliance.

Vendor Management & Strategic Partnerships

Develop and maintain relationships with contractors, equipment manufacturers, service providers, and consultants to support maintenance operations and capital projects. Establish service expectations, evaluate vendor performance, and negotiate maintenance service agreements and contracts in consultation with Procurement partners. Serve as the primary maintenance advisor to Distribution Center leadership, Supply Chain leadership, and Engineering leadership regarding maintenance strategy, asset reliability, facilities management, and capital planning.

Analytics & Performance Management

Provide maintenance and capital expenditure reporting, performance analysis, forecasting and recommendations to senior leadership. Partner with Asset Reliability Analysts to ensure effective financial stewardship, project tracking, and performance measurement of maintenance and capital investments.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive maintenance, facilities, asset reliability, or engineering leadership experience in a distribution, logistics, manufacturing, or highly automated operational environment.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing multi-site maintenance operations or maintenance support functions.
  • Experience leading capital planning, asset replacement programs, and facility improvement initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of maintenance best practices, asset management principles, safety regulations, and facility systems.
  • Experience utilizing CMMS, maintenance management systems, and performance analytics tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and lead through a matrix organizational structure.
  • Strong business acumen, project management, communication, and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Facilities Engineering.
  • Experience supporting highly automated distribution or fulfillment operations.
  • Professional certifications such as Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP), Certified Plant Maintenance Manager (CPMM), Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, or similar credentials.
  • Experience with reliability-centered maintenance, predictive maintenance technologies, and asset lifecycle management programs.
  • Experience leading major distribution center construction, expansion, or automation projects.
  • Experience supporting highly automated distribution or fulfillment operations.

Start Rate = $187,000-$213,500 based on experience plus 25% annual bonus and equity.

Your Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package, including annual bonus opportunities

Dollar Tree is one of North America's largest and most successful value retailers, operating thousands of stores across the United States and Canada. The Senior Technical Product Owner is a senior team member responsible for translating business product strategy into executable technical deliverables and ensuring development teams deliver maximum business value. Working with the business Product Manager who owns overall product strategy, the Senior TPO manages complex product backlogs, drives tactical execution, and mentors junior TPOs. Holds acceptance authority for completed work and creates precise, AI-ready requirements using Given-When-Then (Gherkin) format. Models AI-augmented engineering excellence — integrating AI capabilities where appropriate, evaluating outputs rigorously, and shaping team practices for prompt design, evaluation, and safety.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

AI-Augmented Engineering Excellence

  • Model AI-augmented engineering excellence — design solutions that integrate AI capabilities (LLMs, RAG, agents) where appropriate.
  • Demonstrate active AI fluency — use AI assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) as a daily co-engineer for code generation, test creation, documentation, and learning.
  • Write AI-ready requirements (Given-When-Then/Gherkin) that enable AI-assisted development tools to generate accurate, testable code.
  • Evaluate AI outputs rigorously and shape team practices for prompt design, evaluation, and safety.
  • Stay current with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and equivalents) and evangelize best practices across the team.

Story Creation & Requirements Engineering

  • Author comprehensive user stories using Given-When-Then format with complete behavioral context (Given = initial state/preconditions, When = actions/triggers, Then = expected outcomes).
  • Define explicit acceptance criteria covering happy paths, edge cases, error conditions, and complex integration scenarios.
  • Include technical constraints, validation rules, business logic, performance requirements, security considerations, and compliance standards.
  • Provide concrete examples with sample data, API specifications, and reference implementations.
  • Document dependencies, integration points, and system interactions clearly for both human developers and AI-assisted tools.
  • Collaborate with technical product managers, architects, and technical leads on architectural context and design patterns.
  • Handle complex, enterprise-level requirements involving multiple systems and cross-functional dependencies.

Story Acceptance & Quality Leadership

  • Review and accept completed stories, validating functionality meets all acceptance criteria and enterprise quality standards.
  • Test delivered functionality against each Given-When-Then scenario across multiple integration points.
  • Verify solutions handle all documented scenarios including edge cases, security requirements, and performance benchmarks.
  • Exercise final acceptance authority, ensuring deliverables are production-ready before release.
  • Coordinate with QA teams on acceptance criteria alignment and automated testing strategies.
  • Provide structured feedback for stories requiring remediation.

Backlog Management & Prioritization

  • Own and maintain complex user story backlogs, strategically prioritizing based on business value, technical dependencies, and risk.
  • Translate business product strategy and roadmap into detailed, development-ready user stories.
  • Break down complex features into appropriately sized stories while maintaining technical coherence.
  • Make tactical trade-off decisions to maximize value delivery within constraints.
  • Sequence backlog items accounting for dependencies, risk mitigation, technical debt reduction, and incremental delivery through creation of release plans.
  • Manage backlog across multiple teams or complex product areas when required.
  • Identify and escalate strategic risks or impediments impacting delivery.

Team Leadership & Agile Excellence

  • Lead sprint ceremonies including planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Partner with Scrum Masters, developers, architects, QA engineers, and designers to drive team efficiency.
  • Provide real-time expert guidance on business logic and acceptance criteria during development.
  • Present completed work during sprint reviews, demonstrating acceptance and articulating business value.
  • Foster collaborative environment encouraging questions and continuous improvement.
  • Champion Agile and BDD practices across the organization.

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence

  • Serve as senior point of contact between development teams and business stakeholders.
  • Facilitate complex requirements discovery sessions with diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure business readiness.
  • Communicate sprint progress, release readiness, and risks to business Product Manager, stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Negotiate scope, priorities, and trade-offs balancing business needs with technical realities.
  • Influence technical execution through data-driven insights from delivery and user feedback.

Mentorship & Organizational Impact

  • Mentor and coach junior TPOs (Associate TPO, TPO) on GWT story writing, requirements craft, acceptance practices, and quality standards.
  • Review stories created by junior team members ensuring quality and consistency.
  • Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and training of new product ownership team members.
  • Participate in or lead communities of practice for product owners.
  • Drive adoption of new tools, methodologies, or practices improving delivery effectiveness.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 7–10 years as a TPO, Business Analyst, or Technical Product Owner in Agile teams.
  • Minimum 3–5 years at senior/lead level handling complex, enterprise-scale products.
  • Expert in writing detailed user stories with comprehensive acceptance criteria using Given-When-Then format.
  • Strong Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) experience.
  • Advanced technical acumen with system architecture, data models, APIs, and integration patterns.
  • Proven leadership within Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Expert proficiency with Agile tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence).
  • Outstanding communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members.

Preferred

  • CSPO, A-CSPO, CPO, or PMI-ACP certification.
  • Experience with BDD tools (Cucumber, SpecFlow, Behave).
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.).
  • Understanding of test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
  • Background in software development, architecture, or QA.
  • Experience leading product ownership for multiple teams.

title: Backend Engineer_AI Gateway (Korean Required)
description:
We are building an AI Gateway—a high‑performance intermediary that routes, inspects, and governs traffic between enterprise clients and LLM/AI service providers. In this role you will own the entire full‑stack lifecycle of the gateway, from core Python API service design and implementation to containerization, deployment, monitoring, and day‑to‑day operations.

While you can consult network and security specialists for architecture reviews, threat modeling, and policy definition, the application code, testing, CI/CD pipeline, and production operations will be developed and maintained solely by you. You’ll have full technical autonomy to design, build, and scale a robust, production‑grade system.

What we are looking for

  • Experience: Around 5 years of professional backend development experience, with a solid track record of building and operating production-grade services.
  • Async Python & Core Web Frameworks (3+ yrs): Deep understanding of asyncio and hands-on production experience with FastAPI (Pydantic, dependency injection, OpenAPI).
  • Network Protocol & Streaming Fundamentals:
    • Strong grasp of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and SSE (Server-Sent Events) / Chunked transfer encoding essential for real-time LLM inference streaming.
    • Practical understanding of the TCP/IP lifecycle, connection pooling, keep-alive, and managing back-pressure.
  • Database & Async Messaging:
    • Proficiency in PostgreSQL (query tuning, connection pooling via PgBouncer).
    • Experience with message queues or event streams (e.g., Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, or Kafka) for decoupled task processing.
  • Containerization & CI/CD:
    • Docker, Kubernetes (basic workload management, deployment, HPA), and setting up CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI).

Work experience desired

  • Collaborative Security & Infra Awareness: Willingness to work with internal security/network teams on NGINX/Envoy reverse-proxy setup, mTLS, or IAM/SSO (OIDC/SAML) integrations.
  • AI/LLM Integration: Experience handling LLM API payloads, managing rate limits, or implementing simple proxy/gateway patterns for AI services.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Basic familiarity with Terraform for multi-env infrastructure management.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Assistant Controller
description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Job Summary

Apply principles of accounting to analyze financial information and prepare financial reports and forecasts by compiling information and utilizing appropriate accounting control procedures.

Responsible for working with Teledyne corporate to provide any financial information that is requested. Will supervise a small accounting staff and oversee all daily, monthly and quarterly reporting.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities may include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Prepare and review financial statements, monthly closing reports, journal entries and cost accounting reports
  • Work with controller to maintain proper accounting and internal control procedures and polices
  • Preparation and review of monthly account reconciliations
  • Assist controller with both internal and external auditors in completing annual audits
  • Work with corporate to gather and prepare year end information for tax reporting
  • Maintain a documented system of accounting policies and procedures
  • Research various accounting topics to include GAAP and FAR compliance
  • Assist controller with developing staff
  • Participate in process improvement activities
  • Daily availability to include evenings and weekends when necessary to reach goals and deadlines.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Direct staffing, training and performance evaluation of Accounting personnel to achieve established business goals. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
  • Conducts management meetings with department heads to establish, delineate and review organizational financial policies, to coordinate accounting activities between departments and to establish responsibilities for attaining objectives.
  • Ensure accounting personnel practices are in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Analytical - Collects and researches data; uses intuition and experience to complement data.
  • Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; works well in group problem solving situations.
  • Project Management – Communicates changes and progress.
  • Technical Skills - Pursues training and development opportunities; strives to continuously build knowledge and skills.
  • Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; participates in meetings.
  • Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.
  • Teamwork – Gives and welcomes feedback; supports everyone’s efforts to succeed. Builds team relations.
  • Leadership/Managing People - Exhibits confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well; Effectively influences actions and opinions of others; Accepts feedback from others; Gives appropriate recognition to others. Comes to the forefront in case of crisis, and is able to think and act in creative ways in difficult situations. Holds team accountable. Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent. Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes him/herself available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services. Continually works to improve supervisory skills.
  • Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions.
  • Ethics - Treats people with respect; works with integrity and ethically; upholds organizational values.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; supports organization’s goals and values.
  • Judgment - Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.
  • Motivation – Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles.
  • Planning/Organizing –Prioritizes and plans work activities; uses time efficiently.
  • Professionalism –Reacts well under pressure; treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; accepts responsibility for own actions.
  • Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; looks for ways to improve and promote quality; applies feedback to improve performance; monitors own work to ensure quality.
  • Quantity – Completes work in a timely manner; strives to increase productivity.
  • Safety and Security – Observes safety and security procedures including using Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as required and wearing company issued badge when on company property; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and material properly.
  • Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
  • Initiative – Seeks increased responsibilities; asks for and offers help when needed.
  • Innovation – Generates suggestions for improving work.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from four-year college or university in a related field and a minimum of 5 years of directly related experience (Accounting Management / Assistant Controller) and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Language Skills

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
  • Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.
  • Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format.
  • Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors

Mathematical Skills

  • Ability to apply advanced mathematical concepts such as exponents, logarithms, quadratic equations, and permutations.
  • Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.

Reasoning Ability

  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
  • Be capable of both analytical and imaginative reasoning which are desirable attributes that will better enable you to carry out the duties of Accounting manager.

Computer Skills

To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of

  • MS Excel Spreadsheet software, candidate should be proficient
  • MS Office Products

Other Essential Duties

  • Follows all import/export requirements, consulting with facility import/export personnel as required.

Other Skills and Abilities

  • Basic Knowledge of ISO and/or AS9100
  • Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing/6 Sigma/Kaizen
  • Knowledge of specific software Deltek Costpoint would be a plus, but extensive knowledge of ERP system is required. (design, analysis, ERP…)

Other Qualifications

  • US Citizenship with ability to attain/maintain government security clearance.
  • Ability to travel (domestically/internationally) approximately _+/-10__%

The Software Engineer/Developer will join Wadsworth Center’s Laboratory Information Management System (CLIMS) team to perform computer application maintenance, development and integration activities to support core LIMS functionality and needs for internal users. title: Projektledare inom ISO-certifiering
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en nyckelroll där du leder ett verksamhetskritiskt ISO-certifieringsprogram i en komplex organisation. Här får du hålla ihop hela certifieringsresan och skapa struktur, framdrift och samsyn från planering och styrning till revisionsberedskap och långsiktig efterlevnad. Du arbetar nära verksamhet, IT, processägare, ämnesexperter, revisorer och ledning för att etablera ett hållbart ledningssystem som uppfyller ISO-krav och samtidigt stödjer verksamhetens mål och operativa effektivitet.

Rollen passar dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan projektledning, governance, compliance och förändringsledning. Du får stort inflytande över hur arbetet formas, prioriteras och följs upp, samtidigt som du driver engagemang och ansvarstagande i flera delar av organisationen. Det här är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett komplext program med tydlig påverkan på både struktur, kvalitet och långsiktig hållbarhet.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du etablerar och driver den övergripande roadmapen för ISO-certifieringen, med tydliga milstolpar, beroenden och uppföljning.
  • Du sätter styrning, rapporteringsstruktur och beslutsforum som skapar kontroll och transparens genom hela programmet.
  • Du leder arbetet med budget, resurser, risker, antaganden, avvikelser och kritiska frågeställningar.
  • Du samordnar intressenter inom verksamhet och IT och skapar samsyn kring mål, compliancekrav och processägarskap.
  • Du håller i workshops, styrgrupper och andra forum där du driver beslut och säkerställer framdrift.
  • Du koordinerar gap-analyser mot relevanta ISO-standarder och ser till att identifierade gap hanteras genom strukturerade åtgärder.
  • Du stöttar utveckling, granskning och förvaltning av policys, processer och dokumentation som krävs för certifieringen.
  • Du leder förberedelser inför interna och externa revisioner och säkerställer att organisationen är väl förberedd i god tid.
  • Du driver kommunikations- och förändringsarbete som stärker medvetenhet, beredskap och förankring i organisationen.
  • Du följer upp korrigerande och förebyggande åtgärder samt koordinerar arbetet med närliggande complianceinitiativ där kravbilden överlappar.
Krav
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda certifierings-, compliance-, governance- eller transformationsprogram.
  • Erfarenhet av arbete mot relevanta ISO-standarder.
  • Erfarenhet av att leda tvärfunktionella initiativ i komplexa organisatoriska miljöer.
  • Erfarenhet av riskhantering, revisionsprocesser och regulatoriska compliancekrav.
  • Mycket god förmåga att skapa struktur, styrning, rapportering och uppföljning i program med många intressenter.
  • Förmåga att påverka och skapa framdrift även utan formellt mandat.
  • Ett strukturerat, analytiskt och pragmatiskt arbetssätt med starkt leveransfokus.
  • Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
Meriterande
  • Erfarenhet av ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, ISO 20000 eller liknande ramverk.
  • Erfarenhet av att samordna complianceinitiativ med överlappande krav.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Executive Director, Board Development
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

The Executive Director of Board Development provides system-wide leadership for board development across first-tier BILH organizations, while serving as lead advisor and primary support for BIDMC board development initiatives. Reporting to the Vice President, Philanthropy Enterprise Initiatives, The Executive Director is responsible for the development, implementation, and oversight of a comprehensive board development program that supports organizational priorities, advances a partnership with local and system governance staff, promotes philanthropic engagement, and develops strategies to recruit and cultivate diverse volunteer leadership talent to reflect patient populations and support strategic priorities. The position partners with the BILH System Governance Team to ensure board development practices complement governance standards and processes. The Executive Director partners closely with hospital leaders, senior executives, Philanthropy leaders, board development staff, and volunteer leaders to ensure an exceptional board engagement experience for trustees, advisory board members, and committee members. The role provides system-wide leadership for first-tier board recruitment, onboarding and board engagement strategies designed to advance philanthropic and organizational goals.

Job Description:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but not limited to:

Strategic Board Development Leadership

1. Leads the Board Development function across first-tier BILH hospital and clinical unit boards, establishing a system-wide approach to identifying, cultivating, recruiting, onboarding, and educating volunteer leaders.

2. Develops and coordinates system-wide strategies for first-tier trustee recruitment, leadership succession, committee appointments, and volunteer engagement initiatives.

3. Ensures alignment of board structure, composition, and leadership development efforts with system governance structure and local strategic priorities and community needs.

Board Candidate Pipeline and Leadership Development

1. Build and manages the candidate pipeline across first-tier hospitals and clinical units, partnering with Governance and Nominating Committees, philanthropy leadership, prospect development teams, and executive leadership to identify, evaluate, and recruit high-impact volunteer leaders.

2. Leads efforts to cultivate and maintain robust trustee and volunteer leadership pipelines, including identification of future board chairs, committee leaders, and philanthropic ambassadors.

3. In collaboration with the BILH Board Governance team, establishes and coordinates comprehensive onboarding, orientation, education, and continuing development programs for first-tier board members and volunteer leaders.

4. Develop and recommend strategies to increase community representation, and skill-based board participation.

Board and Volunteer Engagement

1. Provides strategic leadership for trustee engagement and stewardship activities, ensuring meaningful opportunities for board members to advance philanthropy, advocacy, community engagement, and organizational priorities.

2. Develops and monitors reporting and metrics related to trustee engagement, including participation, philanthropic engagement, leadership involvement, and other indicators of an active and engaged board.

3. Partners with philanthropy and executive leadership to identify opportunities that maximize board members' influence, networks, expertise, and philanthropic capacity.

4. Works with board and philanthropy leaders to develop educational initiatives to enhance the engagement of board members in philanthropy.

5. Creates an intentional and consistent trustee experience across the first-tier board member lifecycle, from onboarding and early engagement through ongoing service, leadership development, recognition, and transition from board service.

Team Leadership and Management

1. Coordinates Board Development staff, creating a high-performing team culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, innovation, customer service, and continuous improvement.

2. Develop work plans including project management, budget development, operational performance, and resource allocation.

3. Identifies opportunities to leverage data, technology, and best practices to strengthen candidate pipeline development, trustee engagement, and overall board member experience.

Organizational Partnership and Consultation

1. Serves as the organization's subject matter expert on board development, trustee engagement, and onboarding best practices for first-tier boards.

2. Provides consultation, training, guidance, tools, and resources to philanthropy staff, hospital administrators, executive leaders, and board liaisons on board development matters.

3. Leads special projects and strategic initiatives relating to board development, volunteer leadership, board engagement, and philanthropy integration.

4. Represents Board Development and Philanthropy in system-wide committees, task forces, executive meetings, and external professional organizations as appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required.

  • Experience: 10–15 years of progressively responsible experience in philanthropy, volunteer leadership, board development, nonprofit management, healthcare administration, or related field required.

  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership and staff management experience required.

  • Demonstrated experience building relationships and working effectively with trustees, senior executives, donors, community leaders, and other high-level volunteers required.

  • Healthcare, academic medicine, or large nonprofit system experience strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience developing and engaging trustees, volunteer leaders, and other influential constituents with knowledge of nonprofit board structures , and best practices.

  • Demonstrated success developing and engaging influential volunteer leaders, trustees, and philanthropic ambassadors.

  • Experience supporting healthcare, academic, nonprofit, or complex matrix organizations.

  • Knowledge of fundraising principles, major gifts, board philanthropy, campaign leadership, and donor engagement strategies.

  • Experience leveraging governance technology platforms, including Nasdaq BoardVantage, Diligent, OnBoard, or similar systems.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, O365, Power BI, CRM platforms, and board management systems.

  • Experience leading diversity-focused board recruitment and inclusion initiatives.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:

Decision Making - Ability to make complex, strategic decisions affecting multiple organizations, departments, and stakeholder groups. Exercises significant independent judgment in board development strategy, volunteer leadership engagement, and organizational planning.

Problem Solving - Ability to navigate highly complex and sensitive issues involving trustees, volunteer leaders, executive stakeholders, donors and organizational priorities through diplomacy, strategic thinking, and influence.

Independence of Action - Functions with a high degree of independence. Establishes strategic direction, departmental objectives, and operational priorities with broad executive guidance.

Written Communications - Exceptional ability to prepare executive-level communications, board and volunteer engagement materials, presentations, reports, correspondence, and strategic recommendations for senior leaders and trustees.

Oral Communications - Ability to influence, negotiate, advise, and present effectively to board members, executive leadership, physicians, donors, and external stakeholders.

Knowledge - Demonstrated expertise in board development, volunteer leadership engagement, philanthropy, and nonprofit leadership practices, with a strong working knowledge of nonprofit governance principles and board best practices.

Teamwork - Ability to lead high-performing teams and foster collaborative relationships across multiple entities and stakeholder groups.

Customer Service - Ability to establish and maintain exceptional service standards for volunteer leaders, trustees, executive leadership, and internal partners.

Physical Requirements & Environment:

  • Work requires close attention to task for work to be accurately completed. Intermittent breaks during the work day do not compromise the work.

  • Work is varied every day and the employee needs to be adaptable to respond to these changes and use independent judgment and manage priorities.

  • No substantial exposure to adverse environmental conditions

description:

title: Integration Lead
description:
SEEK Pass is revolutionising how over 5 million people manage their verified credentials across Asia-Pacific. You will lead the strategic delivery of partner integrations that expand our ecosystem and drive growth. This newly created role reports to the Senior Growth Manager (Ecosystem) and requires someone who can think strategically about integration delivery while building the frameworks and processes that enable scale.

You will work across SEEK Pass Growth, product squads, sales teams, and external partners to ensure integrations deliver predictable business outcomes and partner value. As we expand our partner network with increasingly sophisticated organisations, you'll need a solid understanding of how APIs work combined with commercial judgment to design delivery approaches that balance speed, quality and business impact. This isn't about executing task lists—you'll be thinking through how to streamline partner journeys, identify bottlenecks in API integration processes, design scalable frameworks, and create visibility that drives better business decisions.

Success in your first 6-12 months means establishing delivery frameworks that improve integration velocity and quality, creating pipeline visibility that informs growth strategy, and building stakeholder confidence through predictable, business-focused delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and optimize end-to-end API integration delivery frameworks that enable ecosystem growth and partner success
  • Think strategically about integration scoping and solution design, understanding API architecture and technical trade-offs
  • Build scalable processes, governance and tooling that improve API integration predictability and reduce time-to-value
  • Create visibility and reporting frameworks that connect integration delivery to business health and growth metrics
  • Identify patterns, bottlenecks and opportunities to systematically improve how we deliver API-based partner integrations
  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment across internal teams and external partners through strong stakeholder management
  • Establish best practices and templates that enable consistent, high-quality API integration delivery as the partner network scales
  • Proven experience leading API integration delivery on large-scale projects with focus on process design and scalability
  • Solid understanding of how APIs work with ability to engage credibly in technical conversations about integration architecture
  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design frameworks, identify patterns and solve for scale
  • Growth-oriented mindset with understanding of how delivery excellence drives ecosystem expansion and partner value
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination across technical and commercial teams
  • Comfortable operating in high ambiguity environments, bringing structure and strategic thinking to complex problems

Desirable but not required

  • Experience scaling integration or partnership functions.
  • Familiarity with API-enabled products or platform ecosystems.
  • Domain knowledge in identity, verification or credentialling.
  • Experience in marketplaces, SaaS or B2B technology.
  • Exposure to release management or implementation governance.
  • Experience in start-ups, scale-ups or newly created functions.

At SEEK, we are passionate about fostering a culture of inclusion and wellbeing that embraces and values the diversity of our people. We are a purpose driven business that works with heart.

We know teams with diverse ideas, experiences and perspectives are more creative and are critical to ensuring effective delivery and innovating to enable our future success. As such, we welcome applications from people with a diverse group of backgrounds and life experiences, especially as they relate to gender, sexual identity, culture, faith, disability and life stages. title: Sponsor Donor Processing Associate II
description:
The expected salary range for this position is $19.37 - $22.76. Employees in specific high cost of labor locations in the United States (such as San Francisco, CA and Seattle, WA) may qualify for a geographic differential. Compassion International is not responsible for third parties who omit this information when copying and re-posting job openings.

Please note: This is a full-time role that works onsite at our Global Ministry Center in Colorado Springs, CO. Preference will be given to candidates who are local to the Greater Colorado Springs area.

Overview

IMPORTANT – PLEASE NOTE: The first (approximately) six to nine weeks will consist of all-day training onsite at our Global Ministry Center to ensure team members are fully equipped when taking live calls, chat and email to and from sponsors and donors, and will include on-the-job training. To be considered for this position, you must be available to attend every day of in-person training beginning Monday, November 2.

Once training is completed and on-the-job training begins, your regular 8-hour shift will be between the hours of 7:00am to 5:45pm MT, Monday through Friday. Due to the nature of this work, this is a full-time role working onsite at our Global Ministry Center in Colorado Springs, CO. Preference will be given to candidates who are local to the Greater Colorado Springs area.

As a Sponsor Donor Processing Associate, you will play a critical role in how Compassion cares for its supporters. You will respond to and resolve sponsor and donor inquiries, providing information, communication, and service within a contact center environment. This role involves processing donations, managing cases, handling exceptions, and updating accounts and commitments received through various channels – including inbound phone, mail, email, chat, and case submissions.

On occasion, you will also initiate outbound communication with sponsors and donors to clarify financial transactions, account details, donation methods and designations, and commitment information. These interactions typically follow automated workflows and exception resolution procedures.

In addition, you will maintain accurate financial records and sponsor/child relationships within accounts. This includes allocating donations and commitments to the appropriate funds, reconciling donations, and preparing daily bank transaction transmissions as needed.

Beyond transactional responsibilities, you will educate sponsors about Compassion’s child development programs, fostering sponsor satisfaction and loyalty. You will be expected to deliver exceptional service to both internal and external contacts, handling sensitive child-related information with care and discretion.

What will you do?

  • Maintain a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Be a consistent witness for Jesus Christ, maintaining a courteous, Christ-like attitude in dealing with people within and outside of Compassion, and faithfully uphold Compassion’s ministry in prayer.

  • Act as an advocate to raise the awareness of the needs of children. Understand Christ’s mandate to protect children. Commit to and prioritizes child protection considerations in all decision-making, tasks and activities across the ministry. Abide by all behavioral expectations in Compassion’s Statement of Commitment to Child Protection and Code of Conduct. Report any concerns of abuse, neglect or exploitation of children through Compassion’s internal reporting process and appropriately support responses to incidents if they occur.

  • Uphold and engage in Compassion’s core Cultural Behaviors.

  • Receive training to ensure competence for all Associate Level II tasks and functions, as well as specialized financial transactions and resolution, detailed customer account maintenance, and specialty account processing. Provide back up and support on a regular basis.

  • Receive and/or respond to contacts, verbally and/or in written form (as applicable) from sponsors, fielding questions regarding numerous areas related to Compassion, sponsor accounts, country/child information, general information, and/or other ministry related information.

  • Initiate and maintain a high volume of regular sponsor accounts. Research and resolve account problems, escalating to senior associates when needed. Determine best pairings for sponsor-requested product and commitment levels, link sponsor to children and products in computer system.

  • Research and resolve journal entry errors or problems from personal contributions.

  • Work within the automated workflow system to allocate sponsor/donor monies to the appropriate funds or accounts, and maintain the sponsor/child relationship. Apply appropriate coding procedures for allocation of funds to sponsor account, sponsorship and/or commitment.

  • Maintain assigned accounts and process exception transactions that require additional research than regular transactions.

  • Provide sponsors with excellent service that builds loyalty to Compassion and the overall mission of the ministry. Resolve sponsor problems, answering questions accurately while adhering to published guidelines. Follow protocol to offer options for an on-going relationship with Compassion and reinforce sponsor commitment to the ministry.

  • Communicating in a way that reflects and supports Compassion’s mission, values, vision and strategy. Responsible for achieving individual performance and attendance metrics and contributes to overall service targets.

  • As directed, participate in available training and coaching opportunities to expand knowledge and abilities related to this role.

What do you bring?

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Proficient typing and computer skills

  • High level of organization and attention to detail

  • A love for Compassion’s mission and a heart to serve others

  • Data entry and/or customer service skills; ideally 1-2 years of experience in a customer service environment is strongly preferred

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish (speaking and writing) is a plus

Why should you apply?

Being a part of the Kingdom work happening here at Compassion is truly an exciting honor. Our team is comprised of business-minded Christ Followers who have a passion for child advocacy, are 100% here for one another, and work together knowing we are all parts of one body in Christ.

One of the most amazing aspects of working for Compassion is the investment we make in our team members, both spiritually and professionally! If you are chosen for this position, you can expect to participate in things like weekly team huddles, monthly team meetings, monthly chapel, and even prayer groups! We are so blessed to support our mission of releasing children from poverty in Jesus’ name! We hope you will join us in this mission and allow God to work in and through your life!

Why work here?

  • The mission: Join a team that is motivated to release children from poverty in Jesus’ name.

  • Our benefits: Receive generous paid time off, 10% contribution to a 403(b) retirement fund on top of your salary, excellent healthcare coverage, free short-term professional counseling, and more.

  • Spiritual growth: Participate in regular chapel services, prayer groups, and department devotionals.

title: Director, Data Governance, Quality and Enablement
description:
Madrigal is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering novel therapeutics for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a serious liver disease that can progress to cirrhosis, liver failure, need for liver transplantation and premature mortality. Every member of our Madrigal team is connected by our shared purpose: leading the fight against MASH.

Madrigal’s medication, Rezdiffra (resmetirom), is a once-daily, oral, liver-directed THR-β agonist designed to target key underlying causes of MASH. Rezdiffra is the first and only medication approved by both the FDA and European Commission for the treatment of MASH with moderate to advanced fibrosis (F2 to F3). An ongoing Phase 3 outcomes trial is evaluating Rezdiffra for the treatment of compensated MASH cirrhosis (F4c).

Our success is driven by our people. We are building a dynamic, inclusive, and high-performing culture that values scientific excellence, operational rigor, and collaboration. To support our continued growth, we are strengthening our workforce strategy to ensure we have the right talent, at the right time, in the right way.

The Director, Data Governance, Quality & Enablement will lead the development and execution of capabilities that ensure enterprise data is trusted, compliant, high-quality, discoverable, and accessible across the organization. This role will lead the implementation of data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, cataloging, data product controls, and data enablement capabilities across the enterprise data ecosystem.
The Director will partner closely with Data Engineering & Platform, Data Products & Analytics, Enterprise Integration, IT Security, Privacy, IT Compliance, and business Data Owners and Stewards to embed governance and quality directly into data pipelines and data products.
The role will enable trusted data consumption across analytics, operational integrations, automation, and AI use cases, while ensuring appropriate controls and standards are consistently applied across the enterprise data lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Technology & Operating Model

  • Develop and execute the IT data governance roadmap in alignment with enterprise data strategy and business priorities.
  • Establish technical governance standards and controls across the enterprise data platform.
  • Implement scalable governance capabilities for data classification, ownership, metadata, lineage, quality, access, and lifecycle management.
  • Partner with business functions to operationalize Data Owner and Data Steward responsibilities.
  • Translate enterprise policies, regulatory requirements, and business expectations into practical technology standards and controls.
  • Establish governance processes that enable rapid delivery while maintaining appropriate controls.

Data Quality & Observability

  • Establish the enterprise technology framework for data quality and data observability.
  • Define reusable patterns for profiling, validation, monitoring, reconciliation, and exception management.
  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to embed automated quality controls directly into pipelines.
  • Establish quality gates across ingestion, transformation, and data-product publication.
  • Implement monitoring and scorecards for critical data products and Critical Data Elements.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and remediation of systemic data-quality issues.
  • Establish measurable data-product health and reliability standards.

Metadata, Catalog & Lineage

  • Lead implementation and adoption of enterprise metadata, catalog, and lineage capabilities.
  • Establish technical metadata standards across pipelines, lakehouses, semantic models, integrations, and data products.
  • Enable automated lineage from source systems through transformation to downstream consumption.
  • Partner with business Data Stewards to connect technical metadata with business definitions and context.
  • Improve enterprise data discovery and reuse through searchable, governed data catalogs.

Governed Data Products

  • Establish the technical standards required for a data asset to become a certified enterprise data product.
  • Define minimum requirements for ownership, metadata, lineage, quality, security classification, documentation, SLAs, and lifecycle management.
  • Partners with Data Engineering and Data Products & Analytics teams to embed these requirements into development processes.
  • Establish automated certification and quality controls wherever practical.
  • Promote reuse of trusted enterprise data products rather than creation of duplicate datasets and pipelines.

Data Enablement & Self-Service

  • Establish technology-focused data enablement programs supporting responsible self-service.
  • Develop standards, templates, documentation, playbooks, and reusable patterns.
  • Partner with Data Products & Analytics to establish governed self-service analytics practices.
  • Build communities of practice and enablement programs for data and analytics practitioners.
  • Improve adoption and reuse of certified enterprise data assets.
  • Enable users to find and understand available enterprise data without depending on IT for every request.

Compliance & Technology Controls

  • Partner with IT Security, IT Compliance, Privacy, Legal, and Quality functions to translate enterprise requirements into data-platform controls.
  • Ensure appropriate data classification, access, retention, lineage, auditability, and usage controls are implemented across enterprise data capabilities.
  • Support evidence collection and technology controls required for internal and external audits.
  • Ensure data solutions follow applicable company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to ensure controls are scalable

AI-Ready Data Foundation

  • Establish data standards necessary to support trusted consumption by AI and advanced analytics solutions.
  • Ensure data products intended for AI consumption have appropriate quality, metadata, lineage, ownership, security, and business context.
  • Partner with AI teams to establish governed access patterns to enterprise data
  • Ensure AI solutions consume trusted enterprise data products.

Leadership Expectations

  • Own the multi-year Data Governance, Quality & Enablement technology roadmap.
  • Build and mature the governance capability within Global Data Platform & Analytics.
  • Lead employees, contractors, strategic partners and technology vendors as appropriate.
  • Drive automation of governance and quality controls.
  • Establish measurable standards and KPIs.
  • Communicate data trust, risk and maturity to senior IT and business leadership.
  • Balance speed, scalability, compliance and control.

Required & Desired Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data governance, enterprise data management, data quality, or related disciplines, including 5+ years in leadership roles building or scaling enterprise data governance capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and operationalizing enterprise or federated data governance frameworks, including data ownership, stewardship, policies, standards, decision rights, and governance operating models.
  • Strong knowledge of data quality, metadata management, data cataloging, lineage, master and reference data, data classification, data products, and semantic models, with experience embedding governance and quality controls into modern data platforms and engineering processes.
  • Strong understanding of data governance and control frameworks and industry standards, such as DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM, NIST, or comparable frameworks, with the ability to translate standards into pragmatic, scalable enterprise practices.
  • Experience supporting data environments subject to SOX and financial reporting controls, including an understanding of data lineage, access controls, change management, data integrity, auditability, and evidence requirements relevant to financial reporting.
  • Experience operating within highly regulated environments, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences experience strongly preferred. Working knowledge of GxP principles, data integrity expectations, and regulated data practices is highly desirable.
  • Understanding applicable privacy, security, records retention, and data protection requirements, with demonstrated experience partnering with IT Security, Privacy, IT Compliance, Internal Audit, Finance, and other control functions.
  • 5+ years of experience owning and administering enterprise data catalog and governance platforms, with proficiency in Alation or comparable technologies (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Informatica), including data cataloging, metadata management, lineage, stewardship workflows, data discovery, and access governance.
  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms, data governance, and analytics technologies. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Purview, Alation, Power BI, Azure, or comparable technologies is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish governance by design, integrating data quality, metadata, lineage, security, compliance, and other controls into data pipelines and data products without unnecessarily slowing business delivery.
  • Proven ability to influence senior business and technology leaders across organizational boundaries, establish accountability, and drive adoption of enterprise standards in a federated operating environment.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, change leadership, and organizational transformation skills, with the ability to translate complex data and regulatory concepts into clear business outcomes.
  • Experience working in Agile environments with JIRA and Confluence for project planning, sprint execution, and documentation.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to influence technical and business teams and drive strategic outcomes.

description:
Univision is seeking a talented motion graphic designer based in Miami, proficient in Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects, detail-oriented, and strong communication skills. This individual will be a major contributor to the News Special Projects. Must be a true team-player, with an emphasis on quality and timeliness. This role performs a wide range of duties with a unique blend of design, animation, and client communication. Candidate most work well under pressure.

The successful candidate will be a strategic and creative thinker, a self-starter, and a collaborator, willing to learn and share ideas, to generate original content for the needs of the news division.

Most be flexible on the schedule, be willing to work nights and weekends as well as holidays. And be willing to report for duty on Breaking News coverages.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Service the needs for News Projects as assigned.
  • Ensure Projects are completed with high quality and delivered on schedule.
  • Effectively communicate concepts and ideas to the Manager and production team.
  • Collaborate with team members.
  • Work closely with producers, directors and graphics designers to incorporate design assets into motion graphics.
  • Manage multiple projects within design specifications and budget restrictions.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Minimum 2+ years of professional experience in the field of motion graphic design.
  • Expert proficiency using industry software applications, Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator and Cinema 4d.
  • Good time management skills with the ability to organize, prioritize and complete tasks in a timely manner.
  • Detail oriented, with ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with extremely tight deadlines.
  • Must have a current and evolving sense of design with an excellent eye for detail.
  • Creative problem solver with a positive attitude.
  • Must be able to juggle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication skills are crucial.
  • Compelling portfolio of work over a wide range of creative projects.
  • Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment for multiple key stakeholders
  • Willingness to take feedback/criticism and improve upon skills.
  • Fluent in Spanish (read and write)

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

In collaboration with the Program Director, the program administrator is responsible for the accreditation, non-clinical operation and financial management of the Graduate Medical Education program. Requires a comprehensive and detailed understanding of national accreditation policies and organizational policies, as well as a high degree of initiative and independent judgment. Continually assesses and directs a wide range of programmatic planning solutions to include short and long range planning goals, recruitment, orientation, accreditation and assigned projects. The program administrator is an active member of the residency/fellowship leadership team, therefore, ultimately responsible for residents/fellows within the program.

Job Duties:

  • Partners with other members of leadership to ensure continued program accreditation
  • Responsible for the continued oversight of accreditation, site visit preparation and execution
