title: Staff Interaction Designer
description:
Interaction Design is a key role at Intuitive, spanning multiple technical disciplines to craft user-friendly experiences for complex medical devices. We bring human-centered design to healthcare innovation and to the development of safe, effective, and confidence-inspiring robotic interfaces.

As a Staff Interaction Designer (IxD) for da Vinci Multiport Systems, your role will be pivotal in designing seamless and intuitive experiences that unify physical interactions with connected digital platforms. This role is central to ensuring every interaction across all da Vinci Multiport Systems and digital touchpoints enhances users’ lives, offering consumer-grade simplicity, speed, and clarity.

You will lead workshops and collaborate closely with product managers, clinical development engineers, front-end and back-end developers, and the broader UX design team to not only assemble existing elements into cohesive experiences but also innovate entirely new interaction paradigms. This role demands high emotional intelligence (EQ) and analytical intelligence (IQ), requiring both meticulous pixel-level attention and strategic business design thinking. You must clearly articulate the user experience vision through detailed roadmaps and compelling conceptual NorthStar's, rallying cross-functional teams around shared goals and executing the design vision effectively.

This full-time on-site position is based in our Sunnyvale, CA office.

What You'll Bring

  • You are a human-centered designer motivated by the opportunity to improve the life of patients and tackle novel challenges in healthcare.
  • You thrive in highly technical domains, enjoying abstract and often unfamiliar design problems.
  • You are comfortable with translating highly complex user challenges into clear, frictionless interaction models that make complex tasks feel effortless.
  • You are methodical and drive design decisions through insights and iteration.
  • You value design craftsmanship, recognize quality, and expect high standards.
  • You believe in collaboration, knowing that success hinges on working closely with other designers and cross-functional partners.
  • You are emotionally intelligent and have excellent listening, communication and analytical skills that help you to adapt in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design for complex workflows of core interactions across the platform, including voice/conversational interfaces, authentication flows, and user profile systems, translating nuanced user needs into intuitive, scalable experiences.
  • Drive a cohesive design vision for da Vinci Systems, aligning cross-functional teams around a unified, end-to-end user experience that delivers the simplicity and fluidity of consumer products in a high-stakes surgical environment.
  • Conduct user research & Insights to deeply understand the needs, behaviors, and pain points of target users. Develop detailed user personas and scenarios to inform interaction design strategies and solutions.
  • Contribute to design documentation and testing, writing clear, comprehensive and detailed user interface specifications for others to build and test against. Consider potential safety and usability risks together with our Human Factors Engineers and design necessary mitigations.
  • Minimum of 8-10 years in design or UX-focused roles, with substantial experience leading interaction design strategies for complex products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Product Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Expertise in physical or embedded interaction design (beyond web or mobile app interfaces)
  • Experience designing for voice/conversational interface, authentication systems, and/or user profile management.
  • Demonstrated expertise across the full design lifecycle, from concept generation and experience definition to detailed interaction design, prototyping, and final implementation.
  • Proven experience conducting impactful workshops and driving cross-functional alignment on UX strategies, priorities and designs.
  • Demonstrated ability to deeply engage with technical teams, driving clear planning, communication and collaboration across front-end, back-end, and hardware engineering disciplines.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively present to senior management.
  • Demonstrated success bringing products with complex user interactions to market.

Portfolio required for application.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

title: Senior Insights Architect - Analytics and AI
description:
Primary Function of Position

We are seeking an experienced Senior Insights Architect for Analytics and AI Solutions to lead the design and implementation of our advanced analytics, data product architecture and collaborate during development of AI solutions, while also playing a key role in integrating these capabilities into our business processes. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in developing analytics, evaluating AI solutions using Engineering and Supply Chain Data, hands-on experience collaborating during building and deploying AI/ML models and GenAI-powered solutions, and experience leading the technical design and development of complex data products. They will have a deep understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, and visualization techniques as well as modern AI frameworks and large language model (LLM) integration patterns and will be able to effectively translate business requirements into scalable and performant technical solution requirements. This role requires a strong ability to influence and collaborate across teams, even without direct authority, to ensure successful implementation and adoption of analytics and AI solutions.

Essential Job Duties

  • Work closely with business stakeholders across Process, Design and Supplier Engineering functions to understand their analytics needs and translate them into scalable and performant technical solutions, including requirements for AI-driven insights and automation opportunities.

  • Lead the design and development of complex analytics and data products that address Engineering challenges and opportunities, including predictive models, anomaly detection systems, and GenAI-powered tools, and drive their integration into key Engineering processes in partnership with process owners.

  • Evaluate, prototype, and recommend AI/ML approaches (supervised, unsupervised, and generative) to solve Engineering business problems.

  • Manage the roadmap for analytics and data products, including AI/ML initiatives, aligning with Engineering strategic objectives, while effectively balancing competing requirements in a dynamic Engineering environment.

  • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, ML engineers, and product engineers to ensure seamless integration and deployment of analytics and AI solutions.

  • Ensure data quality, security, and governance across all analytics solutions, including responsible AI practices such as model explainability, bias detection, and compliance.

  • Build strong relationships and influence stakeholders across the organization, particularly within Engineering functions, to gain buy-in and support for analytics and AI initiatives, and champion the adoption of AI tools and platforms to improve team productivity and decision-making.

  • Stay up to date on the latest technologies and trends in data, analytics, and artificial intelligence, particularly as they relate to Engineering management.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience developing analytics solutions using Snowflake, Tableau, BOXI or similar tools using Engineering data.

  • Hands-on experience with BOXI is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated experience building, collaborating in the deployment, and maintaining ML models and/or GenAI applications in a production environment.

  • Experience collaborating with team working on large language models (LLMs) and prompt engineering, including integration of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, etc.) into data products.

  • Functional understanding and data flows of Engineering systems and processes.

  • Effectively communicate technical concepts — including AI model outputs and limitations — to non-technical audiences to foster understanding, influence, and build consensus across teams.

  • A very good team player with demonstrated ability to manage and influence without direct authority.

  • Strong understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, and visualization techniques.

  • Profound SQL knowledge and experience, including writing complex queries and optimization.

  • Experience leading the technical design and development of complex data products.

  • Previous experience integrating advanced analytics and AI solutions into business processes.

Required Education and Training

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, or a related field.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Strong statistical background and analytical skills.
  • Experience working with a leading Manufacturing organization in a regulated environment.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision applications.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and responsible AI principles.

Job Description

About the role:
The Associate Director - Process Analytics Lead is responsible for leading process analytics method development and platform implementation across multiple programs and product types within Analytical Development. In this role, you will shape high-throughput, fit-for-purpose analytical methods, support automation and robotics, and help build standardized ways of working that improve productivity, data integrity, and execution consistency. You will partner with Process Development, Quality, Compliance, Digital, Information Technology, and external vendors to align priorities, support delivery, and build scalable capabilities.

How you will contribute:

  • Lead the development, optimization, and sustainment of high-throughput analytical methods for process and product development across small molecule and biologic programs, using phase-appropriate approaches and analytical quality by design principles.

  • Define standards, performance measures, and governance for method lifecycle management within your area of responsibility.

  • Ensure successful transfer, training, and implementation of developed methods into process development laboratories, including clear documentation, troubleshooting plans, and ongoing support for consistent non-good manufacturing practice platforms.

  • Work with the Process Analytical Development team to deliver the platform roadmap, including automated analytical methods and end-to-end workflows with robotics where appropriate.

  • Support vendor selection and vendor management for automation and analytical platforms, and help drive cross-site standardization.

  • Modernize laboratory operations, including sample and data management, instrument connectivity, workflow standardization, and data traceability.

  • Provide technical and people leadership to the Process Analytics Development capability area through planning, prioritization, coaching, and change adoption.

  • Lead cross-functional workstreams, resolve dependencies, and represent Analytical Development organization in governance and collaboration forums.


What you bring to Takeda:

  • Typically 8 to 12 or more years of relevant industry or laboratory experience in analytical development or process analytics, with demonstrated delivery of high-throughput methods and or automation and process analytical technology implementations.

  • Degree in a relevant scientific or engineering field such as Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or Chemical Engineering; bachelor’s, master’s, or doctorate accepted, with level and scope calibrated to degree and experience.

  • Proven experience designing and scaling automation solutions across workflows, teams, and or sites, with measurable performance outcomes.

  • Demonstrated experience deploying robotics-enabled high-throughput analytical workflows, including method transfer and validation considerations, assay robustness, and operational use in a research and development laboratory environment.

  • Strong experience with analytical development strategy, standards, and governance, including analytical quality by design (AQbD) method frameworks and performance measures.

  • Demonstrated ability to bridge high-throughput methods to GMP release and stability methods in partnership with Quality and Process Development teams.

  • Demonstrated people and matrix leadership experience, including mentoring, coaching, prioritization across multiple programs, and influence with senior stakeholders; direct people management experience is preferred.

  • Strong ability to partner with and influence senior scientific stakeholders, translating scientific needs into scalable automation and operating model solutions.

  • Fluent in English; fluent in Japanese is a plus.

  • Experience operating in regulated environments with automation, process analytical technology, and inspection readiness expectations is desirable.

  • Familiarity with automation and artificial intelligence-assisted knowledge work within appropriate compliance constraints is desirable.

description:
Job Description:

Your impact

Are you looking for an exciting and challenging opportunity to lead a skilled team in a time of significant growth in an AESA Radar sector, based in either our Edinburgh or Newcastle offices?

Leonardo is a global leader in defence electronics and delivers mission-critical systems for situational awareness, electronic warfare and surveillance across land, sea and air. The Radar and Advanced Targeting line of business, based across Edinburgh and Newcastle, is uniquely positioned as one of the world's top manufacturers of radars, lasers and infrared countermeasure systems with a rich heritage in engineering, with 100 years of pioneering development. The Secretary of State for Defence announced the UK European Common Radar System (ECRS) Mk2 production contract during a visit to Leonardo Edinburgh in January 2026. We have an exciting opportunity to join the ECRS Mk2 programme at an early stage of its lifecycle. Based in either Edinburgh or Newcastle, you will have the opportunity to influence the successful delivery of equipment to the end user.

We are seeking a Project Engineering Lead (PEL) to lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team responsible for maturing cutting-edge PCB/PCA designs in the supply chain supporting the ECRS Mk2 Programme. Reporting directly to the Project Engineering Manager, this role will provide technical and operational leadership across Leonardo and strategic suppliers to improve manufacturing capability, yield, quality, throughput and production readiness.

As the PEL for the Supply Chain Improvement Team you will :

  • Lead the ECRS Mk2 Supply Chain Improvement Team, providing direction, prioritisation and governance across supplier improvement, manufacturing maturity and industrialisation activities.

  • Establish and deliver a strategy for improving supplier quality, yield, throughput, lead time and production readiness.

  • Act as the primary engineering interface between Leonardo, strategic suppliers and internal stakeholders advising of improvements to design to aid manufacturing quality, schedule & cost

  • Drive root cause investigations and robust corrective and preventive actions.

  • Lead regular supplier performance reviews focused on yield, quality, capacity and schedule adherence.

  • Conduct supplier assessments, technical reviews and manufacturing readiness evaluations.

  • Provide engineering leadership for manufacturing non-conformities and quality issues.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality and Programme teams.

  • Drive Design for Manufacture (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA) and industrialisation best practice.

  • Provide regular updates to the Project Engineering Manager, Chief Engineer, Programme Leadership Team and Head of Programmes.

What you’ll bring

  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Manufacturing, Electronics, Physics or equivalent technical discipline.

  • Experience of leading engineering teams or complex manufacturing, industrialization, NPI or supply chain work packages.

  • Experience working with suppliers to improve quality, delivery and manufacturing capability.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality systems and continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Ability to identify root causes and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.

  • Experience leading supplier reviews, audits or performance improvement activities.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Self-motivated with the ability to provide structure, focus and momentum within a challenging delivery environment.

Project Title
Semiconductor Manufacturing Variability Reduction Using Advanced Data Analytics

Project Description
This project provides the intern with an opportunity to learn how advanced data analytics can be applied to reduce process variability and reject rates in semiconductor manufacturing.

The intern will analyze inline signals, process parameters, and test results to identify patterns associated with Assembly and Test issues. The project will provide practical exposure to semiconductor packaging processes, yield analysis, statistical methods, Artificial Intelligence, and cross-functional engineering collaboration.

Objective of the Project
The objective is to develop data-driven insights and analytical methods that:

  • Identify potential sources of manufacturing variability and yield loss.

  • Improve the analysis of inline signals, process data, and test results.

  • Detect relationships between process conditions and product rejects.

  • Recommend opportunities for improving process stability and manufacturing quality.

  • Explore AI-Enabled methods that enhance analytical efficiency and effectiveness.

Project Scope
The intern will be given the opportunity to:

  • Learn semiconductor packaging, Assembly and Test processes, and common sources of process variability and yield loss.

  • Analyze inline signals, process parameters, manufacturing data, and test results using Python, Structured Query Language, or equivalent analytical tools.

  • Apply statistical and data analytics techniques to identify patterns, correlations, and potential contributors to reject rates.

  • Explore AI-Enabled tools and analytical methods to improve the efficiency, quality, and effectiveness of the project analysis.

  • Document findings and present data-driven recommendations to engineering stakeholders.

Learning Opportunities

  • The intern will have the opportunity to:

  • Gain practical exposure to semiconductor packaging and high-volume manufacturing.

  • Learn how manufacturing variability and yield loss are investigated using process and test data.

  • Apply programming, statistical analysis, visualization, and structured problem-solving techniques.

  • Develop responsible proficiency in AI-Enabled tools and workflows in accordance with organizational standards.

  • Strengthen technical documentation, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Deliverables
The intern is expected to deliver:

  • A structured analysis of relevant inline signals, process parameters, and test results.

  • Identification of key patterns and potential contributors associated with process variability and reject rates.

  • Data visualizations or analytical models that communicate findings clearly.

  • Documented recommendations and proposed next steps for engineering evaluation.

  • A final technical report and presentation covering the methodology, findings, limitations, and recommendations.

Impact of the Project
The project is intended to:

  • Improve visibility into manufacturing variability and sources of yield loss.

  • Enable more effective analysis of Assembly and Test issues.

  • Provide data-driven insights for process stability and quality improvement.

  • Strengthen the use of advanced analytics and AI-Enabled workflows in semiconductor manufacturing.

  • Establish reusable analytical methods for future variability-reduction projects.

Skillsets Required
The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Programming knowledge in Python, Structured Query Language, or equivalent analytical tools.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, systems-thinking, and critical-thinking capabilities.

  • Familiarity with statistics, data analysis, visualization, or AI-Enabled workflows.

  • The ability to learn quickly, investigate technical topics, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong self-motivation, outcome orientation, interpersonal communication, and technical documentation skills.

Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field, or have equivalent experience.

Duration of Period
The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of 5 months.

title: Lead Test Data Management Engineer
description:
Description

The Lead Test Data Management Engineer is responsible for translating Huntington's Test Data Management (TDM) strategy into operational capabilities. This role serves as the bridge between architecture, engineering, governance, and delivery teams, driving the design, implementation, and adoption of enterprise test data capabilities that reduce reliance on production data in lower environments.


The position combines technical leadership, solution design, and hands-on engineering expertise to establish repeatable test data services, accelerate pilot delivery, and create the foundation for a scalable Test Data Management capability.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 5+ years of related experience or an additional 4 years of related work experience may be considered in lieu of the Bachelor's Degree

Platform & Capability Leadership

  • Partner in defining the TDM roadmap and engineering priorities while providing technical leadership for implementation.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate production data usage in non-production environments.
  • Provide analysis and recommendations for build-vs-buy evaluations, technology tradeoffs, and implementation decisions.

Engineering & Solution Delivery

  • Design and implement synthetic data generation and test data provisioning solutions.
  • Build reusable automation, data pipelines, engineering patterns, and accelerators.
  • Integrate TDM capabilities with testing, quality engineering, and CI/CD processes.
  • Partner with application teams to onboard use cases and validate solutions.
  • Evaluate and implement tooling to improve test data quality, availability, and efficiency.
  • Maintain deep technical expertise in TDM tools, synthetic data technologies, and supporting platforms.

Test Data Lifecycle Management

  • Define and operationalize end-to-end test data lifecycle processes.
  • Establish repeatable provisioning, refresh, archival, and retirement patterns.
  • Define service models for requesting, generating, delivering, and maintaining test data.

Data Quality, Reuse & Governance

  • Establish reusable synthetic data patterns and data asset libraries.
  • Develop standards for referential integrity and realistic test data creation.
  • Define validation approaches to ensure synthetic data is fit for purpose.
  • Measure and report progress toward reducing or eliminating production data usage.

Adoption & Organizational Enablement

  • Support onboarding, training, and adoption activities across technology teams.
  • Monitor emerging industry trends and recommend improvements to Huntington's TDM capabilities.
  • Establish reusable engineering patterns and operational processes that support future scalability.

Additional Experience

  • Experience designing and implementing technology or data solutions.
  • Experience with databases, APIs, data pipelines, automation frameworks, and software delivery practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation, masking, tokenization, virtualization, or privacy-preserving data techniques.
  • Experience implementing automated test data provisioning solutions.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery models, DevOps practices, and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing technology platforms and vendor solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, risk management, compliance, and information security principles.
  • Experience supporting large-scale application development and testing environments.
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution.

Som extraanställd på Effektiv kommer du att ingå i vår arbetspool, vilket innebär att du kommer få möjlighet att testa varierande arbetsuppgifter på olika arbetsplatser inom industri och lager. Vem är du?

För att trivas i denna roll tror vi att du som söker är flexibel och gilla att arbeta med kroppen. Du har en positiv inställning, god arbetsmoral och gillar att lära dig nya saker. Vidare förstår du att du representerar Effektiv när du arbetar, och gör ditt bästa på jobbet.

I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt på personliga egenskaper, då vi tror att man klarar sig långt med rätt inställning.

För att vara aktuell för tjänsten behöver du: - Studera eller ha en annan sysselsättning om minst 50%. - Tala och förstå det svenska språket.

Det är meriterande om du har: - B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil (för att kunna ta sig till fler arbetsplatser) - Erfarenhet inom industri och lager - Truckkort

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan

Låter tjänsten intressant?

Välkommen med din ansökan via effektiv.se. Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. Vill du veta mer om tjänsten kontakta gärna Christoffer på christoffer@effektiv.se

Om Team Effktiv

Effektiv är det innovativa och personliga företaget inom rekrytering, bemanning, coaching, matchning & interim. Idrottsrötterna och lagandan präglar bolaget, dels arbetar vi i team i våra bemannings- och rekryteringsprocesser, dels är sponsring till idrottsföreningar en betydande del.

Vi har en sportslig attityd mot våra konsulter och erbjuder schyssta villkor samt kollektivavtal. Vi vill ge de bästa förutsättningarna till dig som blir en del av Team Effektiv. För den här tjänsten kommer du att vara anställd via Effektiv och uthyrd som konsult till kundföretaget under en tidsbegränsad period.

title: Personlig assistent sökes till aktiv och härlig 13-årig tjej i Stockholm! -
company: ASSISTANS I BALANS I SVERIGE AB
description:
Om mig: Jag är en skön, rolig och aktiv tjej på 13 år som älskar fart och äventyr! Jag bor på södra sidan av Stockholm, men jag hänger också ofta inne i stan där det händer lite mer. Jag gillar att vara i rörelse och uppleva nya saker - livet ska vara roligt! Jag har en trakeostomi (”trach”) och behöver därför ha dubbelassistans dygnet runt. För mig är det viktigt att allt fungerar smidigt så att jag kan fokusera på att leva mitt liv - på mitt sätt. Som min assistent behöver du därför ha lätt för att samarbeta med både mig och mina andra assistenter. Jag vill att du är lyhörd och på tå, men också veta när du ska ta ett steg tillbaka och låta mig ha mitt eget utrymme. Arbetsplatsen är där jag är - det kan vara hemma, ute på stan, i skolan, hos kompisar eller på utflykter. Om du kan teckenspråk är det ett stort plus, men det är inget krav.

Om dig:

Är du en omtänksam, trygg och flexibel kvinna med god samarbetsförmåga? Då kan du vara precis den jag söker! Jag vill att du är rökfri och har lätt för att anpassa dig till olika situationer. Du behöver vara närvarande och uppmärksam, men samtidigt förstå att du är där för att stötta mig i mitt liv - inte styra det. Det är viktigt att du fungerar bra i en större arbetsgrupp och kan hoppa in för kollegor när det behövs. Du kommer att arbeta både dag, kväll, vaken natt och helg enligt ett rullande schema, så du bör trivas med varierade arbetstider. Tjänsten: Tjänsten börjar som en timanställning så att vi får möjlighet att lära känna varandra. Därefter går det över till en Vikarieanställning på Ca 80% på ett rullande schema. Andra tider kan dock förekomma då det ingår i tjänsten att hoppa in extra vid akuta vakanser. Vikarietjänsten är mellan perioden 2026-08-14 till 2027-09-14 och kan leda till en fastanställning om behov finns. Låter det här som något för dig? Då hoppas jag att du vill bli en del av mitt team - så vi tillsammans kan göra vardagen både trygg, rolig och full av äventyr! För att anställas måste du uppvisa giltig ID-handling, eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige samt utdrag ur polisregistret. Detta beställs på www.polisen.se Välj det utdrag som heter Arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning Bemanning: Det ingår ett utökat (och arvoderat) bemanningsuppdrag i den här tjänsten som innebär att man vissa veckor måste vara anträffbar på annan tid än arbetstid, för att i situationer då ingripande krävs ringa in en vikarie eller själv hoppa in och assistera. Detta är Assistans i Balans sätt att säkerställa att våra uppdragsgivare alltid har en välbekant assistent vid sin sida. Uppdraget delas av alla assistenter som arbetar efter ett regelbundet schema.

Om Assistans i Balans:

Assistans i Balans anordnar - med lång och egen erfarenhet - högkvalitativ personlig assistans till personer med omfattande funktionsnedsättning i enlighet med LSS och Independent Living-rörelsen. Vi vill bidra till en jämlikare värld där alla oavsett funktionsnedsättning ges en möjlighet att leva ett självständigt liv med självbestämmande och självrespekt i fokus. Vår service är nära, personlig och kontinuerlig och vår ambitionsnivå är hög. Alla medarbetare får grundlig introduktion, fortlöpande utbildning, ta del av vårt värderingsarbete, friskvårdsbidrag och trygghet genom kollektivavtal (Fremia - Kommunal).

Läs mer på www.assistansibalans.se

title: Executive | PPC
description:
The PPC Executive will be responsible for planning, scheduling, coordinating and monitoring production activities to ensure that customer orders are completed on time, as per required quality standards and with optimum utilization of manpower, machines and materials.

1. Production Planning

  • Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production plans based on confirmed orders and delivery requirements.
  • Review production drawings and order requirements before scheduling production.
  • Plan production activities across CNC cutting, edge banding, drilling, assembly and finishing.
  • Prioritize production orders based on delivery commitments, material availability and production capacity.
  • Monitor planned production against actual output and identify deviations.

2. Material Planning

  • Prepare and review Material Requirement Sheets (MRS) based on production requirements.
  • Coordinate with Purchase and Stores to ensure timely availability of required materials.
  • Identify material shortages in advance and highlight potential production delays.
  • Track material availability against planned production schedules.
  • Coordinate with relevant teams for material substitutions or urgent requirements when required.

3. Production Monitoring & Control

  • Track Plan vs. Actual production on a daily basis.
  • Monitor order-wise production status and pending quantities.
  • Identify bottlenecks, delays and capacity constraints affecting production.
  • Escalate production deviations and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Maintain accurate records of production schedules, pending orders and completion status.

4. Drawing & Cut-List Coordination

  • Review production drawings received from the Design team for completeness and production feasibility.
  • Coordinate with Designers to clarify technical issues before releasing jobs for production.
  • Prepare or coordinate cut-lists based on approved production drawings.
  • Ensure required production information is available before releasing orders to the shop floor.

5. Capacity & Resource Planning

  • Plan production based on available machine capacity, manpower and material availability.
  • Coordinate manpower and machine requirements with the Production team.
  • Identify capacity constraints and recommend changes to the production sequence.
  • Support efficient utilization of CNC and other production machinery.
  • Assist in balancing workloads across production processes.

6. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with:
    • Design
    • Purchase
    • Stores
    • Production
    • Quality
    • Dispatch
  • Conduct regular follow-ups on order status and production dependencies.
  • Ensure timely communication of changes in production priorities and delivery requirements.
  • Support smooth handover of production requirements from planning to the shop floor.

7. MIS & Reporting

  • Prepare daily and weekly PPC/MIS reports.
  • Track:
    • Production Plan vs. Actual
    • Order completion status
    • Material shortages
    • Production delays
    • Machine utilization
    • Pending production
    • Delivery commitments
  • Provide regular updates to the Production Manager and management.
  • Maintain accurate production planning data in Excel/ERP systems.

8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring production delays and planning gaps.
  • Suggest improvements in production sequencing, material planning and workflow.
  • Support initiatives to improve productivity, production efficiency and on-time delivery.
  • Maintain proper documentation and follow established production SOPs.


Requirements

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of Production Planning & Control (PPC).
  • Good knowledge of BOM, MRS, cut-lists and material planning.
  • Understanding of modular furniture/panel-based manufacturing processes.
  • Knowledge of CNC cutting, edge banding, drilling and assembly processes.
  • Ability to read and understand production drawings.
  • Strong working knowledge of MS Excel for planning and MIS reporting.
  • Experience with ERP/PPC systems is preferred.
  • Exposure to IMOS, Cabinet Vision, CutRite or similar manufacturing software will be an advantage.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree/Diploma in Mechanical, Industrial, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in PPC/Production Planning, preferably in modular furniture, cabinetry, interior manufacturing or a similar manufacturing environment.
  • Candidates with prior shop-floor production experience along with PPC experience will be preferred.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience and capability
  • Health insurance
  • Professional growth and development opportunities
  • Opportunity to work in a growing modular furniture manufacturing organization
  • Exposure to modern production planning and manufacturing processes

title: Clinical Trial Liaison, Director – East
location: Wilmington, Delaware, United States of America
description:
US Field Based

AstraZeneca is advancing the pace of Clinical Trial progress in the US as a critical enabler of Ambition 2030. The Regional Director, Clinical Trial Liaison Team will lead and manage a field-based Clinical Trial Liaison team responsible for strengthening scientific engagement with strategic clinical research sites, improving investigator understanding of AstraZeneca trials and pipeline, and helping reduce practical barriers to study start-up, screening, enrollment, referral, and retention.

This role blends Field Medical Affairs leadership with deep clinical trial partnership. The Regional Director will translate national Clinical Trial Liaison priorities into regional execution, aligning with BioPharmaceuticals Business Unit US Medical headquarters and field teams, Clinical Value and Outcomes, US Site Management and Monitoring, Clinical Operations, and other matrix partners to deliver coordinated site-facing engagement.

The Regional Director will coach and develop a regional Clinical Trial Liaison team that advances high-quality engagement across priority US research centers. The role is accountable for recommending priority site selection, and setting up a clear field plans consistent engagement expectations across US strategic research centers increasing the consistency, impact, and speed of site-facing medical support for new and ongoing clinical studies across AstraZeneca marketed products, new indications, and compounds in development, including priorities across Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolic; Respiratory, Immunology; and Vaccines and Infectious Disease.

The Regional Director is accountable for field performance, team health, and executional excellence across the assigned region. The leader will set expectations, coach to quality, assess capability needs, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, compliance, and urgency in support of US clinical trial acceleration.

The role will represent investigator, site, and referring-provider perspectives in Medical Affairs and clinical trial workstreams, ensuring that site-facing engagement remains aligned to trial priorities, regional realities, and the broader ambition to accelerate access to innovative medicines for patients.

Key Accountabilities

  • Team Leadership: Lead and coach a regional Clinical Trial Liaison team through clear goals, call plans, ride-alongs, timely feedback, onboarding, capability building, and talent development.

  • Drive Performance and Lead execution: Establish performance expectations, monitor execution against priorities, use metrics and field observations to identify gaps, and coach the team toward improved impact, engagement consistency, and accountability.

  • Manage Talent: Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain high-performing Clinical Trial Liaisons while fostering accountability, collaboration, and team health.

  • Strengthen CTL Site Engagement: Strengthen scientific engagement with clinical investigators, thought leaders, health care professionals, site staff, and referring physicians to improve understanding of trial protocols, study designs, pipeline assets, and study compounds.

  • Strong Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with US Site Management and Monitoring, Clinical Operations, headquarter and global medical teams, MSLs and Clinical Account Directors, and Medical Affairs partners to deliver coordinated site-facing engagement

  • Accelerate Insights to Action: Ensure field insights from investigators and research sites are captured with quality, shared rapidly with the appropriate national and headquarters partners, and translated into practical field actions.

  • Lead Change Adoption and Execution: Implement R&D initiatives, remove execution barriers, and reinforce ways of working through training and consistent field follow-up.

  • Resource and Compliance Management: Manage regional resources, travel, congress activity, and spend while ensuring adherence to AstraZeneca policies, Medical Affairs standards, and FDA requirements.

Essential Requirements

  • Advanced degree in a scientific or clinical discipline, such as MD, DO, PharmD, PhD, NP, or PA-C, or equivalent advanced health practitioner experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, Field Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or clinical trial research, with a portion of that experience leading teams or demonstrating strong leadership capability.

  • Strong experience with clinical research, study site logistics, investigator and site engagement, and collaboration with clinical operations partners.

  • Working knowledge of FDA compliance, regulatory requirements, Medical Affairs policies, and appropriate scientific exchange standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate national strategy into regional account coverage, field plans, and measurable execution priorities.

  • Established track record of effective and influential scientific communication, including oral presentations to health care professionals and internal stakeholders.

  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, written, project management, and change leadership skills.

  • Ability to synthesize field insights, identify execution barriers, and communicate recommended actions clearly across a matrix organization.

  • Ability to travel 30-40% of the time, with travel requirements varying by geography and business need.

Desirable Requirements

  • Doctorate in bio-sciences, pharmacology, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, or a related clinical or scientific field.

  • Previous line management experience in Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or Field Medical Affairs.

  • Three or more years of Medical Science Liaison experience.

  • Experience in pharmaceutical industry clinical or preclinical research, drug discovery, drug development, pipeline engagement, or key external expert interactions.

  • Experience working in an account-based setting with Commercial Account Directors and other internal matrix partners.

  • Experience with clinical trial site education, investigator engagement, feasibility input, patient recruitment initiatives, or trial-enrollment support.

  • Entrepreneurial, future-forward mindset with enthusiasm for coaching, change adoption, and advancing patient care.

Why AstraZeneca?

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

description:

Job Description:

YOUR IMPACT

Own your opportunity to work with the largest government agency in the nation. Make an impact by advancing the Department of War’s mission to keep our country safe and secure.

OUR COMPANY

Iron EagleX (IEX), a wholly owned subsidiary of General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), delivers agile IT and Intelligence solutions. Combining small-team flexibility with global scale, IEX leverages emerging technologies to provide innovative, user-focused solutions that empower organizations and end users to operate smarter, faster, and more securely in dynamic environments.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Iron EagleX is seeking a SME Cyber Network Analyst to join our fast-paced technical team. In this role, you will analyze, engineer, and troubleshoot complex network environments while supporting the integration and operationalization of advanced cyber capabilities. You will work at the intersection of traditional network engineering, systems administration, cyber analysis, and capability development using your understanding of network architectures, protocols, configurations, and infrastructure to characterize cyber outputs and translate them into actionable operational capabilities.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As a SME Cyber Network Analyst, you will use your understanding of network architectures, configurations, protocols, and systems to help teams understand, validate, and operationalize cyber-derived information and capabilities. Your work will include reconstructing and analyzing network environments, investigating complex network behavior, developing repeatable technical workflows, and collaborating with analysts, developers, and engineers to transform technical outputs into mission-relevant capabilities. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, work across a diverse range of network and systems technologies, expand your cyber and engineering expertise, and directly support missions where technical accuracy and operational effectiveness matter.

JOB DUTIES (INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO)

  • Conduct network surveys and technical assessments to identify, document, and characterize network architectures, configurations, systems, services, and communications pathways.

  • Build and maintain representative laboratory environments to reproduce network configurations, validate technical findings, evaluate cyber outputs, and support capability development and testing.

  • Analyze and map complex network environments, including network devices, hosts, services, routing relationships, protocols, access paths, and other infrastructure dependencies.

  • Analyze cyber-derived technical outputs and translate them into understandable network, system, and operational context for use by analysts and engineers.

  • Examine network configurations and communications pathways to identify relationships, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and potential operational access paths.

  • Perform packet, protocol, traffic, and configuration analysis to characterize network behavior and troubleshoot complex connectivity or interoperability issues.

  • Configure, administer, and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and other network infrastructure within operational and laboratory environments.

  • Develop Python scripts and other lightweight automation tools to support network analysis, data processing, environment configuration, monitoring, testing, and recurring administrative workflows.

  • Build, configure, and maintain Linux and Windows systems supporting network analysis and laboratory environments.

  • Deploy and administer virtualized environments using common hypervisor and virtualization technologies.

  • Develop technical documentation, diagrams, network maps, configuration references, and other artifacts that clearly communicate complex network architectures and technical findings.

  • Identify technical limitations, dependencies, and integration requirements associated with transitioning cyber-derived capabilities into operational environments.

  • Collaborate with analysts, software developers, systems engineers, and network engineers to investigate technical problems and develop solutions supporting advanced operational requirements.

  • Apply disciplined configuration management, documentation, and testing practices to ensure technical environments and workflows are repeatable and maintainable.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Strong practical understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, subnetting, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, and common network protocols.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, upgrading, migrating, and troubleshooting enterprise or operational network infrastructure.

  • Ability to analyze complex network configurations, communications pathways, routing relationships, and system dependencies to understand how traffic and capabilities traverse an environment.

  • Proficiency with Python or a similar scripting/programming language for technical analysis, workflow automation, data manipulation, or tool development.

  • Strong working knowledge of Linux operating systems, including command-line administration, networking utilities, services, permissions, processes, and troubleshooting.

  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows systems and understanding their interaction within enterprise network environments.

  • Ability to build, configure, and troubleshoot representative network and systems environments for testing, analysis, validation, or capability development.

  • Demonstrated ability to systematically investigate complex technical problems across networking, operating systems, applications, and infrastructure.

  • Ability to document network architectures, configurations, technical findings, and troubleshooting processes clearly for both technical and operational audiences.

  • CCNA certification or demonstrated equivalent networking knowledge and practical experience.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing virtualized environments using technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or similar platforms.

title: Butiksmedarbetare till Dollarstore Sisjön
description:
Sugen på att vara med och demokratisera shoppingglädjen för alla våra kunder? Är du redo på ett jobb där ingen dag är den andra lik, där du får chansen att möta massor av olika människor och sprida glädje i deras vardag? Då kan vi ha jobbet för dig! ✨

Hos oss på Dollarstore kommer du att vara ansiktet utåt – både när våra kunder kommer in i butiken och när de lämnar den. Din uppgift är att se till att de får en positiv upplevelse, från första "hej" till sista "tack och hej då". Om du har erfarenhet av att jobba i kassa är det ett plus, men viktigast är att du gillar att möta människor och ge bra service.

Tillsammans med din butikschef ser du till att butiken alltid ser tipptopp ut, är välfylld och inbjudande. Det betyder att du ibland behöver beställa nya varor och alltid hålla ett öga på att allt ser bra ut.

Vi jobbar tätt tillsammans i vårt team och hjälps åt med allt som behöver göras. Ibland behöver man rycka in där det behövs och vara beredd på att arbetsuppgifterna kan variera från dag till dag.

🌟 Hos oss på Dollarstore tycker vi att det ska vara kul att handla lågpris! Om du håller med och vill vara en del av vårt glada gäng, då kan det här vara rätt plats för dig 🌟

Varför Dollarstore? På Dollarstore får du chansen att omvandla våra utrymmen och förvandla dem till något unikt och minnesvärt. Det är en magisk upplevelse som låter kreativiteten flöda fritt. Halloween bjuder på möjligheten att omfamna mystik och spänning med kusliga dekorationer, medan trädgårdsrummet kan explodera i loungemöbler, vattenkannor och blomstrande färger under vår och sommar. Det är något speciellt med att se ett rum förändras med årstiderna – varje säsong bjuder på nya teman, färger och känslor. Att bygga dessa rum är som att skapa en liten värld där fantasi och verklighet möter varandra. Vi vill göra det roligt för människor att handla lågpris och som en del av Dollarstores team får du möjlighet att fortsätta göra det! I en spännande och dynamisk arbetsmiljö får du dagligen fortsätta bidra till vår framgång!

Praktisk information

🕒Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

⏳Anställningsgrad: Deltid, 10-20h/v Vikariat

📍Plats: Dollarstore Datavägen, Sisjön

💰Lön: Timlön enligt kollektivavtal

Om du är redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och tror att du har vad som krävs för att bli en framgångsrik butiksmedarbetare hos Dollarstore, skicka in din ansökan idag genom att klicka på "Ansök nu" nedan. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team och tillsammans fortsätta skapa fantastiska shoppingupplevelser för våra kunder!Vi är stolta över att vara en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering, där vi ser mångfald och inkludering som grundläggande värden. Vår rekrytering är alltid baserad på kompetens och vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla, oavsett bakgrund, har lika möjligheter att växa och utvecklas. Genom att aktivt arbeta för en rättvis och inkluderande arbetsplats, ser vi till att alla våra medarbetare känner sig respekterade, värderade och välkomna.

Som en del i Dollarstores rekryteringsprocess genomför företaget bakgrundsanalyser tillsammans med Svensk Bakgrundsanalys vilket är ett auktoriserat företag inom bakgrundskontroller.

Vi ses! 👋

Notera: Vi tar emot ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Ansök därför redan idag!

Dollarstore är en av Sveriges största lågprisaktörer och vi fortsätter växa. Idag har vi över 130 butiker i både Sverige och Danmark där vi erbjuder våra kunder glädje, gemenskap och fantastiska priser. Sedan augusti 2023 ingår Dollarstore i finska Tokmanni Group och tillsammans med dem är vi en av de ledande lågprisaktörerna i Norden och är listade på finska börsen. Tillsammans med våra 2000 medarbetare brinner vi för försäljning och mötet med kunden. Välkommen till Dollarstore!

DollarStores DNA

  • Vi är närvarande mot kunder och kollegor och tror på att alla människor har rätt till glädje, gemenskap och fantastiska priser
  • Vi har de mest upplevelsefyllda butikerna och produkter som hela tiden överraskar.
  • Vi är alltid ärliga och vi är på riktigt. No monkey business – helt enkelt.
  • Vi har de lägsta priserna och skapar mest värde till våra konsumenter. Detta görs genom att vi alltid har kostnaderna i fokus.

Job Description:

Join GDIT and be a part of the team of men and women who solve some of the world’s most complex technical challenges. We are seeking a Network Engineer to join our team at Langley AFB.


The Dual-Role Network & Cloud Architecture Engineer is responsible for the overall design, management, performance, and upkeep of enterprise-wide area network (WAN), campus area network (CAN), and multi-cloud infrastructure environments. This role blends traditional networking expertise with modern cloud architecture, covering cloud design, hybrid connectivity, routing, switching, cryptographic devices, multiplexing components, and network services. The engineer ensures daily operational integrity across physical and cloud-native networking devices within the 480th Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance (ISR) Wing Security Office and the Distributed Common Ground System (DCGS) Architecture while driving cloud migration and hybrid topology design.

In addition, the Cloud & Network Engineer:

  • Cloud & Hybrid Network Architecture Design: Architect, design, and manage scalable, secure cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, or hybrid/multi-cloud) while ensuring seamless, low-latency connectivity between on-premises DCGS networks and cloud infrastructures.
  • Network & Cloud Operations: Oversee the operation, maintenance, and optimization of all physical networking devices, virtual private clouds (VPCs), cloud gateways, routers, switches, crypto devices, and network management platforms within the DCGS environment.
  • Troubleshooting & Support: Provide troubleshooting and support for network and cloud connectivity issues across core, cloud-hosted, and remote locations.
  • Security & Compliance: Maintain full operational understanding of the DCGS Architecture and security protocols; enforce government and military security practices, generate and support Network Service Requests (NSR) and Ports, Protocols, and Services Request (PSR).
  • System Optimization & Capacity Planning: Evaluate workload requirements provided by the AF DCGS Program Office to determine bandwidth, cloud compute/storage demands, Controlled Interface (CI) settings, and performance baselines for existing and emerging ISR capabilities.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as an Operations Engineer working with DOC Tier III staff, outside agencies, the 480 ISR WG, and the AF DCGS program office to establish robust, well-architected cloud and network integration solutions.
  • Deployment & Documentation: Lead installation efforts, configuration, and migration of CAN/WAN equipment and cloud resources; maintain comprehensive architectural diagrams, cloud design documents, and network baselines.
  • Risk Management: Review all enterprise and cloud integration efforts to guarantee system engineering rigor, advising government leadership and COR representatives on technical risks and optimization strategies.

Required

  • 7 Years of network engineering and integration experience
  • 2 Years Cloud integration experience
  • Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmentalized Information (TS/SCI)
  • Certifications: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or CompTIA Cloud+ and CompTIA Security+


Preferred

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • A working knowledge of AF DCGS and AF ISR operations is desired

title: Sr. Facilities Space Auditor
description:
Our client, a government contractor supporting critical federal programs, is seeking an experienced Senior Space Auditor to join a Space Management Team responsible for maintaining accurate facility, occupancy, and utilization data across a geographically dispersed portfolio.

This position is ideal for a facilities or space management professional who enjoys working both in the field and with data. The Senior Space Auditor will conduct onsite facility assessments, validate occupancy and personnel information, update floor plans and seating allocations, and work closely with government personnel, building managers, space coordinators, and other stakeholders to support effective space planning and utilization.

The role requires strong technical knowledge of space management systems, AutoCAD and Revit, along with the ability to interpret architectural drawings and translate audit findings into accurate facility records. Domestic and international travel is required.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Space Management Team in maintaining accurate space, occupancy, and utilization data.
  • Coordinate with Space Coordinators, Site Chiefs, Building Managers, government personnel, and other stakeholders involved in space allocation and facility use.
  • Gather and analyze customer space and occupancy requirements.
  • Conduct facility and site walks to validate existing conditions, seating assignments, occupancy levels, and personnel bed-downs.
  • Perform field measurements and verify room dimensions, layouts, and space configurations.
  • Update floor plans and seating allocations based on audit findings and facility changes.
  • Resolve floor plan, spatial orientation, and occupancy discrepancies.
  • Develop and revise space layouts using AutoCAD and Revit.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, architectural drawings, floor plans, and facility documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records of space usage, capacity, occupancy, and vacancy.
  • Use ARCHIBUS or a comparable Computer-Aided Facility Management system to update records and generate utilization reports.
  • Analyze capacity, occupancy, vacancy, and utilization data.
  • Support immediate and long-term space planning and occupancy needs.
  • Assist with strategic space planning, occupancy planning, and facility planning initiatives.
  • Identify gaps and discrepancies within accountable spaces.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and communications for senior leadership.
  • Facilitate stakeholder meetings or workshops when needed.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Conduct space audits at facilities worldwide, including domestic and international travel on a bi-monthly, quarterly, or as-needed basis.


Requirements

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Facilities Management, Engineering, Planning, or a related field with 6+ years of experience, or 10+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience in space management, occupancy planning, facility planning, space auditing, or a related function.
  • Prior experience with ARCHIBUS or a comparable Computer-Aided Facility Management system.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD and Revit.
  • Experience conducting space audits, facility assessments, occupancy validations, or personnel bed-down reviews.
  • Ability to perform field measurements and accurately document facility conditions.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, architectural drawings, and floor plans.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, and Adobe products.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and changing priorities.
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with strategic space planning, occupancy planning, facilities planning, and workplace utilization analysis.
  • Familiarity with federal space accountability requirements.
  • Experience managing space inventory, occupancy, and utilization data across large or geographically dispersed facility portfolios.

If you are an experienced space or facilities management professional with an active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph and enjoy a combination of field auditing, technical space planning, and stakeholder collaboration, we encourage you to apply.

title: Vice President, Commercial Strategy
location: Any Region, REMOTE, United States of America
description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart(R).

About the Role

We are seeking a Vice President, Commercial Strategy to join our team in a remote capacity. As Vice President, Commercial Strategy, you will drive new business growth and strategic market positioning for Parexel by leading commercial strategy initiatives, analyzing market opportunities, and guiding high-impact bid pursuits. This position plays a critical role in shaping Parexel's competitive positioning, enhancing client relationships, and accelerating revenue growth. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across sales, operations, and technical functions, leverage industry insights to identify strategic opportunities, and contribute to business development from opportunity identification through successful award.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic commercial initiatives, client relationship development, and competitive market analysis. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Vice President, Commercial Strategy can expand influence across the organization and drive transformational business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in bid triage discussions to evaluate incoming opportunities, assess strategic fit, and align pursuits with corporate objectives
  • Conduct comprehensive market and competitive analysis to identify, qualify, and prioritize high-value opportunities that align with Parexel's capabilities and growth strategy
  • Provide expert guidance and coaching to bid teams on high-profile RFI and RFP opportunities, ensuring competitive and compelling sales messaging that differentiates Parexel and drives successful outcomes
  • Collaborate closely with sales teams, technical experts, and operational colleagues to understand client requirements, assess opportunity scope, and develop winning strategies
  • Prepare bid teams for client presentations and interactions through constructive feedback and strategic positioning to maximize Parexel's competitive advantage
  • Extract and disseminate lessons learned from wins and losses across the organization to continuously improve commercial effectiveness and bid pursuit outcomes
  • Monitor industry trends, policy changes, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies that may impact Parexel's market positioning and competitive strategy
  • Participate in bid pursuits and client engagements as needed to strengthen relationships and represent Parexel's strategic capabilities
  • Represent Parexel at industry conferences and events to stay informed on market developments, engage with customers, and enhance Parexel's industry visibility
  • Lead or participate in internal initiatives to optimize commercial hit rate and enhance bid pursuit effectiveness
  • Collaborate with Sales Operations and business leaders on analysis of wins and losses, and development and dissemination of key commercial insights
  • Participate in development of training materials and resources on commercial strategy and bid pursuit best practices

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication and presentation skills that inspire confidence and drive engagement
  • Advanced negotiation, influencing, and persuasion capabilities with the ability to shape strategy and drive stakeholder alignment
  • Demonstrated leadership and ability to influence multiple stakeholders across functions to set strategy and oversee successful implementation
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking with the ability to identify market opportunities and competitive positioning
  • Executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships and interface effectively with external clients and internal employees at all organizational levels
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills combined with creativity and strategic insight
  • Collaborative, inclusive, and proactive attitude with demonstrated ability to foster teamwork across diverse teams and drive achievement of goals
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy with strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Willingness to travel as needed for the position

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of successful track record in the CRO industry with extensive client management experience and background in senior sales and/or operational roles
  • Extensive experience in development of commercial messaging including proposal writing, RFIs, sales and marketing materials, and bid pursuit content
  • Proven experience leading and managing global cross-functional teams
  • Proficiency with commercial and bid tools and software including Microsoft Office, Salesforce, and proposal or presentation automation platforms
  • Superior understanding of commercial strategy messaging, selling with insight, and data-driven methodologies
  • Strong knowledge of the CRO industry, the biopharma market, and the products and services that Parexel offers
  • General understanding of medical terminology and ICH/GCP
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific or business discipline
  • Advanced degree in business, science, or related field
  • Experience in pharmaceutical medicine or related therapeutic areas
  • Demonstrated success in business development or new business pursuits

  • Tuition Reimbursement

title: Sr Director Finance, Filler Metals
description:
Job Description:

Founded in 1904, ESAB Corporation is a premier narrowly diversified global leader in connected fabrication technology and gas control solutions. Our rich history of innovative products, workflow solutions, and business system, ESAB Business Excellence, enables our purpose of Shaping the World We Imagine™. We’re looking to hire a talented Sr Director Finance, Filler Metals based in Denton, TX or Bethesda, MD.


Reporting to the VP Finance, North America the Sr Director Finance, Filler Metals is responsible for being the senior finance leader for ESAB's Filler Metals business, a manufacturing segment generating approximately $400M in annual revenue. This is a full P&L role combining manufacturing finance, commercial finance, and strategic business partnership with plant and commercial leadership. The role owns financial close, FP&A, and budgeting for the business, and serves as a lead finance partner on ERP implementation and broader transformation initiatives. This is a highly visible role with direct influence on the performance of a major ESAB business unit.


Primary Duties


Full P&L and Business Partnership

  • Own the full P&L for the Filler Metals business (~$400M in revenue), from revenue and margin through conversion cost and SG&A.
  • Serve as strategic finance business partner to plant and commercial leadership, influencing decisions on pricing, mix, capacity, and investment.
  • Translate operational and commercial performance into clear financial narratives and recommendations for business and executive leadership.

Manufacturing Finance

  • Lead standard costing, conversion cost, and manufacturing variance analysis across the business's manufacturing operations.
  • Partner with operations on capacity planning, cost-out initiatives, and productivity tracking.
  • Support inventory management, reserve policy, and capital project evaluation.

Commercial Finance

  • Partner with commercial leadership on pricing strategy, deal economics, and customer/channel profitability.
  • Support funnel and growth reviews, ensuring financial rigor in forecasting commercial performance.

Close, FP&A, and Budgeting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with company policy and US GAAP.
  • Lead annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning for the business.
  • Drive EBITDA management and margin improvement initiatives, including product/SKU rationalization efforts.
  • Deliver consistent, action-oriented KPI reporting and governance routines to leadership.

Transformation and ERP

  • Serve as a lead finance stakeholder on ERP implementation, ensuring the system supports costing, close, and reporting requirements for the business.
  • Support data migration, process design, and finance-team readiness/training as part of the ERP rollout.
  • Identify and drive process standardization opportunities as part of the broader finance transformation agenda.

Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a finance team supporting the Filler Metals business, including site controllers and FP&A analysts.
  • Establish consistent governance, KPI reporting, and review cadences.
  • Act as a change agent, driving alignment to common financial processes and reporting standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA, CPA, or CMA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience in a manufacturing/industrial environment, including plant or site-level finance ownership.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a full P&L and serving as a strategic business partner to operations and commercial leadership.
  • Strong background in standard costing, manufacturing variance analysis, and conversion cost management.
  • Experience with FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and monthly close processes.
  • Experience supporting or leading ERP implementations (SAP preferred).
  • Strong communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence plant, commercial, and senior leadership stakeholders.

Working Conditions

  • Remains in a stationary position 50% of the time and involves additional physical demands such as ascending/descending stairs, walking stooping and standing.
  • Must wear Personal Protective Equipment ‘PPE’ when working/visiting manufacturing and plant locations.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery including but not limited to printer, tablets, cell phones.
  • Moves transports, puts, or removes equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.; pushes, pulls products weighing up to 200 lbs. using provided safety tools.
  • May be exposed to varying weather during travel.
  • Domestic travel required approximately 25%.

description:
Tjänst: Innesäljare – Bli en del av ett familjeföretag med smak för affärer!

Du blir en viktig länk mellan kunder och våra utesäljare – och en del av ett tight, engagerat team i en miljö där det händer saker varje dag. Här får du både ansvar och utrymme att växa!

· Friskvårdsbidrag och personalrabatter

· Ett kontor i Jordbro med bra kommunikationer

Start: Omgående

Tjänsten är heltid, Söndag 13:00-17:00 och måndag–torsdag 08:00-17:00

Om Restaurangjouren

RJ - Restaurangjouren - är en etablerad restauranggrossist med över 3 000 artiklar i sortimentet. Vi arbetar med både lokala producenter och globala leverantörer och brinner för att erbjuda våra kunder ett brett, aktuellt och kvalitativt utbud.

Våra kunder finns inom restaurang, café och fast food – och vi strävar alltid efter att ligga steget före med både produkter och service.

Ansökan

För oss är det viktigt att ta tillvara på all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden. Vi välkomnar alla sökande och arbetar aktivt för mångfald och inkludering.

Låter det som rätt utmaning för dig?

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – vi intervjuar löpande.

Mejla din ansökan till vår HR chef Tony Johnsson på: tony@restaurangjouren.se

Din ansökan skall innehålla ett CV och ett personligt brev i PDF format.

Glöm inte att märka din ansökan tydligt med vilken tjänst du söker eftersom vi har fler tjänster ute.

Tjänsten kan komma att bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag, ansök därför så snart som möjligt.

title: Recreational Coordinator, Relief
description:
JOB SUMMARY

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

The Recreation Coordinator is responsible for planning, implementing and overseeing developmentally appropriate play activities and interactions in the all LPCHS playrooms, at the bedside, in designated waiting rooms, and other assigned areas. This position interviews, orients, trains, evaluates competence and oversees Child Life volunteers. Assists with the planning and implantation of special events/visitors, orders and maintains playroom supplies, creates activity schedule and assists with donations.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

* Maintains safe ratio/space for patients and families (IV pole, wheelchair accessibility, etc.)
* Plans and implements group activities for patients and families which are developmentally appropriate and based on needs assessment in the LPCHS playrooms, play spaces, waiting rooms, bedside, and other designated areas.
* Assists in the planning, coordination and facilitation of special events and special visitors.
* Shares observations of child's developmental, physical and emotional behavior, along with relevant family information, with the other members of the Child Life and Creative Arts team verbally and/or through our child life hand off process.
* Interviews, orients, trains, evaluates competence and oversees Child Life volunteers.
* Assists with acceptance of donations and other donation related responsibilities.
* Provides developmentally appropriate play activities and orientation to Child Life Services for patients at bedside.
* Provides and maintains age-appropriate supplies in compliance with safety and infection control policies, assists in inventory control, ordering of supplies and storage of supplies.
* Develops, edits, prints, and distributes playroom calendar, flyers for events and banners for Get Well TV .
* Evaluates programs and services. Records statistics and other data needed for program evaluation.
* Develops new program/initiatives to meet patients' needs.
* Collaborates with media coordination team to set up patient activities.
* Assists in development of best practices for play and programming standards.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education: Associate's degree in work-related field

Experience: One (1) year of progressively responsible directly related work experience.

License/Certification: None required.

KNOWLEDGE

These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

* Ability to assess and meaningfully interact with infants, children youth and families.
* Ability to provide a safe, therapeutic and healing environment for infants, children, youth and families.
* Ability to develop and evaluate services.
* Ability to implement services within the structure and culture of the work environment.
* Ability to foster effective working relationships and build consensus.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Ability to communicate with others in all formats: written, oral, interpersonal.
* Ability to display independent judgment and initiative.
* Ability to establish and sustain relationships with staff members and a variety of internal and external working groups and individuals.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Salary within our ranges may also be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
Typically, new team members join at the minimum to mid salary range.
