title: National Clinical Trial Liaison Lead
location: Wilmington, Delaware, United States of America
description:
Field Based US

AstraZeneca is advancing the pace of clinical study progress in the US as a critical enabler of Ambition 2030. The National Director, Clinical Trial Liaison Team will provide national leadership, direction, and performance management for a field-based Clinical Trial Liaison team focused on strengthening scientific engagement with strategic clinical research sites and accelerating support for prioritized studies across the US.

This role serves as the key link between US clinical investigators, strategic research sites, healthcare professionals, and headquarters-based teams across Medical Affairs, R&D, Clinical Operations, and Brand. This leader will translate enterprise priorities into a clear national CTL strategy, ensuring scientifically rigorous, compliant, and impactful site engagement. The role will lead field execution across priority research centers, strengthen engagement capabilities, advance new ways of working, and leverage field insights to inform study planning, clinical trial execution, and efforts to accelerate patient access to innovative medicines.

The National Director is accountable for national field performance, team health, scientific engagement capability, and executional excellence for the Clinical Trial Liaison function. This leader will establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, compliance, urgency, continued growth, and recognition while helping the organization elevate the importance of clinical trial acceleration in the US.

The role requires strong enterprise leadership and matrix influence,. The National Director will partner with multiple headquarters and field functions across R&D and business areas to align priorities, remove execution barriers, and ensure site-facing work supports both current study needs and AstraZeneca's longer-term ambition to bring innovative medicines to patients faster.

Key Accountabilities

  • Establish National Strategy and Vision: Establish the national vision, operating model, and execution priorities for the Clinical Trial Liaison team, making US clinical trial acceleration a visible field medical priority in support of Ambition 2030.

  • Drive Performance and Lead Field Execution: Lead national and enterprise study priorities into clear field plans, priority site coverage, and consistent engagement expectations across US strategic research centers, including select Partner in Care Network sites and other key research partners.

  • Strong Team Leadership and Talent Development: Lead and manage the national Clinical Trial Liaison team, including goal setting, performance management, coaching, onboarding, capability building, best-practice sharing, team culture, and talent development.

  • Translate Insights into Strategic Impact: Serve as the national conduit for investigator, site, and referring-provider insights, ensuring field insights are gathered with quality, shared rapidly with headquarters partners, and used to inform strategies, plans, and field adjustments.

  • Future-Ready Field Leadership: Anticipate future trends and needs in the clinical trial and health care marketplace, resource the field team optimally, and lead change initiatives that enable positive business and patient outcomes

  • Strong Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with US Site Management and Monitoring, Clinical Operations, R&D, Medical Affairs, Therapeutic Area Medical Science Liaisons, Clinical Account Directors, Brand teams, and business area counterparts to coordinate site-facing engagement and support prioritized studies.

  • Execution Excellence and Operational Discipline: Ensure field medical deliverables, quality expectations, and metrics are relevant, understood, met, and where possible exceeded; reinforce consistent adherence to business processes, guidelines, and policies.

Essential Requirements

  • Masters required, PhD, PharmD, MD, DO preferred

  • Ten or more years of combined experience contributing to and leading Field Medical, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, pharmaceutical industry, or clinical trial research teams.

  • Experience in supporting clinical trial site engagement, feasibility input, patient recruitment initiatives, or trial-enrollment support.

  • People leadership experience with proven ability to lead field-based teams, first-line leaders, or large-scale field medical initiatives.

  • Track record of delivering large-scale, impactful medical, clinical, or field execution initiatives across a matrix organization.

  • Strong experience with clinical research, study site logistics, investigator and site engagement, clinical trial education, and collaboration with clinical operations partners.

  • Experience in implementation of AI tools to accelerate patient identification & recruitment

  • Demonstrated expertise in scientific communication, drug information exchange, and education of health care professionals, investigators, site staff, and internal stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of FDA compliance, regulatory requirements, Medical Affairs policies, business processes, and appropriate scientific exchange standards.

  • Ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally with executive leadership, headquarters partners, Global Medical Affairs, R&D, Clinical Operations, Brand teams, and field-based colleagues.

  • Excellent collaborative, interpersonal, verbal, written, project management, and change leadership skills.

  • Ability to travel 30-40% of the time, with travel expectations varying by business need.

Desirable Requirements

  • Medical, clinical, or scientific expertise in one or more AstraZeneca BioPharmaceuticals therapeutic areas; Immunology and cardiovascular and metabolic expertise is highly preferred where relevant to the assigned portfolio.

  • Previous national or regional line management experience in Medical Affairs, Field Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or a clinical-trial-facing organization.

  • Experience in pharmaceutical industry clinical or preclinical research, drug discovery, drug development, pipeline engagement, or key external expert interactions.

  • Experience working in an account-based setting with Clinical Account Directors, Commercial Account Directors, Brand teams, and other internal matrix partners.

  • Entrepreneurial, future-forward approach with passion for coaching, change adoption, scientific innovation, and advancing patient care.

Why AstraZeneca?

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program. Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans. Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base pay (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Ion™ endoluminal system is Intuitive's new robotic platform for minimally invasive biopsy in the peripheral lung, with an initial goal of improving the early diagnosis of lung cancer. We are seeking a senior algorithm engineer to play a lead technical role in conceptualizing, designing, and evaluating our next-generation planning and guidance software. This role is dedicated to developing advanced algorithms to analyze real-time ultrasound (US) imaging- specifically endobronchial ultrasound (EBUS) and min-profile ultrasound probes – for the accurate detection, segmentation, and classification pulmonary structures. This position focuses heavily on processing temporal, high-resolution ultrasound video streams, mitigating inherent acoustic artifacts, and fusing ultrasound data with pre-operative imaging modalities to improve targeting confidence and clinical outcomes.

Essential Duties

  • Drive the full cycle of medical imaging analysis software development, developing algorithms from R&D concepts into robust, commercial medical device products.
  • Design, prototype, and implement advanced computer vision and machine learning algorithms tailored for real-time processing of diverse ultrasound modalities, including EBUS and ultrasound probes.
  • Develop specialized algorithms to handle the unique challenges of high-frequency ultrasound data, including speckle reduction, acoustic shadowing mitigation, and temporal tracking across video frames.
  • Apply and fine-tune state-of-the-art architectures, including spatio-temporal Vision Transformers (ViTs), recurrent networks, nnU-Net, Graph Neural Network (GNN) and Diffusion models, adapting them for noisy, high-frame-rate clinical ultrasound datasets.
  • Architect and execute model deployment pipelines, seamlessly integrating trained models into high-performance C++ production environments, utilizing techniques like quantization, pruning, and hardware acceleration to ensure real-time performance on constrained medical systems.
  • Support system integration and testing while generating formal design documentation and patent applications.

Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industrial experience in algorithm development, with a deep specialization in medical imaging and computer vision.
  • Exceptional proficiency in Python and C++, with a deep understanding of modern software component design for production environments.
  • Expert knowledge of ML frameworks and software toolkits, including PyTorch, OpenCV, MONAI, ITK, VTK, and model optimization tools such as TensorRT or ONNX.
  • Strong domain expertise in ultrasound physics, acoustic image processing, and temporal/video data analysis is highly preferred, especially experience with data from EBUS or high-resolution small-profile transducers.
  • Experience with spatiotemporal deep learning architectures and deployment of low-latency real-time applications for ultrasound imaging applications.
  • Experience or knowledge of the development of AI/ML features in strict alignment with Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP) principles, ensuring data representativeness and model transparency.
  • A proven track record of shipping commercial AI/ML software products is bonus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective cross-functional collaboration with clinical and engineering teams.

Mō tō mātou rōpū | About the school

The School of Environment is home to a vibrant and diverse community of students, academics and professional staff pursuing research and teaching across the social and natural sciences.

Alongside Earth Science, the School brings together internationally recognised disciplinary programmes in Geography, Geology, Geophysics and Geographical Information Science, as well as interdisciplinary programmes in Environmental Management, Environmental Science.

This creates a highly collaborative environment where researchers can connect across disciplines and explore new approaches to some of the most important environmental challenges facing our world.

Earth Science is an integral part of this broader community, providing opportunities to collaborate nationally and internationally and to contribute to research that connects past, present and future Earth system processes.

Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

We are seeking a researcher and educator with a PhD in Earth Science, Geography, Environmental Science, Evolutionary Biology or a related discipline, and a developing record of high-quality research publications.

This is an exciting opportunity for an academic who is passionate about research, enjoys working collaboratively and wants to contribute to the development of the next generation of Earth and environmental scientists.

We welcome researchers who use field, laboratory, analytical, computational, and/or modelling approaches and who are excited by opportunities to work across disciplines.

Ngā Haepapa Matua | Key Responsibilities (not limited to):

Contribute to the teaching and delivery of undergraduate and postgraduate Earth Science courses

Conduct research and contribute to the development of an independent research programme in Earth Science

Supervise postgraduate research students in Earth Science and related areas, supporting their academic and research development.

Contribute meaningfully to the School's collegial working environment by working collaboratively with staff, students, and relevant external and professional organisations.

For more detailed information review this position description

This is a full-time (40 hrs per week) permanent role

The remuneration is between $99,788 - $109,496 per annum, dependent on skills and experience

He kōrero mōu | About you

We are looking for an engaged, forward-thinking, and collegial academic who is excited about research and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and students.

You will hold a PhD in Earth Science, Geological Science, Geography, Environmental Science, Evolutionary Biology, or a closely related discipline.

You will also bring:

  • a track record of research demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications, appropriate to your career stage;
  • research expertise in Earth Science, with alignment to paleoclimate and/or climate-linked Earth system science;

  • excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • the ability to work effectively as part of a diverse and collaborative team;
  • a collegial approach and enthusiasm for engaging with colleagues and students across disciplines; and
  • the potential to develop an internationally recognised research programme.

Teaching experience is preferred, as is experience demonstrating the ability to contribute to Earth Science teaching and research programs.

Ngā āhuatanga kei a mātou | What we offer

The University of Auckland is New Zealand's leading University and maintains significant computational, laboratory, and analytic facilities. Auckland is frequently rated as one of the world's most liveable cities.

  • Flexible employment practices (including working from home and flexible hours)

title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Money
description:
Intuit's Consumer Group is committed to building tools and services that improve our members' financial journeys. At the heart of this mission, the Fast Money & Lending team is developing innovative solutions to empower customers to confidently access their tax refunds, obtain a line of credit and diversify their portfolio.


The team is seeking a Sr. Staff Data Scientist to serve as an analytical leader & strategic thought partner across our fast money & lending products - spanning refund advance, refund transfer, 5 Days Early & line of credit. This is a high-impact, cross-initiative role where you will set the analytics vision, raise the scientific bar across the team, and influence product, marketing, and lending strategy at the Business Unit level.


Responsibilities

* Set strategy across initiatives: Set strategy across the fast money & lending business to evaluate the customer lifecycle end to end.

* Influence senior leadership: Combine insights, business acumen, strategic considerations, and industry-wide learnings to influence cross-functional leaders up to the VP level; act as the connective tissue across Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Design.

* Advance the science: Identify new ML and causal inference methodologies and external trends, adapt them to lending use cases, and create shareable frameworks that enable adoption across the BU -- with clarity on when and how each methodology should be used to drive business value.

* Lead experimentation at scale: Drive an iterative experimentation culture across the team -- designing complex experiments (A/B/n, painted-door, bandits, and quasi-experimental designs) and applying causal inference (Propensity Score, DiD, Synthetic Control where A/B testing capability is limited)

* Build durable segmentation & customer understanding: identify key patterns in customer behavior by connecting insights across a portfolio of experiments and analyses; create durable customer segmentation strategies that enhance targeting, positioning, and the application experience.

* Shape the AI-native roadmap: Co-create the analytics/AI strategy for lending & fast money in partnership with cross-functional teams; guide phased testing and rollout with the right measurement, safety, risk, and ethical considerations; connect model performance metrics to customer and business outcomes.

* Raise the bar & develop talent: Mentor and elevate Data Scientists across the team, set scientific standards and best practices, contribute to calibrations and hiring, and scale yourself through delegation while remaining hands-on in the highest-leverage areas.


Qualifications

We're looking for a curious, proactive, and influential data science leader with a passion for fintech.

* 9+ years of experience in data science and analytics, with a track record of driving strategy and impact across multiple initiatives or business units; fintech experience (lending,banking,investing) strongly preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to apply first-principles thinking to translate ambiguous business strategy into analytical problems at the business-unit level.

* Proven success designing and interpreting complex experiments well beyond traditional A/B testing, and applying causal inference where experimentation is constrained.

* Deep expertise in causal inference, customer segmentation, and experimentation design, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor and business considerations.

* Exposure to light weight Machine Learning in terms of being able to build offline classification & regression models to inform business decisions.

* Experience creating reusable frameworks, methodologies, and toolkits that are adopted by a broader analytics community.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-influence skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence Director- and VP-level leaders across business and technical teams.

* Ability to navigate ambiguity with minimal guidance, make fast data-driven decisions (one-way vs. two-way door), and operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Ability to use AI native tools to plan, implement and synthesize analyses across a variety of use cases ranging from experiment readouts, quasi experimental methodology, revenue deep dives & measuring the success of product launches.

* BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).





Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Oakland $210,500 - $284,500

title: Event Delivery Lead (Casual)
description:
Who We Are

At Contour, we’re reshaping education, one student at a time.


Born from the frustration of students who knew the system could be better, we set out to build what we once wished existed: tutoring that actually works. Not generic classes. Not recycled notes. Not overpriced, overcrowded rooms with an out-of-touch teacher who couldn’t relate. But a complete ecosystem of tutoring, resources, and support, meticulously designed to help every student reach their full potential.

Since 2020, over 10,000+ students have trusted Contour to guide their academic journey, and we’ve grown to over 300+ team members. We’ve produced hundreds of 99+ ATARs, tutored the World-Record UCAT scorer, and placed more students into medical school than any school in Australia.

Our growth is a testament to the simple philosophy: Put the student first, always. Everything we design, from our world-class tutor-training programs to our purpose-built campuses, exists to help students master content faster, perform with confidence, and even rekindle the joy of learning.


Contour is a group of three brands united by one goal: to give every student the best chance to achieve their full potential:

  • Contour Education: Reshaping how students master their high school subjects with small-group tutoring, structured resources, and 1-on-1 support across Maths, Science, and English.
  • Contour Medprep: Reshaping medical preparation with a proven, step-by-step pathway through the UCAT, interviews, and admissions, led by a team of 100+ medical students.
  • Contour TestPrep: Reshaping test preparation, starting with the selective entry exam, through rigorous tutoring, mock exams, and data-driven feedback to give students a decisive advantage.

This is Contour. Built by students, for students.

What You Will Do

  • End-to-end event delivery – Lead on-site logistics, timetabling, and team coordination for student assessments and events across Melbourne.
  • Flawless planning – Map out detailed timelines, floor plans, and run sheets to ensure seamless execution from setup to pack-down.
  • Rigorous documentation – Build clear checklists, site manuals, and operational guides to keep every event component fully aligned.
  • On-site leadership – Serve as the calm, authoritative point of contact for casual staff, venue managers, students, and internal teams.
  • Staff management & briefs – Roster, brief, and guide casual invigilators and event teams to maintain high standards of delivery.
  • Exam integrity & supervision – Direct and oversee assessment rooms to ensure a highly structured, quiet, and strictly compliant environment.
  • Student wellbeing & equity – Facilitate approved Special Examination Arrangements and handle student needs with poise and professionalism.
  • Daily agile briefings – Lead daily team huddles during multi-day events to surface challenges, gather feedback, and implement rapid fixes.
  • Resource & budget control – Manage printing, stationery, and vendor sourcing while keeping event expenses strictly within approved budgets.
  • Venue evaluation – Conduct thorough site visits and assessment checks to inform venue selection and operational design.
  • Registration & attendance – Oversee event software to manage check-in flows and accurately track student attendance in real time.

What You Will Bring

  • Event operations background with proven experience in coordination, exam delivery, or logistics is ideal.
  • Casual team leadership exposure is desirable, but full training and onboarding support are provided.
  • Operational mastery with a track record of managing timelines, documentation, compliance, and event budgets.

title: Quality - Leaad
description:
Role Summary

Responsible for leading plant quality activities covering internal manufacturing quality, customer quality, supplier quality, audits, inspection controls, ISO compliance, documentation, and quality improvement initiatives. The role involves handling customer complaints, warranty issues, supplier concerns, NCRs, audits, FAI / PPAP documentation, and ensuring plant quality KPIs are achieved.

Key Responsibilities – Plant & Customer Quality

▪ Lead and manage plant quality activities for manufacturing, customer, and supplier requirements
▪ Monitor daily quality control, inspections, audits, and issue resolution
▪ Drive quality improvement to reduce customer complaints, internal rejections, supplier defects, and warranty concerns
▪ Monitor quality KPIs and ensure achievement of plant quality targets
▪ Handle customer complaints, warranty issues, containment, RCA, corrective actions, and closure
▪ Coordinate customer audits including GPA audits, Torque audits, RTM audits, and special process audits
▪ Prepare customer FAI documents, 3.1 certificates, inspection reports, and compliance documents
▪ Ensure effective implementation of inter-process quality controls
▪ Monitor daily rejection data and initiate corrective actions for recurring defects
▪ Ensure proper instrument calibration and inspection readiness

Key Responsibilities – Quality System, Supplier Quality & NPI

▪ Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and maintain audit documentation
▪ Plan internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings
▪ Manage NCRs, corrective actions, preventive actions, and effectiveness reviews
▪ Manage supplier quality issues, incoming material concerns, and supplier corrective actions
▪ Conduct supplier audits and follow up on supplier improvement plans
▪ Verify supplier material certificates including 3.1 certificates
▪ Monitor supplier performance and support supplier development activities
▪ Ensure supplier FAI audit and compliance
▪ Support new product introduction, new process implementation, and product transfer activities
▪ Coordinate with production, engineering, supply chain, and quality teams for product launch readiness
▪ Ensure PFMEA, Control Plan, PPAP, FAI, inspection standards, and process documents are prepared and implemented
▪ Handle commodities such as rubber, machined parts, castings, plating, and heat treatment components

Skills Required

▪ Strong knowledge of QA / QC in manufacturing industries
▪ Good working knowledge of ISO 9001, PPAP, PFMEA, FAI, NCR, and 8D methodology
▪ IATF knowledge will be an added advantage
▪ Experience in customer complaint handling and warranty issue resolution
▪ Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits
▪ Knowledge of internal audits, customer audits, and certification audit
▪ Good communication in English, Hindi, and Kannada
▪ Ability to coordinate with international teams

Preferred Industry Background

▪ Rolling stock / railway component manufacturing
▪ Automotive Tier 1 or Tier 2 companies
▪ Customer exposure with Alstom, BEML, Indian Railways, or similar customers preferred

Experience: 7–10 Years for B.E./B.Tech OR 10–12 Years for Diploma

title: Senior Interaction Designer
description:
Interaction Design is a key role at Intuitive, spanning multiple technical disciplines to craft user-friendly experiences for complex medical devices. We bring human-centered design to healthcare innovation and to the development of safe, effective, and confidence-inspiring robotic interfaces.

As a Senior Interaction Designer on the da Vinci team, you will drive design work and product innovation for da Vinci’s multiport and single port systems. You will be involved in all stages of product development from early concepting to final design and implementation, collaborating closely with other designers, Human Factors, engineers, product managers, and clinical experts.

This full-time on-site position is based in our Sunnyvale, CA office.

What You'll Bring

  • You are a human-centered designer motivated by the opportunity to improve the life of patients and tackle novel challenges in healthcare
  • You thrive in highly technical domains, enjoying abstract and often unfamiliar design problems
  • You are comfortable designing for intelligent and semi-autonomous systems, with an understanding of how interfaces communicate system intent, state, confidence, limitations, and next actions to support safe and effective human oversight.
  • You are methodical and drive design decisions through insights and iteration
  • You value design craftsmanship, recognize quality, and expect high standards
  • You believe in collaboration, knowing that success hinges on working closely with other designers and cross-functional partners
  • You are emotionally intelligent and have excellent listening, communication and analytical skills that help you to adapt in a dynamic, cross-functional environment

What You’ll Do

  • Design world-class physical and digital interfaces, upholding superior design standards and methods to deliver product experiences that push the frontier of human-computer interaction.
  • Define the behavior of interactive and intelligent systems, driven by evidence and deep problem understanding. Design macro and micro interactions that communicate system capabilities, state, intent, confidence, and limitations, enabling users to effectively understand, supervise, and collaborate with increasingly sophisticated system behaviors while exploring, prototyping, and iterating through solutions to systematically narrow the solution space.
  • Deliver design solutions that are desirable, feasible and viable, proposing and articulating clear and compelling design solutions with sound rationales. You will take part in evolving the product’s design language to produce beautiful and functional interfaces.
  • Contribute to design documentation and testing, writing clear, comprehensive and detailed user interface specifications for others to build and test against. Consider potential safety and usability risks together with our Human Factors Engineers and design necessary mitigations.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of product design or related field experience (in-house, agency, or freelance work)
  • Expertise in physical or embedded interaction design (beyond web or mobile app interfaces)
  • Proficiency in current design tools and software applications

Required Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Human Factors, or equivalent

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrated expertise across the full design lifecycle, from concept generation and experience definition to detailed interaction design, visual design, motion design, prototyping, and final implementation.
  • Experience designing for 3D, spatial, or AR/VR interactions.
  • Demonstrated systems thinking and experience designing scalable interaction frameworks across products, workflows, and user journeys.
  • Experience designing for complex, intelligent, or highly automated systems where users interact with, supervise, or direct sophisticated system behaviors.
  • Ability to design clear system feedback, controls, and interaction models that help users understand system state, intent, capabilities, and limitations.
  • Ability to articulate design rationale clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success bringing products with complex user interactions to market.

title: Collections & Hardship Consultant
description:

We are looking for several dedicated individuals to join our team in Melbourne as a Customer Service Agent. In this fast-paced position, you will serve as a vital, empathetic voice for customers of renowned Australian Bank - resolving account queries live on our desktop systems and protecting their accounts when security matters arise.

Key Details

  • Full-time (38 hours per week), working 5 days per week across a 7-day operation between 8am to 8pm.

    • Roster Parameters: Full availability required across a 7-day operational window between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. (Rosters are fixed once assigned but subject to client demand, with a minimum of 2 weeks' notice provided for any shift adjustments).

The Role

The primary objective of this consultant is to assist customers in financial hardship via outbound and some inbound calls. The agents will need to display empathy, ask appropriate questions to understand the customers financial situation, then discuss and agree an appropriate solution within the agreed delegation. These solutions include reduced payment plans, payment deferrals and capitalization. In some cases, the agents will be following up or requesting supporting documents from customers. Providing accurate, timely responses with respect and empathy is paramount, as you document all interactions and strive for excellent customer satisfaction on every call.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Adherence & Quality Compliance: Follow all established banking policies, privacy guidelines, and performance metrics (such as NPS, compliance, and transfer rates) to ensure first-time correctness.

  • Collaboration: Work with Team Leaders and support functions like QA and Training to improve customer outcomes.

What you’ll bring

  • Valued Backgrounds: Previous customer service experience in Contact Centres, Banking, Finance, Insurance, Utilities, or corporate environments is highly valued.

  • Technical Agility: Strong computer literacy with the ability to type accurately while actively listening and navigating across multiple digital tabs.

  • Resilience & Focus: The stamina to thrive in a high-volume, 99% call occupancy environment where phone interactions are back-to-back throughout the day.

  • Communication Excellence: Proficient verbal and written communication skills with a focus on active listening and building rapid rapport.

  • Holiday Availability: Full commitment to the contract duration through December 31st, 2026. Due to the critical nature of the seasonal holiday surge, extended leave blocks cannot be accommodated, and availability to work rostered public holidays at a premium pay rate is required.

  • Ability to take coaching feedback and apply it consistently to improve performance.

Why Join Us?

  • Elite Performance Rewards: Excel on your campaign metrics and compete for our massive monthly center prizes! The top three performing agents each month take home an extra $700 (1st Place), $600 (2nd Place), and $500 (3rd Place) in net cash value!

  • Full Wellbeing Benefits: Access our comprehensive, unlimited mental health and well-being platform (Sonder) to empower your personal and professional balance.

  • Access to everyday savings: From technology, phone bills, fuel and groceries to fashion, restaurants and entertainment. Our employee benefits provider Flare can help you save every day with well-known brands

  • Participate in fun group activities like Pizza/takeout days, Office Pyjama days, celebrate holidays/festivals in the office with food and games.

Probe CX is a global business of 9,000 team members. We believe in combining human expertise with technology to deliver exceptional results. Our team members are instrumental in delivering on our promise to provide a human touch to every interaction.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you'll be doing:

The Threat Management Center (TMC) is the first line of defense for Verizon's networks and information systems against misuse and attacks. The TMC performs 24x7x365 monitoring and responds to automated and user-reported cyber security incidents that may impact people and information important to Verizon. The TMC plays an integral role in driving forward the security intelligence and capabilities in Cyber Defense.

Verizon is looking for a second shift innovative and driven leader who will be responsible for enhancing our existing threat defense capabilities and maturing our current processes within Verizon's unique security landscape. A TMC Security Operation Center (SOC) Analyst works in a fast paced collaborative environment and is required to be adaptable, open to learning and teaching, and able to think creatively to effectively navigate the evolving threat landscape. Analysts are required to proactively identify signs of misuse and abuse using various logs and security techniques. This role plays a critical role in Verizon's enterprise Cyber Defense program.

Responsibilities include:

  • Performing day-to-day operations for TMC’s Security Operation Center (SOC).
  • Monitoring security alerts from a variety of different technologies across multiple platforms in order to identify and mitigate security incidents affecting the Verizon enterprise.
  • Assessing potential cyber threats from a variety of intakes workflows and performing appropriate responses like threat containment.
  • Leveraging security tools and logs in order to complete a detailed and accurate assessment of security alerts and threats affecting the Verizon enterprise.
  • Analyzing security, cloud, and application security risks and ensuring threats are detected and mitigated accurately and within required time frames.
  • Providing support and analysis for priority and high profile security incidents.
  • Ensuring the case management and alert development life cycles are followed or adjusted when necessary. This includes writing comprehensive case notes and escalation summaries.
  • Enhancing techniques, workflows and processes to drive the TMC operational and strategic growth (continuous improvement). This includes updating and maintaining process documentation.
  • Collaborating on efforts to support the growth and maturity of ITO’s enhanced monitoring capabilities of critical data and high valued assets.
  • Promoting an environment of collaboration and individual accountability when it comes to problem-solving, decision-making, and process improvements.


Due to the nature of this role, you may be expected to work evenings and/or weekends.

What we’re looking for...
You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Three or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
  • Two or more years of experience in Information Security, Technology or Technical Risk Analysis.
  • Two or more years of experience working with SIEM technologies (i.e. Splunk, SecOps).


Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Experience in SOC utilizing system, cloud, application and network logs.
  • Practical application of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) tools to identify threat patterns, enrich investigations, and build automation-supported workflows.
  • Comprehensive understanding of cyber based adversarial frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and Lockheed Martin’s Cyber Kill Chain.
  • High-level understanding of Operating Systems: Windows, Unix/Linux, and OSX Operating Systems in support of identifying security incidents.
  • Proficient knowledge of the cyber threat landscape including types of adversaries, campaigns, and the motivations that drive them.
  • Experience working with analysis techniques, identifying indicators of compromise, threat hunting, and identification of intrusions and potential incidents.
  • Certifications like: Network+, Security+, CISSP, CISM, and/or CFE.

If this role sounds like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

title: HEAD GUIDE
description:
a luxury four-star lodge located near Musina, Limpopo, is seeking a highly experienced, passionate, and professional Head Guide to lead our guiding department and deliver world-class wilderness experiences.
This live-in role is ideal for a dedicated conservationist and mentor who can manage a guiding team while providing unforgettable, educational, and safe safaris for our local and international guests.



Position Overview
The Head Guide is responsible for the overall management of the guiding department, vehicle fleet, and guest activities. You will lead by example in the field, conducting exceptional game drives, bush walks, and specialized tours (such as trips to the nearby Mapungubwe National Park or local rock art sites). Beyond hosting, you will mentor junior guides, ensure strict safety protocols, and maintain all tracking and game-viewing equipment to the highest standards.

1. Field Guiding & Guest Experience
  • Safari Operations: Conduct professional game drives, interpretive bush walks, and specialized excursions, delivering deep knowledge of local fauna, flora, geology, and cultural history.
  • Guest Hosting: Act as a key host for the lodge, dining with guests when required, managing daily activity schedules, and tailoring safaris to meet diverse guest fitness levels and interests.
  • Safety Excellence: Ensure the absolute safety and comfort of guests at all times by adhering strictly to dangerous game protocols and bush safety regulations.

2. Departmental Leadership & Mentorship
  • Team Management: Manage, schedule, and motivate the guiding team, ensuring high morale and professional conduct.
  • Training & Mentorship: Implement ongoing training programs for junior guides and trackers to elevate their tracking, birding, botany, and guest relation skills.
  • Environmental Stewardship: Ensure all guiding activities comply with environmental legislation and ethical ethical wildlife viewing practices to minimize ecological impact.

3. Fleet, Equipment & Administration
  • Vehicle Maintenance: Oversee the daily checks, cleaning, service schedules, and general upkeep of all open 4x4 safari vehicles.
  • Equipment Control: Manage the maintenance and inventory of guiding equipment, including firearms, ammunition, spotlights, first aid kits, and reference books.
  • Admin Duties: Handle daily activity logs, fuel reconciliations, incidence reporting, and coordinate closely with the Lodge Manager regarding guest schedules.


​

Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications
  • Qualifications: FGASA / CATHSSETA Nature Site Guide NQF4 (Level 2) qualification is required (FGASA Level 3/Professional Field Guide highly preferred).
  • Specialist Qualifications: Valid FGASA Full Trails Guide (or Professional Trails Guide) status with valid Advanced Rifle Handling (ARH) is essential.
  • Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of active guiding experience in big game areas, with at least 1–2 years in a senior or lead guiding capacity within a 4- or 5-star lodge environment.
  • Registrations & Licences: Valid DEAT/NDT registration, valid PrDP (Public Transport Driver’s Permit), and a valid SASSETA firearm proficiency certificate.
  • Attributes: Exceptional communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus), strong leadership capabilities, a sober habit, and a deep love for remote bushveld living.


Benefits


Location: Musina (Messina), Limpopo, South Africa

Salary Range: R15,000 – R25,000 per month (Negotiable based on qualifications and experience)

Benefits: Live-in accommodation,discount on Meals- Meals not included

title: Principal Engineer - Bioprocess Clinical Manufacturing Technology - FSP

description:
We are looking to fill a Principal Engineer position working as a full-time employee of Parexel FSP on long-term assignment onsite at one of our clients located in West Point, PA. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in pharmaceutical/biotech manufacturing and quality systems, with proven expertise in documentation, compliance, and training within a GMP environment. This role is highly focused on supporting raw material release workflows, maintaining strict GMP documentation standards, and ensuring compliance during audits. This position offers full benefits, sick time, 401K, paid holidays, and paid time off. This position does not offer any sponsorship.

Responsibilities

Media & Bulk Product Support

  • Material Release Management: Actively support the timely release of raw materials and culture media by precisely managing RLIMS2 item codes, executing sample log-ins, and generating sample numbers to keep manufacturing timelines on track.

  • Workflow Coordination: Process sample submission forms and accurately manage SWMS requests, serving as a liaison between manufacturing, quality control, and supply chain teams to prevent operational bottlenecks.

  • Data Integrity: Ensure all sample tracking data is entered and maintained with strict adherence to ALCOA+ principles.

Documentation & SOPs

  • Document Lifecycle Management: Draft, author, initiate, review, and approve critical GMP documentation (such as batch records, forms, and technical reports).

  • Continuous Improvement: Actively review existing documentation for clarity, compliance, and process optimization, ensuring all materials align with current regulatory standards and internal quality policies.

  • Workflow Tracking: Drive document workflows through electronic document management systems from draft to final approval.

Quality & Compliance

  • Audit Readiness & Execution: Facilitate and actively participate in internal audits and external agency inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA).

  • Logistical Support: Assist in the preparation of audit materials, support front-room/back-room logistics, and provide real-time documentation retrieval during active inspections.

  • Compliance Culture: Champion a culture of quality by ensuring daily operations remain in a constant state of inspection readiness.

Training & Development

  • Knowledge Transfer: Deliver targeted, comprehensive training to relevant personnel on new procedures, system updates (like RLIMS2), and GMP compliance standards.

  • Training Effectiveness: Evaluate the effectiveness of training sessions and ensure all staff understand the practical application of SOPs in their daily tasks.

  • Record Maintenance: Ensure accurate tracking of training completion within the learning management system.

The Sr. Cloud DevOps Engineer will play a key role in building, automating, and operating secure, scalable multi-cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, GCP, and AWS. In this hands-on role, you will partner with architects, security teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver resilient infrastructure, strengthen automation, and support modern cloud services for a global organization.

What you will do in this role

  • Implement and maintain secure multi-cloud infrastructure across Azure, GCP, and AWS using Terraform and infrastructure as code best practices.

  • Extend and support reusable Terraform modules, including module versioning, remote state management, environment separation, and drift remediation.

  • Build, manage, and improve GitHub-based delivery pipelines, including pull request validation, policy enforcement, and promotion of infrastructure changes across environments.

  • Deploy and operate cloud-native platforms and services, including Kubernetes environments such as AKS, EKS, and GKE, as well as serverless and container-based services.

  • Implement secure, private-by-default networking patterns including VNets/VPCs, subnets, peering, routing, private endpoints, DNS resolution, firewalls, and load balancing.

  • Enforce identity, access, and security controls across cloud environments, including IAM/RBAC, managed identities, workload identity federation, secrets management, encryption, and policy compliance.

  • Monitor platform health and reliability through observability and alerting tools, while contributing to incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to support platform modernization, technical documentation, and operational excellence across distributed environments.

Concentrix is a great match if you:

  • Have 4–7 years of cloud engineering experience, including at least 2 years building and maintaining infrastructure as code in a collaborative team environment.

  • Bring strong hands-on production experience across Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and AWS, with the ability to troubleshoot and support cloud environments effectively.

  • Have solid experience writing, maintaining, and reviewing Terraform configurations, including reusable modules, remote state, and production deployments.

  • Have experience building or maintaining Git-based CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions or equivalent automation pipelines.

  • Understand core cloud networking concepts including VNets/VPCs, subnets, peering, routing, firewalls, private DNS, connectivity troubleshooting, and load balancing.

  • Demonstrate knowledge of cloud security fundamentals including IAM, RBAC, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and compliance-driven controls.

  • Communicate effectively and collaborate well across global, multicultural teams, with comfort working across regions and time zones.

It will be a plus if you:

  • Have experience with identity federation for delivery pipelines, such as OIDC or workload identity federation, in place of long-lived secrets.

  • Have implemented policy-as-code or infrastructure scanning controls using tools such as Checkov, tfsec, or OPA.

  • Bring experience supporting multi-subscription, multi-account, or multi-project governance and landing zone models.

  • Have worked with enterprise secrets management and rotation tools such as Azure Key Vault, Google Secret Manager, or similar services.

  • Have experience with Helm, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, or related platform engineering capabilities.

  • Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms such as AKS, EKS, or GKE in production environments.

  • Hold certifications such as AZ-104 or Google Associate Cloud Engineer; Terraform Associate, AZ-500, or CKA are also valued.

  • Have exposure to FinOps, service mesh, Cloudflare, GitHub Enterprise administration, or AI-enabled cloud services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI.

Power the best version of you!

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

title: Senior Security Engineer – Vulnerability Management
description:
We're not hiring someone to run scans. We're hiring someone to build the engine that finds and closes risk before it becomes an incident. We're looking for a Tech Lead who thinks like an attacker prioritizing targets, not an analyst clearing a scan queue. Someone who owns the full vulnerability lifecycle, builds AI-driven prioritization into the pipeline, and turns remediation into a measurable, automated system instead of a spreadsheet of open tickets.

You'll lead Vulnerability Management across cloud, infrastructure, endpoints, and internal environments - turning every scan, exception, and remediation into a shorter exposure window and a more mature program. The goal isn't to keep the vulnerability count low on a dashboard. It's to make exploitable exposure structurally rare.


Why This Matters

Deriv's mission is Trading for Anyone, Anywhere, Anytime. Millions of traders across the globe, around the clock, across regulatory environments. At this scale, an unpatched exposure sitting past its SLA isn't a compliance footnote - it's a trader's funds at risk and a regulator on the phone.

Vulnerability Management is a core defensive layer for a platform that never stops processing transactions. When new assets, cloud workloads, and code ship continuously, your discovery and remediation engine can't fall behind - which is exactly why this role exists to turn Vulnerability Management into a fully automated, intelligence-driven function.


The Challenge

Most vulnerability programs are a scan, a spreadsheet, and a monthly report nobody reads until an audit forces the question. That's not this role.

You'll own the vulnerability lifecycle end to end: discovery, enrichment, risk-based prioritization, remediation, validation, and executive reporting, across AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, containers, endpoints, and network infrastructure. You'll be building automated workflows and AI-assisted prioritization that cut exposure windows quarter over quarter, not chasing CVSS scores in isolation.

If your idea of vulnerability management is exporting a Qualys report and emailing it to engineering, this isn't for you. If you want to architect an automation-first vulnerability engine at global scale and be the technical authority behind it, keep reading.


Why Deriv

Deriv protects millions of global traders across distributed platforms and cloud environments. Vulnerability Management is a core defensive layer here, not an afterthought bolted onto compliance - and this role is designed to transform it into a measurable, automation-driven, intelligence-led capability with direct impact on enterprise risk reduction.


What You’ll Do
  • Own the full vulnerability lifecycle: discovery, enrichment, prioritization, remediation, validation, and executive reporting
  • Lead the operation and optimization of Qualys VMDR (Cloud Agents, SCA, PCI, dashboards, tagging, scan profiles) across AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes and container workloads, endpoints (macOS, Windows, Linux), and office/network infrastructure
  • Implement risk-based prioritization using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, and asset criticality, and design sustainable exception management and risk acceptance governance
  • Define and enforce remediation SLAs across engineering and IT, and reduce exposure windows (MTTR) and aging vulnerabilities quarter over quarter
  • Correlate vulnerability findings with CSPM insights, IAM exposure, and threat intelligence to prioritize exploitable and externally exposed assets
  • Strengthen integration between vulnerability data, SIEM, EDR, and cloud-native security controls, and support hardening aligned with CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and DORA
  • Design automated workflows for vulnerability intake, ticket creation, assignment, tracking, and remediation validation across scanning platforms, workflow tools, and internal security systems
  • Use AI to enrich vulnerability context (exploitability, clustering, attack path, asset importance) and implement secure automated patching where technically validated and risk-appropriate
  • Act as the bridge between Global Security Operations and local IT/Engineering, aligning vulnerability data with detection engineering and blue team strategy
  • Serve as the technical authority for Vulnerability Management in Cyberjaya, mentoring analysts in risk-based triage and exploit analysis, and representing the function during audits and architecture reviews


Who You Are
  • 8-12+ years of cybersecurity experience with deep specialization in vulnerability management
  • Expert-level experience with Qualys VMDR (or equivalent: Tenable, Rapid7)
  • Strong understanding of exploit intelligence, risk scoring models, and vulnerability lifecycle governance
  • Hands-on experience across cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure), CSPM integrations, endpoint patching and configuration management, and SIEM/EDR correlation
  • Strong automation capability: Python, Bash, API integrations, workflow automation
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted prioritization or remediation workflows
  • Proven ability to build dashboards and KPIs that influence executive decisions
  • Experience operating in regulated environments (ISO 27001, GDPR, PCI-DSS, DORA)
  • Strong communicator who can translate technical exposure into business risk


The Honest Reality

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who builds systems, not just processes. You'll raise findings and SLA breaches that aren't always welcome, and you'll be accountable for exposure windows in a regulated environment where a slipped patch cycle is a real finding, not a rounding error.
But you'll get high ownership and strategic influence within a global fintech security organization, the room to architect automation-first vulnerability management at scale, and direct impact on enterprise risk reduction alongside competitive compensation and a long-term leadership growth path.
If you want to run scans and forward reports, this isn't it. If you want to build the vulnerability engine that makes exploitable exposure the exception instead of the norm, it might be.

Start: Omgående, intervjuer sker löpande och kan komma tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag Plats: Från vårt kontor i Jönköping Omfattning: 1 tjänst heltid 40 timmar i veckan . Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten Anställningsform: Tillsvidare, vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning

Urvalsprocessen sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Sabine Lövquist

Operativ chef via mejl . sabine.lovquist@nordstromassistans.se

Personlighetstester som komplement till din ansökan Under rekryteringen kan vi komma att genomföra personlighetstester som en del i vår urvalsprocess. Tester gör urvalsprocessen mer träffsäker och rättvis för dig som söker arbete hos oss och återkopplar till det som är relevant för tjänsten.

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling, lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige.

En del av Team Olivia

Nordström assistans ingår i koncernen Team Olivia. Team Olivia har utvecklats till ett ledande omsorgsföretag med att etablerade bolag under lokala varumärken med verksamheter i Sverige. Role: Senior FCC / RF Infrastructure Analyst

Location: Omaha, NE (Onsite – 5 days a week)

Job Description
We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically curious Senior FCC / RF Infrastructure Analyst to support critical FCC and RF licensing activities across wireless and microwave network environments. In this role, you will lead regulatory support efforts including licensing, renewals, modifications, and compliance documentation, while serving as a key coordination point across engineering, legal, vendors, and field teams. This position also offers the opportunity to grow into RF path analysis and microwave design support, making it ideal for a professional who combines regulatory rigor with a strong interest in technical network engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Support FCC-related licensing activities, including new applications, renewals, modifications, and associated regulatory documentation

  • Assist with spectrum coordination and compliance activities for wireless and microwave systems

  • Partner with internal engineering, legal, and external vendors to support timely and accurate regulatory submissions

  • Track licensing records, project milestones, assets, and installation status to help ensure smooth project execution

  • Serve as a technical coordination point between engineering teams and internal field technicians during deployment activities

  • Help resolve issues through proactive communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration

  • Support execution of infrastructure projects by maintaining clear status updates and coordinating next steps across stakeholders

  • Learn and assist with RF path analysis for microwave and point-to-point systems

  • Support path feasibility reviews, basic link budget analysis, and design validation activities

  • Contribute to engineering documentation, technical artifacts, and project records as skills and experience continue to grow

Qualifications

  • Experience with FCC and RF licensing, renewals, modifications, and regulatory processes

  • Background in telecommunications, wireless, or microwave network environments

  • Strong documentation skills with exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined approach to regulatory compliance

  • Ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, legal, vendors, and field operations

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Working knowledge of wireless or microwave systems and spectrum coordination practices

  • Exposure to RF path analysis, microwave design tools, or related engineering workflows preferred

  • Interest in learning RF path engineering concepts, including feasibility reviews, link budgets, and design validation

  • Experience supporting technical deployments, installation tracking, or infrastructure project coordination preferred

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, solve problems, and adapt as project needs evolve

title: Contracts Superintendent/Specialist
description:
Join us as a Contracts Superintendent/Specialist where you’ll act as the key interface between site operations and corporate Supply Chain, with a strong focus on category management/contract management and supplier performance. This role is about ensuring contracts deliver real value at site.

This is a full-time permanent role based on site at our Aquila Mine and reports into our Supply Chain Manager based in Brisbane.

Key accountabilities also include:

  • Support central Supply Chain and Commercial functions with planning activities, strategy development, strategy execution and reporting aligned to site priorities
  • Monitor and optimise contracts to drive safety, performance and cost outcomes
  • Lead tender processes, including scope development, supplier engagement and bid evaluations
  • Lead contract performance and governance, including KPIs and compliance
  • Support contract variations, commercial decisions and supplier selection
  • Partner closely with site teams to align operational needs with full lifecycle Supply Chain delivery
  • Extensive experience in category management and contract management (implementation, performance, governance)
  • Background in mining, heavy industry or asset-based environments
  • Experience supporting tenders, sourcing or procurement activities
  • Skilled in stakeholder engagement and influencing operational teams
  • Commercially minded, with a focus on value delivery through contracts
  • Relevant qualifications in field (Supply Chain Management, Logistics & Supply Chain, Finance, Business, etc.)
  • Hold current S1, 2, 3 & G2 Supervisor qualification.
  • Previous experience with SAP or a similar ERP will be desirable.
  • Focused on performance, safety and continuous improvement
  • Permanent, full-time positions at Aquila Mine, based in Middlemount QLD
  • Monday to Friday roster with 9-day fortnight available
  • Competitive Salary + 12% Superannuation
  • Annual bonus incentive program
  • Residential, FIFO (company funded) & DIDO options
  • Subsidised accommodation and company funded camp options provided
  • Relocation Assistance available (company funded)
  • Employee Assistance Program for employees and their family

What we offer
When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programmes, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too. We’re a large, successful multinational company – and we’re still growing all the time.

Who we are
We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. As the custodians of coal and other precious natural resources – diamonds (through De Beers), copper, platinum and other precious metals, iron ore and nickel – our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively, with the utmost consideration for local communities, our customers and the world at large.

Background checks
Successful candidates will be required to complete background screening which may include a criminal check and validation of qualifications.

Inclusion and Diversity
At Anglo American, we embrace change and promote an inclusive and diverse environment where you can bring your whole self to work, every day. We are adopting new approaches to recruitment, talent development, mentoring, parental leave, and flexible working to further support diversity across our business.

How we are committed to your safety
Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

How to apply
To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process.

The position requires regular and predictable attendance. Scheduled shifts may include evening hours, weekends, and holidays.

Physical Demands:

Must be able to lift up to (50) pounds. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

Environment Demands:

Duties are performed primarily in the service area. Work includes movement around vehicles, working in various physical positions, and the safe operation of power tools and test equipment. May be exposed to loud noise, vibration, exhaust fumes, and other service and repair conditions. Frequently interacts with customers, service advisors and the service manager.

Verbal and Writing Ability:

Ability to read and comprehend instructions, correspondence, and memos. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers and other employees.

Math Ability:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions. Ability to deal with standardized situations. Ability to understand and follow technical manuals.

Core Values:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following Core Values:

Servant Leadership

Servant Leaders consciously put the needs of others before their own, because to serve people is to value them.

Teamwork through Trust & Respect

Diversity is strength, and when we trust and respect one another we can work as a team to achieve at a high level.

Integrity

Being honest and transparent with people, in an effort to do the right thing within the letter and spirit of the law, drives every action we take and every decision we make.

Commitment to Customer Enthusiasm

Every day we recommit ourselves to the customer experience, and we are empowered to exceed the expectations of our customers.

Passion for Winning

Hendrick’s tradition of winning is based on the idea of striving to be the best, not the biggest, and is therefore defined by how we treat our people.

Accountability at All Levels

Taking ownership of our actions and our decisions allows us to grow as individuals, and support each other as a team.

Commitment to Continuous Improvement

Every day we soften our hearts as well as our egos, in order to seek out and improve upon areas of opportunity within ourselves and our team.

title: Analista Técnico de Seguros Senior (Placement)
description:
ANALISTA TECNICO DE SEGUROS SENIOR (PLACEMENT)

Estamos buscando una persona talentosa para unirse a nuestro equipo Técnico / Placement en Marsh. Este rol estará basado en Bogotá, Colombia (Central Point – Calle 25G). Es un rol híbrido que requiere trabajar al menos tres días a la semana en la oficina. Esta es una posición de tiempo completo, brindando soporte a México (con articulación y equipo en Colombia).

En esta posición brindarás soporte técnico y operativo en procesos de cotización, análisis comparativo de ofertas y elaboración de materiales de presentación para clientes, asegurando precisión, oportunidad y calidad en la información enviada a aseguradoras y clientes. Es un rol con mayor seniority, por lo que se espera autonomía en la gestión, seguimiento y control de entregables, así como un enfoque fuerte en análisis y comunicación clara de información técnica.


Contaremos contigo para:

  • Elaborar slips de cotización conforme a la información proporcionada por el equipo comercial y técnico, asegurando completitud y consistencia técnica.
  • Gestionar solicitudes de cotización con aseguradoras, dando seguimiento puntual a requerimientos, respuestas y aclaraciones, manteniendo control del proceso y tiempos de respuesta.
  • Preparar comparativos de ofertas recibidas de aseguradoras, identificando diferencias clave en coberturas, condiciones, exclusiones, primas y deducibles, y destacando hallazgos relevantes para la toma de decisiones.
  • Elaborar presentaciones para clientes con la información de placement de manera clara, estructurada y profesional, coordinando con el área de marketing cuando aplique.
  • Asegurar la correcta integración, revisión y actualización de la información técnica utilizada en los procesos de colocación, garantizando calidad y trazabilidad.
  • Dar seguimiento a tiempos de respuesta, entregables y validaciones con las áreas involucradas, asegurando cumplimiento de fechas y estándares de calidad.
  • Apoyar en la organización y control de documentación relacionada con el proceso de cotización y placement, promoviendo orden y fácil acceso a la información.


Lo que necesitas tener:

  • Licenciatura concluida o en proceso de titulación en Actuaría, Matemáticas, Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines (evitar perfiles de Derecho/Abogacía, por tratarse de un enfoque distinto).
  • 3 a 5 años de experiencia en procesos de cotización, análisis de ofertas, placement o áreas técnicas de seguros.
  • Excel intermedio alto o avanzado (idealmente con tablas dinámicas y dashboards).
  • Capacidad para analizar información técnica y presentarla de forma clara, ejecutiva y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
  • Inglés básico a intermedio (deseable).


Lo que te hace destacar:

  • Experiencia elaborando slips, comparativos y presentaciones para clientes, con alto estándar de precisión y calidad.
  • Dominio deseable de PowerPoint (por interacción con el área de marketing para materiales y presentaciones).
  • Conocimiento sólido de procesos de cotización y placement y manejo de múltiples stakeholders simultáneamente.
  • Habilidad para priorizar, dar seguimiento y asegurar cumplimiento de tiempos en un entorno de alta demanda.


Por qué unirte a nuestro equipo: • Te ayudamos a ser tu mejor versión a través de oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, trabajo interesante y líderes que te apoyan.
• Fomentamos una cultura vibrante e inclusiva donde puedes trabajar con colegas talentosos para crear nuevas soluciones y tener impacto en colegas, clientes y comunidades.
• Nuestra escala nos permite ofrecer una variedad de oportunidades de carrera, así como beneficios y recompensas para mejorar tu bienestar.

  • Modalidad híbrida: 3 días en oficina y 2 días en casa.
