title: Inventory Specialist
description:
• Responsible for executing, monitoring, and training inventory best practices and standard operating procedures for the entire store, including both front end and pharmacy. Supports pharmacy inventory management activities, including receiving, counting, ordering, and facilitating returns. Champions On-Shelf Availability and is responsible for receiving, counting, pricing, returns, and all in-store inventory processes. Validates and ensures accuracy of planograms.
  • Responsible for reviewing and coordinating the proper use of reports and system applications, which have an impact on the accuracy of front end and pharmacy on-hand balances and pricing.
  • Responsible for executing and maintaining front end and pharmacy asset protection techniques, and filing claims for warehouse and vendor overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods including prescription drugs.
  • In designated stores, as required, opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling and cashier responsibilities, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day.
Customer Experience
  • Engages customers by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
Operations
  • Executes and coaches team members on warehouse and vendor inventory management processes including but not limited to creating, reviewing, and receiving orders.
  • Scans in all deliveries while the vendor is still in the store, including common carrier deliveries. Focuses on One Box receiving. Takes the appropriate action marking delivery as received if the product was physically delivered, contacting vendor for past undelivered scheduled receipts, and opening tickets as needed to correct inaccurate orders.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, verifies all pharmacy shipments are posted for products physically received at the store. Completes or verifies postings of all pharmacy warehouse orders, ABC prescription and OTC orders daily, secondary vendor orders, flu and dropship orders performing any necessary tote audits, and accurately reporting any shortages or damaged product.
  • Completes On-Shelf Availability (OSA) end-to-end process including warehouse and direct store delivery (DSD) for planogrammed departments, executing disposals, call-ins, and vendor returns before expiration, completes scan outs/ scan outs returns on all subscribed departments including vendor/ DSD departments and pharmacy scan outs.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge,completes pharmacy inventory activities including but not limited to pharmacy recalls following Pharmacy Hazardous Waste Policy, vendor returns, non-controlled, and damaged salvage returns. Facilitates excess inventory returns or interstore pharmacy transfers where applicable for non-returnable ABC overstock. Verifies posting of all pharmacy/ prescription claims.
  • Completes execution of all pricing activities including price changes, markdowns, and markdowns deletes. Responsible for basic department pricing, including daily price changes, accurate pricing with correct signage, and reliable and timely completion of any additional regulatory pricing tasks.
  • Responsible for supporting front end and pharmacy ordering by ordering expense items. Monitors pharmacy manual orders to identify excess orders. Maintains consigned inventory and orders as required.
  • Ensures all designated pull & quarantine item on-hands are updated and placed in the designated holding area.
  • Maintains accurate inventory counts. Maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including but not limited to basic departments, stockroom, overstock locations.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, maintains accurate inventory counts and accuracy of on-hand quantities in pharmacy and completes pharmacy smart counts.
  • Ensures the store maintains inventory compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
  • Assists in the maintenance of inventory records, including receiving and posting of all products (in the front-end)) received at the store in all inventory systems. Organizes files and retains all invoices/receipts/return authorizations necessary for all inventory activities.
  • Helps to prepare for physical inventory and supports the physical inventory day activities, including but not limited to preparing sales floor, stockroom, and pharmacy for inventory and auditing the third party team on the day of inventory.
  • Supports keeping all counters and shelves clean and well merchandised.
  • Knowledgeable of all store systems and equipment.
  • Assists and coaches store team on all package delivery activities, including scanning in and out of packages, completing all daily inventory functions and, package returns at Walgreens. Supports execution of Pickup Program.
  • In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned point-of-sale system (POS), including records of scanning errors, price verifications, items not on file, price modifications, and voids. Completes product returns, order voids, customer refunds, cash drops to safe, and provides change as requested for point of sale.
  • Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
  • Completes any additional activities and other tasks as assigned.
Training & Personal Development
  • Attends company-based trainings for continuous development and completes all e-learning modules including safety training requirements.
  • Obtains and maintains a valid pharmacy license/certification as required by the state.
Communications
  • Serves as a liaison between management and non-management team members by coaching and developing other capabilities with inventory systems. When serving as the leader on duty, communicates assigned tasks to team members and reports disciplinary issues and customer complaints to management.


Basic Qualifications
  • Six months of prior work experience with Walgreens (internal candidates) or one year of prior retail work experience (external candidates).
  • Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English (except in Puerto Rico).
  • Must have a willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
  • “Achieving expectations” rating on last performance review and no written disciplinary actions in the previous 12 months (internal candidates only).
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to multi task and manage execution.
  • Experience in identifying operational issues and recommending and implementing strategies to resolve problems.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Prefer previous experience as a shift lead, pharmacy technician, designated hitter, or customer service associate.
  • Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens, with an evaluation on file.
We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The Senior IT Portfolio & Governance Lead supports the execution and continuous improvement of IT portfolio management and governance processes across the IT organization. This role coordinates demand intake, prioritization activities, portfolio reporting, and governance administration to help ensure initiatives are evaluated consistently and aligned with business priorities. The position partners with project managers, resource managers, and business stakeholders to maintain portfolio data, facilitate governance processes, and support informed decision-making.

This position partners closely with IT and business leadership, as well as project and resource managers, to ensure governance practices are applied consistently and effectively. The successful candidate brings strong business acumen, analytical thinking, and communication skills, along with deep experience in PMO and Project Portfolio Management (PPM) frameworks and tools. This role requires strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills, and a commitment to providing guidance and support to project teams while maintaining a high standard of data integrity and confidentiality.

This position is part of the IT PMO within the Digital Enablement (Office of the CIO) group and will be a Remote position located in the USA. At Cepheid, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Support and continuously improve IT portfolio governance processes, including demand intake, prioritization, portfolio reviews, reporting activities, governance administration, and evaluation of initiatives against established business priorities and capacity constraints.
  • Maintain portfolio data integrity and governance visibility by supporting adherence to governance standards, preparing portfolio reports, dashboards, metrics, and analytics, and facilitating governance discussions, decision-making, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Support PMO process adoption and operational excellence through continuous improvement of PMO processes, tools, operating procedures, governance practices, stakeholder engagement, and communication initiatives that promote awareness and understanding of PMO services and standards.
  • Develop and maintain PMO tools, templates, and knowledge assets, including governance artifacts, demand and portfolio management templates, project lifecycle documentation, knowledge repositories, and project information used in governance reviews, while ensuring consistency and accuracy across project repositories.
  • Provide guidance, training, and support to project managers, resource managers, and project teams on PMO processes, tools, templates, methodologies, portfolio management practices, and governance requirements.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting PMO operations, portfolio management, governance, demand management, or related functions, including 3-5 years of experience working with project and portfolio management methodologies.
  • Experience supporting project or program delivery activities within IT organizations, including preparation of portfolio reports, governance materials, dashboards, and executive presentations.
  • Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to support governance processes and effectively collaborate across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, and Copilot, to support portfolio management, reporting, and governance activities.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Supporting or leading enterprise portfolio governance forums, including demand intake reviews, prioritization sessions, and portfolio decision cadences
  • Managing and maintaining governance artifacts, systems and repositories used as the system of record.

description:

Let’s be real: ER nursing isn’t a job, it’s a calling. Your connection to your ER, your patients, your team, it’s deep and personal. We love that about you.

You bring all of you to the Emergency Room every shift, every patient. And then, you take a lot of the ER home with you—the tough moments, the hopes, the tears, the possibilities, the unanswered questions, the thank you’s, the heartaches and, yes, even the smiles and laughter.

Contribute to the team by assisting others without being asked.

Minimum:

License/Certification:
Valid Louisiana license or temporary permit to practice professional nursing.
American Heart Association BLS-HCP.
Current ACLS-HCP (New grad must obtain within 6 months of hire).
BSN preferred.

Experience in an acute care hospital, preferred.

Note: A minimum of 1-year professional nursing experience is required for per diem, Flex-PRN positions.

title: Security Officer Full-Time 2nd Shift - Huntington Convention Center of Cleveland
description:
Legends Global, the leader event and facilities management, has an opening for a Full-Time Security Officer at the Huntington Convention Center of Cleveland. The Security Officer participates in the day-to-day functions of promoting and ensuring both security and safety in the Huntington Convention Center of Cleveland and the Global Center for Health Innovation. The Security Officer provides direction, safety and security for any event related activity as required.

3pm - 11:30pm

Pay: $16/HR

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Secures premises, personnel and guests of the facility by patrolling property.

  • Maintains a safe and calm environment through crowd control, monitoring of facility cameras, challenging and removing those who are uninvited or do not have business with the facility.

  • Confidently maneuver through facility to complete duties, security checks, or emergency situations.

  • Communicate, greet, and provide information or directions to all guests in a courteous and helpful manner.

  • Conduct and document routine property walks around the building that will include:

    • Patrol Service Corridors and employee break rooms

    • Patrol Mechanical and electrical rooms to assure doors are locked

    • Patrol Event Halls and Pre-function Areas

    • Control flow of truck and vehicular traffic during move in and move out on loading dock

    • Perform routine patrols inside and outside perimeter rounds

    • Restrict access to non-event personnel or employees

    • Direct people and trucks to relevant event places

  • Locks and unlocks facility doors during routine patrols and upon request

  • Control access and exit from the facilities loading dock and perform vehicle screening prior to entry or exit.

  • Responds to emergency situations, including but not limited to appropriate use of CPR and/or AED.

  • Complete detailed reports on activity during shift and maintains daily log of activities through computer modules and software programs

  • Operate and monitor computerized fire alarm and surveillance camera systems as required.

  • Operate and control facility command center.

  • Maintain constant radio communication with Command Center.

  • Performs other duties/responsibilities as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Experience

  • High School Diploma/equivalent required.

  • Minimum 6 months security experience preferred.

  • OPOTA Certification beneficial but not required.

  • CPR, First Aid, AED (obtain and maintain through employment as necessary)

  • Maintain a valid drivers’ license or have willingness and ability to obtain for required equipment operation

Skills and Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; fluent in English language.

  • Outstanding interpersonal skills: must display utmost customer service to all clients, guests, and employees.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality as necessary regarding the Company, events, clients, co-workers and all related matters regarding such parties.

  • Detail oriented and excellent organizational skills: accuracy is essential.

  • Ability to work and function both independently and in a team environment

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to use sound judgment in emergency situations.

  • Ability to perform duties efficiently under emergency situations, and to make firm decisions during emergency

  • Must have excellent critical thinking, problem solving, organizational, and multi-tasking skills.

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and address the most critical and pressing demands first.

  • Successfully perform different tasks at once and comfortably switch gears at a moment’s notice.

  • Ability to clearly instruct others on processes and follow-up, as necessary.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate motorized vehicles.

  • Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, which could include overtime, evenings/nights, holidays, weekends, or emergency call-in services as dictated by business need or event activity.

Computer Skills

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual should be proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.

  • Surveillance (CCTV) Skills, preferred but not required

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

This position requires the duties be completed in both indoor and outdoor environments ranging from both quiet and noisy atmospheres. This position is exposed to outside weather conditions and temperature changes, adverse weather conditions, dust, dirt, cleaning agent odors, heavy crowds of people, and other working conditions expected within a public forum. Position is exposed to moderate to high noise levels and bright and/or flashing lights along with limited exposure to airborne inhalants such as vehicular exhaust, dust and/or cleaning solutions while performing duties.

While performing the duties of this job, the position may also require:

  • Personal mobility around all areas of the facility, climbing stairs or ladders, working from various heights, walking on ice or slippery surfaces, bending, stooping, kneeling occasionally

  • Standing or sitting for sustained amounts of time.

  • Lifting, carrying, pushing/pulling items of at least 75 pounds and/or strenuous working conditions

  • Manual dexterity, good vision, balance and steadiness of the arm and hand for equipment operation.

  • Vision, hearing and speech frequently used or communications and speaking, judging distances, reading signs, listening to others in a public forum or noisy atmosphere.

  • Work hours are based on facility or event needs; hours vary by business or event needs and may include irregular, extended hours including weekends, evenings, nights, and holidays.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Also, this document in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position.

title: Red Team Operator
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

As a Red Team Operator in the telecommunications industry, you will play a critical role in proactively identifying vulnerabilities and security gaps within Verizon’s infrastructure, applications, and processes. This role focuses on emulating real-world adversarial techniques to evaluate and improve Verizon’s defensive capabilities, ensuring the security of customer data and network infrastructure.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams to simulate advanced persistent threats and execute red team engagements tailored to the unique challenges of the telecommunications sector. This position requires an understanding of telco-specific systems, such as enterprise-scale complex networks, 4G & 5G wireless network infrastructure, cloud technology, and more. Strong understanding of network equipment and networking protocols is required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Adversary Emulation: Conduct red team exercises that emulate realistic threats targeting telco-specific systems, including wireline/wireless network infrastructure and supporting systems.

  • Vulnerability Exploitation: Identify, exploit, and report vulnerabilities in critical telco systems and infrastructure

  • Attack Vector Development: Design and execute sophisticated attack paths, including advanced network intrusions and identification of high value targets

  • Post-Engagement Reporting: Deliver comprehensive technical reports and executive summaries that outline findings, exploit paths, and remediation recommendations

  • Collaboration: Work closely with blue team to develop detection and prevention strategies informed by red team exercises

  • Tool Development: Build or customize tools, scripts, and exploits for red team operations

  • Threat Intelligence: Stay updated on the latest attack techniques, tactics, and procedures (TTPs) relevant to the telecommunications industry

  • Continuous Improvement: Provide insights to enhance the organization’s security posture through collaboration with peers in both security and operations

Where you'll be working…

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days in one of the offices listed for this position, or any other Verizon office.

What are we looking for :

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field or four or more years of work experience.

  • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.

  • Three or more years’ relevant Red Team, Penetration testing or security experience.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, or OSEP or GIAC certifications like GPEN, GXPN, or GWAPT

  • Familiarity with security challenges in running Internet-scale networks, wireless core components, cloud, and edge computing

  • Expertise in telecommunications systems, protocols (SIP, SS7/Diameter, TR-69, etc)

  • Expertise in 4G/5G core network architecture, and supporting systems.

  • Industry Knowledge: Strong foundational knowledge in enterprise networking technologies and protocols (routers, switches, VPN, load balancers, TCP/IP, Internet numbering – IP, ASN, CIDR, subnetting, etc)

  • Strong Linux skills

  • Proficiency in Red Team and Penetration Testing tools such as Burp Suite, Cobalt Strike, Nmap, Metasploit, etc

  • Coding and scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.). Ability to vet exploit code to understand what it does

  • Solid understanding of network architecture and cloud environments (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenStack, OpenShift)

  • Problem Solving: Ability to think like an attacker and devise innovative attack scenarios targeting telco environments

  • Soft Skills: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to effectively interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. title: Advanced Guestroom Attendant
description:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

No matter the season, Jackson Hole offers a lifestyle built around outdoor adventure, meaningful connections, and unforgettable moments. Surrounded by the iconic peaks of Grand Teton and the natural beauty of nearby Yellowstone National Park, Four Seasons Resort and Residences Jackson Hole offers more than a workplace. It’s an inspiring place to grow your career, build community, and explore year-round. From world renowned skiing and snowboarding in the winter to hiking, wildlife viewing, and endless outdoor recreation throughout the warmer months, there’s always something new to discover in heart of the American West.

Responsibilities

  • Perform thorough cleaning and sanitization of guest rooms, suites, and assigned areas in accordance with hotel standards and brand expectations.

  • Conduct detailed self-inspections of completed rooms to ensure cleanliness, presentation, and functionality meet quality requirements before releasing rooms for guest occupancy.

  • Identify, report, and follow up on maintenance issues, safety hazards, and equipment deficiencies to ensure a safe and comfortable guest environment.

  • Maintain exceptional attention to detail when inspecting room amenities, linens, furnishings, and guest supplies to ensure all items are properly stocked and presented.

  • Consistently achieve and maintain high quality scores during internal audits, management inspections, and brand evaluations.

  • Utilize established inspection checklists and operational procedures to verify compliance with housekeeping standards and cleanliness protocols.

  • Support the training and mentoring of team members by demonstrating best practices in cleaning techniques, room presentation, and self-inspection processes.

  • Accurately document room status updates, inspection results, maintenance requests, and inventory needs using hotel systems and reporting tools.

  • Collaborate with Housekeeping Supervisors, Front Desk, and Engineering teams to ensure timely room readiness and outstanding guest satisfaction.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement by taking ownership of room quality and proactively correcting deficiencies before guest arrival

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of housekeeping procedures, cleaning chemicals, and hotel cleanliness standards.

  • Excellent eye for detail and ability to identify quality deficiencies.

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule. This may include some evenings, weekends and holidays.

  • Basic level of English is required.

  • Previous hotel housekeeping experience with quality assurance or self-inspection responsibilities preferred.

  • Ability to push, pull, lift up to 40lbs.

  • Ability to kneel, crouch and reach.

  • Walk up to 8 hours per shift.

  • Successful candidate must possess legal work authorization in the United States.

Benefits!

title: Handläggare Kompetensförsörjning
description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens skola i Piteå genom att säkra rätt kompetens?

Regeringens stora reformpaket inom skolan ställer förändrade krav på kompetens och behörighet hos lärare och personal inom förskola och skola. Utbildningsförvaltningen i Piteå står därför inför många spännande utmaningar och vi söker dig som är initiativrik, gillar utmaningar och vill vara med och bidra till en bättre vardag för barn och elever i våra förskolor och skolor. Hos oss får du ett utvecklande arbete där du verkligen gör skillnad. Förvaltningen har ca 1500 medarbetare och ansvarar för Piteå kommuns förskolor och skolor.

Bemanningsenheten

Kompetensförsörjning är en central och prioriterad framtidsfråga inom Utbildningsförvaltningen. För att möta framtidens behov utökar vi Bemanningsenheten med en ny roll i form av en handläggare kompetensförsörjning.

Bemanningsenheten inom Utbildningsförvaltningen arbetar med förvaltningens vikariepool, som består av omkring 140 medarbetare. Enheten består idag av två administratörer som hanterar både rekrytering till poolen samt bemannar förvaltningens verksamheter med vikarier för såväl kortare som längre vikariebehov i kommunens alla förskolor och skolor. Just nu står Bemanningsenheten inför en spännande utvecklingsresa med målet att ytterligare stärka och effektivisera vårt strategiska arbete och hitta nya vägar för en lyckad och långvarig kompetensförsörjning inom hela förvaltningen. I detta arbete kommer handläggare kompetensförsörjning att få en central roll med stort ansvar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som handläggare kompetensförsörjning ingår du i Bemanningsenheten och är direkt underställd verksamhetschef för ekonomi och planering. Du har en central och strategiskt viktig roll i arbetet med att säkerställa en långsiktig och hållbar kompetensförsörjning inom Utbildningsförvaltningen. Med ett övergripande helhetsperspektiv bidrar du till att utveckla och samordna förvaltningens arbete inom området.

Som handläggare kompetensförsörjning arbetar du med att:

  • analysera framtida kompetensbehov och driva rekryteringsstrategier för personal inom Utbildningsförvaltningen
  • planera och implementera strategier för personalens fortbildning
  • leda processer och ta fram underlag för Utbildningsförvaltningens kompetensförsörjningsarbete
  • arbeta nära rektorer, HR och externa aktörer för att stärka skolans attraktionskraft som arbetsgivare
  • tjänsten innefattar även att föredra både strategiska och operativa frågor inom kompetensförsörjning för förvaltningen ledningsgrupp och den politiska nämnden, samt representera Utbildningsförvaltningen i olika kommunövergripande arbetsgrupper.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är en positiv och serviceinriktad person som trivs i mötet med nya människor. Du har en god förmåga att se helheter, bygga relationer och uppskattar en roll där du får kombinera operativt arbete med strategiskt tänkande. För att lyckas i uppdraget är du självgående, strukturerad och tar ett tydligt ansvar för ditt arbete.

Du har:

  • relevant högskoleutbildning eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
  • erfarenhet av rekryterings- eller personalarbete, gärna inom offentlig sektor
  • god förmåga att analysera behov, se samband och driva processer framåt
  • god systemvana och ett strukturerat arbetssätt
  • förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för ditt uppdrag

Det är meriterande om du har kunskap inom arbetsrätt samt erfarenhet av arbete med kompetensförsörjning.

Övrigt

Tillsvidareanställning 100%. Tillträdesdatum enligt överenskommelse.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-13

Om arbetsplatsen

Utbildningsförvaltningen är en av kommunens sju förvaltningar. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att skapa välfärd och hållbar samhällsutveckling. Tillsammans med pitebor, näringsliv och föreningar utvecklar vi Piteå till en ännu bättre plats att bo, leva och verka i.

Letar du bostad, vill du veta mer om skola och barnomsorg eller är du nyfiken på kultur- och fritidsutbudet? Move to Piteå erbjuder dig stöd från start till mål.

title: OSHC Coordinator | Mitchelton State School
description:
Helping Hands Mitchelton is seeking an inspiring and motivated OSHC Coordinator to join our growing Helping Hands service. This is an exciting opportunity to step into a key leadership role where you’ll shape culture, drive quality, and make a genuine difference in the lives of children and your team.

This is a permanent, full-time role (38 hours per week) working across split shifts, Monday to Friday, including 8 hours of dedicated non‑contact administrative time to support your success.

Service hours include:

  • Rise Then Shine: 6:30am – 9:00am
  • Stay and Play: 2:30pm – 6:00pm
  • School Holidays: Block shifts between 6:30am – 6:00pm

Why You'll Love Working With Us

  • Work-Life Balance: Our split shift model gives you your middle of the day back, so you can study, manage family life, or enjoy personal time.
  • Competitive Pay: Up to $43 per hour + super, rewarding the important role you play every day.
  • Onsite Service Manager Support: Leading a service doesn't mean doing it alone. Your Service Manager will provide coaching, guidance and practical support every step of the way.
  • Coordinator Loyalty Program: Enjoy $1,250 in retention bonuses during your first year as a thank you.
  • Family-Friendly Support: Access paid parental leave (10 weeks) and up to 50% off childcare fees, supporting you and your family now and in the future.
  • Career Growth & Development: Build your skills through paid training and clear pathways to progress within JAG.
  • Health, Wellbeing & Lifestyle Benefits: Access discounted gym & wellbeing memberships, health insurance and retail savings, helping your money go further.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn $1,000 cash for every successful referral and help us grow our exceptional team.

🏫 About Mitchelton State School

Mitchelton Helping Hands is a growing service supporting around 60 children each morning and 105 each afternoon, with exciting potential for further growth. Enjoy a dedicated OSHC space, a consistent team of educators and strong involvement in the wider school community, with an experienced Service Manager onsite to provide ongoing support and guidance.

About your new role

As a Coordinator, you’ll be leading a team of passionate Educators and overseeing an engaging before- and after-school program for children aged 5-12 years. This role is all about leadership:

  • Design and lead a vibrant, child‑centred program, filled with engaging experiences such as STEM, sport, cooking, arts and crafts.
  • Take ownership of rosters, daily operations, compliance, and administration, with time allocated to do this well.
  • Build a positive, inclusive team culture where Educators feel supported, motivated, and proud of the program they deliver.
  • Partner with families, the school community, and internal stakeholders to ensure the service continues to grow and thrive.
  • Be supported by experienced Regional Managers and a dedicated Support Office so you’re never doing it alone.

Who are we looking for?

If you have a passion for supporting children, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s what we’re looking for:

  • Working towards or completed a relevant qualification to work as a 2 Year Qualified Educator in QLD in accordance with ACECQA
  • National Child Safety Training completion prior to onboarding (via Gecko)
  • A natural leader who enjoys guiding a team and helping others grow.
  • Strong communication skills—you’ll be leading by example!
  • A team player who inspires others and encourages growth.
  • You have (or are willing to obtain) a National Police Check and Working with Children Check.
  • Australian work rights.

At Junior Adventures Group, child safety and child safeguarding principles are our top priorities. Our recruitment process includes thorough background checks and screenings to ensure the wellbeing of all children in our care.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

title: Claims Assistant
description:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this job is to provide administrative support and overall assistance to Claims Examiners. This position exists to ensure the timely payment of benefits and administration of claims in compliance with state law.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivers basic to intermediate administrative support to Claims Examiners.

  • Contacts insured or other involved persons to obtain necessary information to process claim.
  • Documents conversations or information on appropriate enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.
  • Organizes and works with Examiner using computer to enter, access, search and retrieve data.
  • Stays current with diary tasks and procedural changes.

Imparts exceptional customer service to internal and external customers, including insureds.

  • Provides information to insureds, injured workers or provides referrals to outside vendors as requested by the Examiner.
  • Processes claims for indemnity payments and state mandated forms.
  • Processes non-medical payments.
  • Organizes and works with Examiner using computer to enter, access, search, and retrieve data.

Assists Claims Examiner with complete post-claims resolution and related administrative projects.

  • Schedules appropriate medical appointments, calculates mileage and sends appointment letter reminders.
  • Interacts with nurse on case management regarding return to work status.
  • Supports Claims Examiners in the preparation, processing and monitoring of payments.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Staff ASIC Digital Engineer (FPGA Prototyping, Emulation, System-Level Debugging) with 8 to 12 years of experience
description:
Role Overview

The Platform Engineering organization is looking for a self-driven, hands-on engineer who can bridge the communication and skillset divide between firmware, silicon design, and hardware validation. Your primary responsibility will be supporting our advanced prototyping and emulation platforms, with a specific focus on end users.

The ideal candidate has a broad, systems-level knowledge base, with deep technical expertise in platform bring-up, hardware/software co-verification, and high-density FPGA deployments.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead Project Bring-Up & Diagnostics: Partner with firmware and hardware teams during the critical early phases of project bring-up. Own the initial setup, environment configuration, and stabilization of emulation and prototyping platforms.
  • Triage & Debug: Act as the first line of defense for complex system-level failures during bring-up. Rapidly isolate root causes across the hardware, FPGA/emulator configuration, and early boot-code boundaries.
  • Partner with Customers: Work directly with product firmware engineers to break down execution barriers, unblock their development pipelines, and abstract away hardware complexities.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Develop automation, monitoring scripts, and health-check reporting to maximize the reliability, utilization, and throughput of the emulation and prototyping farm.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Document creative workarounds, capture debug methodologies, and build standardized playbooks for platform setup and troubleshooting.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • FPGA Prototyping & Support: Proven experience supporting large-scale FPGA prototyping platforms (e.g., Synopsys HAPS, custom multi-FPGA boards). Understanding of FPGA synthesis, place-and-route constraints, and clocking strategies is highly valued.
  • System-Level Debugging: Mastery of debugging tools and protocols (e.g., JTAG, protocol analyzers, logic analyzers, in-circuit emulators) to trace signals and state machines during early platform bring-up.
  • Emulation Platforms: Familiarity with hardware emulation architectures (e.g., Cadence Palladium, Synopsys ZeBu) and how to map design code into an emulation environment.
  • Hardware/Firmware Intersection: Solid understanding of the firmware development lifecycle and how it intersects with ASIC development, hardware description languages (Verilog/SystemVerilog), and FPGA design.
  • Python Expertise: Advanced Python scripting skills to develop internal tools, parsing utilities for debug logs, and automated regression testing frameworks.
  • Rudimentary Firmware Skills: Ability to write and debug low-level diagnostic code or bare-metal software to validate platform functionality, without needing to own the production product firmware.
  • Systems Administration: Functional understanding of networking, UNIX/Linux, and Windows administration. Because the team manages a high volume of specialized prototyping seats, the ability to troubleshoot local environment, licensing, and OS-level issues is critical.
  • Data Manipulation: Expertise in processing and analyzing usage metrics to optimize resource allocation across a global infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Education: BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.
  • Experience: 8–15 years of experience working in or around pre-silicon development, hardware verification, or platform bring-up.

title: Technical Lead (Octopai - Modeling, APIs)
description:
Business Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

About Octopai

Octopai is a fast-growing Data Intelligence company (Acquired by Cloudera) that empowers enterprises to understand, trust, and optimize their data. Our platform provides automated data lineage, cataloging, and discovery to accelerate analytics, improve governance, and drive business impact.

As we expand our platform capabilities and evolve our next-generation APIs and metadata modeling foundation, we are looking for an experienced Tech Lead to guide the architecture and development of Octopai’s core modeling and API layer.

Role Overview

As a Tech Lead (Modeling, APIs), you will combine hands-on engineering with deep technical leadership, owning the design and evolution of Octopai’s metadata modeling, domain structures, and API infrastructure.

You will drive architectural decisions around how Octopai represents data assets, lineage relationships, governance concepts, and integrations — and how these are exposed through scalable, enterprise-ready APIs.

This role requires strong backend and distributed systems expertise, plus the ability to lead engineers in building robust foundations that power both our SaaS platform and enterprise deployments.

As Technical Lead you will:

  • Lead the backend engineering team in designing, developing, and delivering Octopai’s modeling and API infrastructure.
  • Own the architecture of Octopai’s metadata model, including representation of data assets, transformations, lineage, governance, and operational metadata.
  • Define technical direction and best practices for API versioning, extensibility, and enterprise-grade integrations.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and leadership to translate platform requirements into scalable modeling and API solutions.
  • Provide mentorship and day-to-day technical guidance, fostering strong practices such as TDD, CI/CD, peer reviews, and clean architecture.
  • Ensure API security, performance, and reliability across hybrid (SaaS + on-premise) deployments.
  • Drive development of SDKs, documentation standards, and partner-facing integration frameworks.
  • Partner with infrastructure and DevOps teams to ensure APIs are deployable, observable, and maintainable in complex enterprise environments.
  • Represent the Modeling & APIs domain in cross-team architectural forums, influencing platform evolution and roadmap priorities.

We are excited if you have:

  • 12+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2+ years in a Tech Lead or equivalent leadership role.
  • Proven experience leading the design and development of API-first platforms, domain modeling systems, or core backend infrastructure.
  • Strong programming expertise in C# (.NET), Java and familiarity with modern backend design patterns.
  • Hands-on experience designing RESTful APIs, distributed services, and scalable backend architectures.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including metadata systems, graph-based relationships, or domain-driven design.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, ArangoDB, or similar), and messaging/streaming systems (Kafka, Redis, etc.).
  • Familiarity with API lifecycle management: versioning, backward compatibility, governance, and developer experience.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers, influence stakeholders, and align teams on platform strategy.

You may also have:

  • Experience in data lineage, metadata management, or data intelligence platforms.
  • Background in graph databases and modeling complex relationships across enterprise systems.
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI standards, API gateways, and partner integration ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of search systems (ElasticSearch/Solr, full-text search) and modeling-driven discovery.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or experience scaling backend architecture in high-growth companies.

title: Mobile Platform Technical Lead
description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision-making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

As a Mobile Platform Technical Lead, you will shape how our mobile applications are built, tested, and delivered to users around the world. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused initially on strengthening and automating our mobile delivery platform. You may come from mobile engineering, Mobile DevOps, build engineering, or release engineering. What matters most is that you have real-world experience shipping Android or iOS applications to production and are excited to take deeper ownership of the CI/CD, automation, and engineering practices behind reliable mobile delivery. As our delivery platform matures, you’ll also have opportunities to contribute your mobile engineering expertise more broadly. If you enjoy solving complex mobile delivery challenges while staying close to engineering, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Opportunities to learn and grow within a global healthcare organization

What You'll Be Doing

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for Clario’s mobile delivery roadmap, mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and removing delivery blockers.

  • Design, build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines for Android or iOS applications across build, automated test, signing, and release stages.

  • Own and automate the mobile release lifecycle, including versioning, certificates, provisioning profiles, keystores, secrets, and deployment through Apple App Store or Google Play.

  • Troubleshoot complex mobile build, signing, pipeline, and store-deployment issues while improving reliability, security, monitoring, build performance, and developer experience.

  • Partner with Mobile Engineering, QA, Security, and Product teams to establish scalable delivery practices and contribute to broader mobile engineering initiatives as the platform evolves.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience across mobile software development, Mobile DevOps, build engineering, release engineering, or related areas.

  • Hands-on experience shipping Android or iOS applications to production through Google Play or the Apple App Store, with practical knowledge of the mobile release lifecycle.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD, build or release automation using tools such as Fastlane, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Codemagic, CircleCI, or similar.

  • Experience with mobile signing and release requirements, such as certificates, provisioning profiles, keystores, secrets management, and store submission.

  • Strong software development or scripting skills using Swift, Kotlin, Bash, Python, or similar technologies, with an interest in mobile delivery automation and developer tooling.

  • Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor engineers, troubleshoot complex problems, and drive delivery while remaining hands-on.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering, QA, security, and product teams.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, cloud-native platforms, C#/.NET MAUI, LaunchDarkly, or AI-assisted developer tooling is beneficial.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

title: Gerente de Inteligência Artificial e Tecnologia - São Paulo/SP
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

Missão do cargo

O(a) Gerente de Tecnologia e IA será responsável por liderar a parceria de negócios de DD&T (Dados, Digital e Tecnologia) para tecnologia e IA, traduzindo as necessidades do negócio em demandas prontas para o ambiente corporativo e promovendo a adoção de soluções globais. O(a) Parceiro(a) de Tecnologia e IA atua como um elo estratégico entre as prioridades locais do negócio e as capacidades corporativas de DD&T, garantindo que as iniciativas sejam bem definidas, escaláveis e alinhadas aos requisitos de governança.

A função também apoia a filial/localidade (LOC) na geração de valor mensurável a partir de investimentos em tecnologia e inteligência artificial, incluindo automação e implementação de iniciativas Tech Forward para necessidades específicas da operação local. Além disso, trabalha em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Produtos de Dados, Excelência em Dados, CRM/CXF, Experiência Digital do Cliente & Conteúdo e Saúde Digital, garantindo que as demandas sejam direcionadas ao responsável adequado e entregues como um portfólio integrado de DD&T.

Responsabilidades

Operacionalizar o modelo de parceria de negócios de DD&T

  • Gerenciar o canal de engajamento de DD&T ("porta de entrada") para funções e equipes locais.

  • Traduzir demandas de negócio em requisitos prontos para a organização, incluindo definição clara de problemas, fluxos de processos, necessidades de automação e integração, e estratégias de adoção.

  • Definir áreas de necessidade específicas da operação local onde automação, recursos Tech Forward ou soluções tecnológicas direcionadas possam gerar valor mensurável.

  • Atuar em parceria com os responsáveis pelos processos de negócio, equipes ICC/GCM ou parceiros externos selecionados para desenvolver, entregar e implementar as soluções mais adequadas.

  • Ser responsável pelo padrão e metodologia local de levantamento de requisitos, garantindo que os problemas sejam compreendidos e estruturados de forma independente de solução específica (considerando dados, processos e tecnologia) antes da definição da solução.

  • Coordenar-se estreitamente com membros da equipe DD&T, parceiros multifuncionais e ICC para direcionar cada necessidade ao fluxo de entrega e responsável apropriado.

Liderar governança de portfólio, relatórios e gestão de escalonamentos

  • Manter uma visão integrada das demandas, iniciativas, dependências e restrições de capacidade relacionadas a tecnologia e IA.

  • Priorizar e sequenciar iniciativas para maximizar resultados de negócio e adoção.

  • Tornar visíveis as interdependências entre os portfólios de tecnologia, dados, experiência do cliente e saúde digital.

  • Estabelecer uma rotina de acompanhamento com a liderança de DD&T, produzindo atualizações objetivas sobre:

    • Principais desafios e oportunidades.

    • Riscos de entrega.

    • Indicadores de adoção.

    • Questões de conformidade.

    • Decisões necessárias.

Impulsionar a adoção de tecnologia corporativa e IA na operação local

  • Manter um portfólio priorizado de capacidades corporativas de tecnologia e IA a serem implementadas localmente.

  • Definir cronogramas, dependências, KPIs e resultados esperados alinhados às prioridades estratégicas.

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de Dados, CRM/CXF, Experiência Digital e Saúde Digital.

  • Identificar continuamente oportunidades em IA, automação e recursos digitais capazes de melhorar significativamente os resultados do negócio.

  • Comunicar de forma clara o que pode ser implementado imediatamente, o que depende de etapas futuras e quais pré-requisitos são necessários, como qualidade de dados, maturidade de processos ou evolução das plataformas.

Liderar diretamente 1 a 2 iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia ou IA

  • Estruturar casos de uso.

  • Definir requisitos.

  • Validar a adequação da solução.

  • Impulsionar a adoção de ponta a ponta.

  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes IBU DD&T e ICC/GCM na entrega, mantendo a responsabilidade pela qualidade dos requisitos e pela adoção local.

  • Garantir colaboração adequada com líderes dos domínios DD&T quando as iniciativas envolverem produtos de dados, fundações de dados, CRM/CXF, plataformas de engajamento de clientes ou soluções de saúde digital.

  • Apoiar a prospecção de inovação e monitoramento do ecossistema externo para identificar novas capacidades, parceiros e oportunidades relevantes para fortalecer o roadmap de DD&T local e regional.

Liderar a adoção responsável de IA e seus controles

  • Promover o uso de plataformas e padrões corporativos aprovados de IA.

  • Garantir que os casos de uso de IA incluam controles adequados relacionados a:

    • Proveniência dos dados.

    • Supervisão humana.

    • Monitoramento.

    • Controle de mudanças.

    • Documentação.

  • Evitar o uso de ferramentas ou soluções não aprovadas que possam gerar riscos regulatórios ou dívida técnica.

Atuar em parceria com ICC/GCM para entrega escalável de tecnologia e IA

  • Ser o principal ponto de contato com ICC/GCM para iniciativas de tecnologia e IA na operação local.

  • Coordenar com os membros de DD&T responsáveis pelas frentes de dados, CRM/CXF, experiência digital e saúde digital.

  • Garantir a existência de um modelo de suporte local mínimo, porém completo, com papéis claros de propriedade dos processos e dados, além de canais de escalonamento para equipes globais de suporte e fornecedores.

Garantir governança, riscos e conformidade de DD&T (GRC)

  • Assegurar que todas as soluções adotadas e configurações locais estejam em conformidade com requisitos de:

    • Privacidade.

    • Segurança.

    • Gestão de acessos.

    • Gestão de riscos de terceiros.

    • Documentação.

    • Retenção de informações.

  • Garantir práticas de trabalho em conformidade sem comprometer desnecessariamente a velocidade das entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios e competências

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Sólida e comprovada experiência em tecnologia da informação/comercial, preferencialmente em empresas farmacêuticas, ou de consumo ou de Life Sciences ou de setores regulados.

  • Nível de Inglês Fluente para leitura, escrita, conversação e compreensão.

  • Possuir mindset voltado para crescimento, com abertura a feedback, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação rápida a mudanças no ambiente de negócios e tecnologia.

  • Conhecimento aprofundado de processos comerciais, com capacidade de atuar como ponte entre públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

  • Experiência prática com iniciativas de inteligência artificial, automação e transformação digital em saúde ou em ambientes corporativos complexos.

  • Histórico comprovado de liderança em programas de transformação digital e adoção tecnológica em grandes organizações matriciais.

  • Fortes conhecimentos de plataformas corporativas de tecnologia, arquiteturas de dados e padrões de integração (como ERP, CRM e plataformas de dados em nuvem).

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em requisitos de conformidade digital, governança, privacidade e segurança.

  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e gestão de mudanças, com capacidade de impulsionar adoção e geração de valor após a implementação.

  • Possuir amplas capacidades em liderar pelo exemplo com foco em padronização e geração de valor, promovendo o reaproveitamento de soluções corporativas, construindo redes multifuncionais entre DD&T, áreas de negócio, segurança, privacidade, fornecedores e parceiros externos, além de participar ativamente das discussões-chave para gerar resultados mensuráveis.

Base: São Paulo/SP.

title: Lead Technical Advisor-FIFO
description:
Role Summary/Purpose

Lead Technical Advisors are front line leaders, entrusted with the responsibility of ensuring operations run smoothly for a shift or group of employees. In this role, you will lead, train and support Wabtec technical advisors and customer/subcontractor teams in the execution of Diesel-Electric locomotives maintenance and repair for CTG in Guinea. You will be part of an overall team made up other functions such as supply chain, safety, quality, etc. all working to ensure our customer’s fleet is running at optimal levels. LTAs serves as an escalation point for all technical issues to minimize locomotives downtime.

This role will be based in Guinea near the port of Morebaya on a rotational basis (FIFO) of 60 days on and 15 days off. The operation is 24/7 running two 12-hour shifts. Employees will work 6 days a week one shift. Accommodation will be provided at the maintenance facility, mobilization and demobilization air and land transportation will be provided.

This role will be eligible for an assignment allowance and overtime.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Provide technical expertise to customer/subcontractor employees and management, as well as Wabtec employees, including safety procedures, maintenance, and repair procedures, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, material handling, tooling, and contract requirement clarification.
  • Work with customer employees and management to promote, maintain, and drive continuous improvement in safe work practices while monitoring quality, productivity, and adherence to contract requirements.
  • Provide training / mentorship to customer and Wabtec employees owning preventative and corrective actions.
  • Provide clear communication to customer employees, Wabtec employees, customer management and Wabtec management of work to be performed, quality scope, process improvements, and liaison with other cross functional departments as necessary.
  • Provide regular communication and reports on contractual deliverables which may include locomotive maintenance and repairs completed, upcoming scheduled repairs and maintenance, quality and reliability improvements, technical OJT training, facilitating materials reports, status of open issues, and other metrics deemed critical to safety, quality, and operations for the site.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable Wabtec, customer, and local regulations.
  • Make operational risk assessments, balancing customer requests with Wabtec requirements.
  • Responsible for developing and maintaining customer relationships.
  • Work with various functions within Wabtec to address customer concerns with minimal delays.
  • Coordinating implementation of field modifications and monitor effectiveness.
  • Lead a team of Wabtec and customer/subcontractor during shift to ensure maintenance work is executed successfully and safely.
  • Interface with Wabtec operation leadership on customer, contract and equipment issues.

Qualifications

Bachelors’ Degree in a Technical discipline from an accredited College or University.

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience working in the customer facing role maintaining Wabtec/GE locomotives.
  • Wabtec L1 Locomotive Technical training certificate.
  • Experience and ability to work in shop environment and to work various shifts on various days as required.
  • Understanding of Wabtec Maintenance and Material management processes and systems.
  • Strong leadership and Interpersonal skills
  • Ability to interface with different levels of internal and external customers.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English

Desired Characteristics

  • Ability to manage effectively several projects simultaneously in a dynamic and face paced environment
  • Proven analytical and organizational ability.
  • Effective problem identification and solution skills
  • Lean/Six Sigma certification
  • High level of dependability, a great attitude, and an ability to work well with a team towards achieving common goal.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

title: Senior AI/ML Lead
description:
About RentFlow

RentFlow is tackling a hair-on-fire problem for small and medium businesses across the U.S.: the way their rent is paid each month is fundamentally misaligned with how cash actually comes in.
We’re building the infrastructure layer to fix that.
Today, ~50% of U.S. businesses are late on rent in any given month. The rest face invisible struggles to pay on time, undermining their stability month after month.
The core issue is structural: rent hits as a single fixed lump sum on the 1st, stacked on top of every other major monthly bill, while revenue and other expenses flow in unevenly. This forces healthy businesses into recurring cash-flow stress and is a major driver of business closures.
RentFlow is the first startup to turn fixed business rent into a cash-flow-synced product, underwritten in real time from transaction-level data to prevent issues before they even surface.
This opens up a $20B+ rent-splitting market and creates a natural wedge into an AI CFO layer for businesses and data opportunities we're uniquely positioned to own.
We’re seed-stage, live since May 2025, and growing quickly. We’re ramping up partnerships with the leading rent payment platforms in the U.S., fast-growing SMB software companies, and major property players.

Early-Stage Opportunity

We’re hiring our Senior AI/ML Lead to own underwriting, risk intelligence, LLM applications, and financial data insights end-to-end.
This is a foundational role. You’ll build systems that make real financial decisions in production, while also turning the data generated through RentFlow into entirely new products for tenants and landlords.
You’ll work directly with the founders and have full ownership over both technical direction and business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • AI applications:
    • Build LLM-powered classification systems for messy SMB transaction data
    • Improve RentFlow’s AI CFO for SMBs, turning financial data into actionable insights
    • Power the landlord dashboard and AI insights, surfacing tenant health and portfolio trends
  • Underwriting & risk:
    • Analyze historical repayment data to identify key risk patterns and predictors
    • Turn those insights into hard underwriting and risk rules
    • Build a flexible decisioning framework to test and adjust rules over time
    • Optional but highly appreciated: develop ML risk models to predict repayment and default risk
  • Collaborate closely with the founders on product, risk, underwriting, and roadmap decisions
  • Shape the long-term architecture of RentFlow’s AI, ML, and data stack

You’ll Be a Great Fit If You

  • Have worked with LLMs in production and know where to apply them
  • Are comfortable working with messy financial data
  • Care about real-world impact
  • Enjoy high ownership, fast iteration, and ambiguous problem spaces
  • Want to help define the technical DNA of an early-stage company
  • Are excited to be an early hire with outsized impact, real equity, and real leverage on product and company direction

Why This Role Is Different

  • Your work will directly impact real money and real outcomes
  • You’ll help define an entirely new category at the intersection of rent, finance, and AI
  • You’ll work side-by-side with founders
  • You’ll have meaningful equity and real leverage from day one

If you want to build something with real stakes, real users, and real impact as an early hire, we’d love to talk!

title: Lead Systems Operations Engineer - Platform Reliability Engineering, SRE, Observability and Monitoring, Platform Support
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Systems Operations Engineer. Platform Reliability Engineering (PRE) within the CTO Platform organization. This role is aligned to modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and is responsible for driving reliability, resiliency, observability, and operational excellence across critical platform and application services. The role is intended for senior engineers with deep expertise in one core platform domain, applying that expertise to proactively improve platform stability, scalability, and availability.


In this role, you will:

  • Lead complex, broad impact initiatives including provision of high level systems consultation for the technology teams
  • Work as key participant in large scale planning of computer systems and network infrastructure for Systems Operations functional area
  • Review and analyze complex technical challenges, as well as escalated support issues related to core business solutions that require in depth evaluation of multiple factors, such as alternatives, enhancements, periodic systems reviews, or improvements to existing systems
  • Make decisions on technical changes and enhancements
  • Consult with engineering team on change design requiring solid understanding of technical process controls or standards that influence and drive new initiatives
  • Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve goals


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


Desired Qualifications:

  • experience in Systems Operations, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Production Support with deep expertise in at least one platform domain: Database, Cloud, Network, Compute/Storage, Middleware, or Enterprise Application Support
  • Strong hands-on experience applying SRE practices, including SLI/SLO definition, error budgets, and reliability metrics.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting and resolving large-scale, distributed production systems.
  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, Cribl, ThousandEyes, AppDynamics, or equivalent, including dashboards, alerting, logs, and metrics.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell to reduce operational toil.
  • Experience building automation or reliability tooling using APIs, Git-based workflows, and modern engineering practices.
  • Solid understanding of incident, problem, and change management in enterprise production environments.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills across engineering teams and senior leadership.
  • Experience with capacity management, performance engineering, and resiliency design (HA, fault tolerance, RTO/RPO).
  • Experience operating in hybrid environments (on‑prem + cloud) with complex enterprise dependencies.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation / IaC tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
  • Ability to drive technical debt remediation for critical legacy platforms using structured backlogs.
  • Experience mentoring or leading senior engineers in reliability, operations, or SRE-focused roles.


Job Expectations:

  • Strong collaboration and partnering skills across platform, application, and support teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-impact production environment.
  • Consistent delivery of high-quality reliability outcomes within expected timelines.
  • High attention to detail, data-driven problem-solving, and operational rigor.
  • Prior project or initiative leadership experience is highly desirable.

Job Description:

GDIT's Military Health team is hiring a Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support the Traumatic Brain Injury Center of Excellence (TBICoE).

Hybrid work is available, however, candidates should reside in the National Capital Region with the ability to commute periodically to TBICoE HQ in Silver Spring, MD.

Work visa sponsorship is not available.

TBICoE Mission:
As the traumatic brain injury Pathway of Care manager within the Military Health System (MHS), TBICoE advances state-of-the-science care from point-of-injury through reintegration for Service members, veterans, and their families. TBICoE unifies TBI health care, drives research, and prepares the MHS for future brain health challenges.

In this role, you will serve as the SME for TBI across all levels of severity, operating with minimal supervision in a high-tempo environment responsive to DHA and DoW leadership, clinicians, educators, and cognitive monitoring program needs.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Serve as TBICoE’s SME on mild, moderate, severe, and penetrating TBI, from prevention through rehabilitation, and stay informed on emerging brain health areas such as blast effects and cognitive performance.
  • Review SME quarterly reports and brief leadership on emerging clinical practice trends, brain health threats, and warfighter-relevant issues.
  • Provide expert analysis to senior leadership on TBI research, clinical care, and standards of care across the full continuum of severity.
  • Collaborate with TBICoE, DoW policy offices, and SMEs to enhance metrics and standardization of TBI services and programs.
  • Contribute to development of training platforms/tools and deliver training when appropriate.
  • Advise leadership on evidence-based evaluation, treatment, management, gaps in knowledge, and future research needs.
  • Support and collaborate on TBICoE/DoW research projects.
  • Participate in scholarly, academic, and scientific meetings related to TBI, brain health, blast exposure, and cognitive monitoring.
  • Adhere to all legal, professional, and ethical standards related to confidentiality and privacy.
  • Contribute to the creation and improvement of TBI clinical documents, recommendations, tools, and resources in partnership with the DoD and VA.
  • Translate research findings into clinical recommendations and develop guidance documents, tools, and patient resources.
  • Provide clinical input on standards of care and collaborate with stakeholders.
  • May supervise junior colleagues.

  • MD with specialty training in a TBI-related field.
  • 5+ years of healthcare and/or healthcare research experience.
  • Publication in peer-reviewed journals and/or presentations at professional meetings.
  • Strong knowledge of TBI and statistics.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong collaborative and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to pass a T3 security/background investigation.

  • Family Care Provider or Sports Medicine experience.
  • Knowledge of DoW and VA health care systems.
  • Prior experience working within DoW/VA systems.

Du har med dig erfarenhet av ledarskap på operativ nivå och vet hur du ska bygga team samt omsätta handlingsplaner i praktiken. Vi tar för givet att du behärskar svenska i tal och skrift och känner dig bekväm med att använda din engelska om så krävs. Du har goda kunskaper i MS Office och är en van systemanvändare. B-körkort är ett krav, C-behörighet är meriterande.
