title: System Integration Engineer - On site
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Systems Integration Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering Team. This role owns the system-level integration, validation, troubleshooting, and optimization of printer platforms ( 3D, Inkjet, Thermal) ensuring mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, thermal, motion, and manufacturing systems operate together as a reliable, high-quality product from prototype through mass production.

The successful candidate will bring strong systems thinking, hands-on technical depth, and demonstrated experience resolving complex electromechanical issues. You will work across engineering and operations functions to identify root causes, drive technical decisions, close integration gaps quickly, and improve product performance, reliability, quality, manufacturability, and production readiness.

This is a fast-paced, highly cross-functional role for an engineer who can lead through technical expertise and sound judgment, move effectively between subsystem details and whole-product behavior, and drive issues to closure while keeping development and production milestones on track.

Responsibilities

System Integration & Technical Leadership

  • Own integration of mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software subsystems into a complete 3D printer platform.
  • Define, validate, and manage system interfaces, requirements, operating limits, and integration dependencies across disciplines.
  • Lead system-level bring-up, debugging, issue triage, and technical resolution from prototype through production.
  • Drive system architecture and design integration reviews; identify integration risks early and lead mitigation plans.
  • Assess product-level tradeoffs and use data to drive cross-functional technical decisions.

Product Development, Validation & Print Performance

  • Drive system readiness through EVT, DVT, PVT, pilot builds, production ramp, and sustaining engineering.
  • Develop and execute system validation plans and acceptance criteria covering functionality, performance, reliability, and print quality.
  • Validate and optimize motion systems, including motors, rails, belts, lead screws, encoders, acceleration, velocity, positioning accuracy, vibration, and resonance behavior.
  • Validate and optimize extrusion and thermal systems, including extruders, hot ends, nozzles, heaters, thermistors, cooling, filament feeding, temperature control, and extrusion consistency.
  • Evaluate and improve dimensional accuracy, surface finish, layer adhesion, warpage, bridging, overhangs, repeatability, and print completion performance.
  • Develop and validate robust calibration methods such as bed leveling, Z-offset, extrusion flow, PID tuning, pressure advance, and input shaping.

Root Cause Analysis & Reliability

  • Lead structured investigations of complex system-level failures using 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, DOE, and data-driven problem-solving methods.
  • Drive corrective and preventive actions to closure and verify effectiveness through testing and production data.
  • Partner with Quality and Reliability teams on failure analysis, reliability testing, field-return investigations, and continuous product improvement.

Manufacturing & Cross-Functional Integration

  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to develop and validate assembly, calibration, and end-of-line functional test processes.
  • Support pilot builds and production ramp; improve first-pass yield, calibration success, and manufacturing defect rates.
  • Coordinate closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, Software, Quality, Manufacturing, Supplier Engineering, and Operations teams to resolve cross-functional issues.
  • Maintain clear integration plans, interface documentation, validation protocols, test reports, issue tracking, and engineering change documentation.

Key Competencies

  • Systems thinking able to connect subsystem behavior to whole-product performance.
  • Hands-on problem-solving, able to comfortably work directly with hardware, firmware, software, test equipment, and data.
  • Technical leadership able to lead through expertise, judgment, and influence across functions.
  • Execution moves quickly from problem definition to validated resolution while managing technical risk.
  • Collaboration works effectively across engineering, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and operations.
  • Ownership drives complex issues to closure and maintains focus on product quality and production readiness.

*ONLY APPLICABLE TO MALAYSIAN*

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in systems integration, product development, validation, or troubleshooting of complex precision electromechanical products.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with 3D printing or closely related printing systems; strong FDM/FFF experience is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of system interactions across mechanics, electronics, embedded firmware, sensors, thermal control, motion control, and software.
  • Experience supporting NPI programs from prototype through EVT/DVT/PVT and mass production.
  • Proven ability to diagnose ambiguous system-level problems, identify root causes, and drive solutions across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Experience defining validation methods, acceptance criteria, and data-driven engineering decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions and influence decisions through technical expertise.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience with FDM/FFF printer architecture, extrusion systems, print quality optimization, calibration, and slicer/process parameters.
  • Experience with other printing technologies such as inkjet, thermal, SLA, SLS, or resin-based systems.
  • Familiarity with embedded printer firmware such as Marlin, Klipper, or RepRapFirmware and with G-code and slicer software such as Cura, PrusaSlicer, or OrcaSlicer.
  • Experience with sensors, machine vision, automated calibration, closed-loop control, or diagnostic systems.
  • Knowledge of DFM/DFA, GD&T, reliability engineering, statistical analysis, and regulatory compliance such as UL, CE, and FCC.
  • Working knowledge of CAD and engineering/data tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, Fusion 360, Python, MATLAB, Minitab/JMP, Jira, Confluence, and Git.
  • Hands-on proficiency with test and diagnostic equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, thermal cameras, calipers, and CMMs.

What to Do Next: Please attach your resume including links to your Github and website where applicable. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information!

The FaRB Risk Consultant will work cross-functionally to review business practices and customer-facing processes, supporting efforts to assess risk, identify emerging issues, and develop practical guidance that promotes sound risk management. The Tester is responsible for carrying out functional test on advance electrical systems and equipment to detect faulty wiring and ensure product compliance with codes and standards in a work cell or area. Shift: 1st Shift

Hours: 6:00AM-4:30PM (Mon-Fri & additional days as needed)

  • Perform functional tests on components to ensure components will operate correctly and have been assembled according to work instruction, schematics, change sheets, or wire diagrams.

  • Perform basic troubleshooting on various assemblies when functional tests produce a fail result. Identify and resolve the underlying issue where possible.

  • Perform similar functional test in at least 3 lines utilizing the DAL test fixture and perform Hipot and Continuity test

  • Utilize Shop floor management system to drive KPC/TPM, Tier 1, 5S, and cross-training principles to promote continuous improvement

  • Participates in training associates on product and functional test requirements.

Knowledge of electrical components and advanced problem-solving skills, using computer systems and documents to ensure product compliance. Solid communication skills to drive improvement in defect prevention and flexibility to foster learning all products and test cell configurations. Ability to train others in product and carrying out functional test to drive cross-training and knowledge transfer. Advanced ability to read Wire Diagrams, Schematics, and proper use of electrical tools (OHM meter).

About the Role:

The Project Engineer plays a key role in supporting our paper mill operations in Pine Bluff, AR by leading and executing capital projects that improve safety, reliability, productivity, and sustainability. This role is highly collaborative and involves managing projects from concept through startup, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, and performance objectives are achieved. This position works closely with Operations, Maintenance, Reliability, Environmental, and Engineering teams, as well as external contractors and vendors, to successfully deliver projects that support the mill's strategic objectives.

title: Senior Premier Banker Whitestone
description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes
  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs
  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes
  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners
  • 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience
  • Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others
  • Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments
  • 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position
  • Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration
  • State Insurance license(s)

Job Expectations:

  • Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays
  • This role requires FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 (or FINRA recognized equivalents), and State Insurance license(s) which must be active or completed within a designated timeframe. For any FINRA qualification exams earned after Sept. 30, 2018, the Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is also required.
  • For the following states where hired, FINRA Series 65 (or equivalent) examination will also be required within a specified period: AK, AL, CT, DE, HI, IA, ID, IN, KS, MD, MI, MN, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NM, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, and WY. Wyoming allows referral-only licensed bankers to receive the IAR registration without completing the Series 65/66 exam requirement. Requirements may change based on current state regulations.
  • Obtaining and maintaining required FINRA licenses is necessary for continued employment. This role also requires meeting enhanced financial fitness and criminal background standards. Wells Fargo will begin the FINRA review process once an offer is accepted.
  • SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date.Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.
  • This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

  • Transports patients, belongings and deceased to and from assigned departments.

  • Assists patients in and out of vehicles and transport equipment.

  • Lifts and maneuvers patients using proper body mechanics and equipment, as needed.

title: Warehouse Lead
description:
Job Title: Warehouse Lead

GCL : F

Be part of history in the making. AstraZeneca is building its first biologics manufacturing campus in Singapore — a groundbreaking USD 1.5 billion investment that will serve as a global hub for innovation and excellence.

This innovative facility will deliver end-to-end Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC) capabilities with different manufacturing units/buildings in one campus

  • Small molecule- chemical API production
  • Large molecule- monoclonal antibody manufacturing
  • Conjugation
  • Fill-and-finish operations, including sterile filling and lyophilization
  • Final secondary packaging

The campus will be equipped with modern digital and automation infrastructure, enabling autonomous manufacturing powered by artificial intelligence. In addition, it will be designed for carbon neutrality, embedding sustainability into every aspect of operations and setting a new benchmark for environmentally responsible biologics' manufacturing.

We are looking for passionate individuals with proven experience who thrive in dynamic environments and bring a “make-it-happen” attitude. Joining us means contributing to a project that will not only transform AstraZeneca’s global supply chain but also advance life-changing medicines for patients everywhere.

If you’re ready to shape the future of biologics and be part of a once-in-a-generation project, we want you on our team.

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to lead a complex, high-performing distribution network that keeps life-changing medicines moving with precision, speed and care? In this role, you will connect warehouse execution to business strategy, ensuring the right product reaches the right place at the right time and cost—safely and compliantly. Your leadership will translate digital insights and operational excellence into tangible results for patients and the business.

As a Warehouse Lead, you will own delivery across large or multiple markets, guiding operations in internally managed and outsourced distribution centres. You will set performance standards, develop Service Level Agreements alongside commercial partners, and build positive relationships with Freight Forwarders, LSPs and 3PLs. Can you turn data into decisive action on the floor and across the network, while fostering a team culture that delivers right-first-time performance?

Accountabilities:

  • E2E Strategy: Develop and implement a warehousing strategy aligned to the plant’s production schedule and global supply objectives, ensuring capacity, service, and cost targets are met.
  • Daily Operations Excellence: Govern day-to-day activities across receiving, de-palletization, sampling support, temperature-controlled and ambient storage, and outbound logistics to maintain flow and on-time performance.
  • Capacity and Layout Optimization: Optimize warehouse footprint, layout, and material handling to secure space for raw materials, consumables, WIP, and finished goods as volumes scale.
  • Regulatory and Audit Leadership: Ensure adherence to FDA, EMA, HSA and internal QMS requirements; serve as warehousing SME during inspections and drive audit readiness at all times.

  • Cold Chain Stewardship: Protect temperature-controlled regimes with monitored, alarmed systems; lead swift mitigation and root-cause actions for any excursions.
  • Loss Prevention and Turns: Partner with Procurement and Quality to minimize write-offs and manage rejected or expired goods; improve inventory turns and reduce variances.
  • Digital Systems Ownership: Serve as business owner for WMS and ERP (e.g., SAP/S4HANA), ensuring data integrity, seamless manufacturing integration, and reliable targets.
  • Automation Deployment: Lead or support AGVs, AS/RS, RFID and related technologies to increase throughput, reduce human error, and standardize processes.
  • People Leadership: Build, mentor, and upskill warehouse managers, supervisors, and specialists; foster an inclusive, accountable environment that gets results.
  • Financial Stewardship: Own OPEX and CAPEX for warehousing; identify and complete cost improvements without compromising safety, quality, or compliance.

Degree level qualification;

Experience in managing teams;

Experience in logistics and/or distribution;

Knowledge of supply chain management principles

Desirable Skills/Experience:

Professional qualification in distribution;

Experience of project work under tight deadlines and service levels across different technology bases

Here, science with purpose meets real-world execution. You will work with diverse, cross-functional teams who bring different perspectives into the same room to solve complex manufacturing challenges and get medicines to patients faster. We pair modern tools—data-rich systems, automation, and advanced analytics—with a collaborative culture that values curiosity, constructive feedback, and accountability. As a member of the Sectional Core department team, working on the 06:00-14:00 shift (38 hours/week) Monday to Friday, you will be responsible for working in a manual environment, the role is to process cores (radiators) through the manufacturing production line, using hand tools, checking quality of the product during the process. PPE supplied; safety glasses, ear protection, overalls, gloves, safety boots (and visors where relevant).

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

What do we want to know about you?

Team player with a positive can-do attitude.

Practical, hands on.

Have good communication skills.

Willing to work flexibly.

Attention to good Housekeeping.

What about the physical demands of the job?

A manual environment, lifting heavy equipment with magnetic hoists and chain/strap hoists.

Benefits:

Retention bonus (up-to £650) / 4 x life assurance / Sick Pay scheme / Pension

Holiday 23 days per year plus bank/public holidays / Free hot drinks / Access to retail discounts / Medicash health plan

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

title: Account Strategy Director
location: Any Region, REMOTE, United States of America
description:
Account Strategy Director

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking an Account Strategy Director to join our team in a remote capacity. As an Account Strategy Director, you will serve as the strategic commercial and business operations backbone for our mid and large biopharma account teams. This position plays a key role in proposal management, account development, customer intelligence, and internal process coordination. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to account growth from planning through execution. Responsibilities include leading proposal strategies, developing customer intelligence, coordinating break-in strategies, and supporting business development initiatives, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence account outcomes.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic account management, competitive proposal development, and seamless customer engagement. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Account Strategy Director can explore career paths and expand skills across commercial strategy and business development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate RFP response processes from the sales perspective, partnering with Account Executives, bid defense teams, subject matter experts, and operational teams to develop winning strategies and ensure high-quality, competitive, and timely submissions
  • Oversee proposal development workflows, timelines, and internal reviews; analyze win/loss data to continuously improve proposal strategies and approaches
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive customer maps identifying key stakeholders, decision-makers, and influencers within assigned accounts
  • Research and document customer organizational structures, priorities, and strategic initiatives to support account planning and provide insights on customer needs, challenges, and opportunities
  • Create and maintain detailed customer profiles and relationship histories to enable targeted account development
  • Design and implement targeted break-in strategies to penetrate new departments or therapeutic areas within existing accounts, identifying potential entry points and developing tailored value propositions
  • Support the creation of account-specific business development plans and monitor effectiveness of break-in strategies
  • Guide contracts (SOW, CIS, etc.) through internal approval processes, coordinating with legal, finance, and operational teams to expedite document reviews and resolve workflow bottlenecks
  • Serve as the liaison between Account Executives and internal departments, ensuring seamless communication and process coordination
  • Conduct active prospecting to identify new opportunities within assigned accounts and coordinate strategic customer meetings for Account Executives
  • Prepare comprehensive briefing materials and background information for customer interactions and support follow-up activities after customer engagements
  • Demonstrate strategic thinking and problem-solving orientation to drive account growth and commercial success

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Exceptional project management and organizational abilities with strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strategic thinking orientation
  • Experience working in commercial strategy, business development, or a regulated environment
  • The ability to collaborate across teams and work effectively with multiple internal departments
  • Comfort working with CRM systems, proposal management tools, and other business applications
  • Understanding of pharmaceutical industry trends, challenges, and the clinical research landscape

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Numerous years of previous experience working in Life Sciences, with proven track record in proposal development and business development
  • Strong understanding of clinical research processes and CRO services
  • Experience with customer relationship management systems and proposal management tools
  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry trends, challenges, and regulatory environment
  • Familiarity with contract negotiation and business terms in the CRO space
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, life sciences, or related field
  • Experience in strategic account planning and execution
  • Background in managing complex stakeholder relationships
  • Familiarity with additional business development methodologies or sales enablement tools

Benefits and Compensation

  • Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Work/Life Balance
  • 401(k) with Company match
  • Pet Insurance

For a complete list of benefits, please visit www.parexel.com/us-benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, which includes paid time off, a 401(k) match, life insurance, health insurance, and additional benefit offerings in accordance with the terms of our applicable plans.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Why this opportunity

This is an opportunity to shape how SEEK operates by developing practical AI-enabled tools and platforms that can be adopted, scaled and continuously improved. The role offers end-to-end ownership—from identifying high-value opportunities through to implementation, adoption and measurable business impact. You’ll join a fast-paced and supportive environment where people are passionate about SEEK’s purpose, collaborate closely and take a long-term view.

You will be working day-to-day embedded in to one or more of SEEK's strategy, product, technology and support teams. In this role you will design and deploy AI-enabled intelligence platforms, workflows and tools that strengthen decision-making and improve the productivity of work across SEEK.

Reporting to the Head of Operational Excellence, this is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll partner with teams across Strategy, Product, Data, Architecture, AI and Engineering teams to solve business problems by building scalable systems, workflows and decision-support tools that improve the speed, quality and consistency of work.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of solutions for the embedded team, from opportunity identification and approach development through to implementation, adoption and realised benefits.
  • Build—and partner with others to build—solutions such as intelligence platforms, copilots embedded with the way we work, and agents that orchestrate and automate our core processes
  • Collaborate across Strategy, Product, Data, Architecture, AI and Engineering to deliver solutions aligned with SEEK’s technology patterns and share learnings across the organisation.
  • Build capability and encourage adoption through training, coaching, playbooks, templates, communities of practice and effective operating rhythms.
  • Monitor adoption, quality, productivity and business impact, using these insights to continuously improve AI-enabled strategy workflows and tools.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience designing and building AI-enabled products, workflows, agents or decision-support systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI technologies including LLMs, retrieval systems, agent architectures, evaluation approaches and guardrails.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
  • Strong business judgement, with the ability to connect organisational objectives to effective systems, workflows and decision-support tools.
  • Experience embedding new tools, technologies or operating models through stakeholder engagement, training and coaching.
  • Experience in areas such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, product management, consulting, transformation or startup environments will be valuable, as will experience building internal AI products, knowledge systems or intelligence platforms.

Permanent Perks
At SEEK we offer:

  • Annual Performance Bonus Plan
  • Support of flexible working, including a mix of office and work from home days depending on your role.
  • Paid and unpaid leave benefits including Personal Flexi Days and Volunteer Days, as well as the opportunity to purchase additional leave
  • Support for parents with 14 weeks paid primary carers leave and 2 weeks paid leave for partners

At SEEK, we are passionate about fostering a culture of inclusion and wellbeing that embraces and values the diversity of our people. We are a purpose driven business that works with heart.

We know teams with diverse ideas, experiences and perspectives are more creative and are critical to ensuring effective delivery and innovating to enable our future success. As such, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and life experiences, especially as they relate to gender, sexual identity, culture, faith, disability and life stages. If you have the skills, curiosity and an adaptable mindset but don't meet every responsibility or qualification listed in this advertisement, please still get in touch with us.

Should you require any specific support or adjustments throughout the recruitment process and beyond, please advise us and we will be happy to assist.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Emulation
description:
Primary Function of Position
The Multiport Software Group within Intuitive has an immediate opening for an experienced Software Engineer with a focus on the internal da Vinci emulator. You will be on a small team responsible for building, deploying, and supporting our full-system emulator and hybrid hardware-in-the-loop setups.

A successful candidate must excel in a high-energy focused team environment and must balance delivery of new features, supporting existing features, and tracking system changes. An excellent candidate can rapidly learn the large complex and continually evolving systems, through establishing working relationships with multiple engineers in multiple departments and direct experimentation with the existing system. A deep sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the ability to make work fun and interesting

Essential Job Duties

  • Lead the emulation team on industry-standard or innovative approaches to developing performance system emulators.
  • Expand the functionality of the internal da Vinci emulator by faithfully emulating microcontrollers, sensors, FPGAs, and physics models.
  • Learn and explore the continuously evolving da Vinci system software and firmware.
  • Explore creative ways to faithfully emulate da Vinci hardware.
  • An advocate for hardware “simulation first” that educates developer on the productivity benefits of using the emulator.
  • Continuously follow up with developers (i.e. our internal customers) to support feature requests, bug fixes, and system integration.

Required Education, Skills & Experience

  • 12 years of experience and a Bachelor’s degree in computer science or another relevant engineering discipline, or 8 years of experience and a Master’s degree, or 5 years of experience and a PhD degree; or equivalent experience
  • Extensive experience understanding and debugging complex systems
  • Excellent knowledge of Software Engineering and Computer Science fundamentals
  • Experience using C++ and Python
  • Proficient communication skill and the ability to collaborate with a diverse range of talented engineers

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with CUDA and graphics acceleration
  • Experience with Linux process management, signals, and inter process communication
  • Working knowledge of or willingness to learn microcontrollers and embedded software for memory-mapped I/O
  • Some experience with Docker and Git

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Technical Logistics Coordinator
description:
Join Parexel’s team of changemakers as we help advance healthcare throughout the globe, all while keeping the patient at the heart of everything we do.

Technical Logistics Coordinator/Leader

At Parexel, we are a leading Clinical Research Organization (CRO) company specializing in delivering life‑changing medicines to patients. We are seeking a Technical Logistics Coordinator to join our team. As a Technical Logistics Coordinator, you’ll be joining a fast‑paced, driven environment that’s helping to make a life‑changing difference to patients by supporting the setup, maintenance, and quality oversight of clinical trial logistics systems and data. Through the collaboration and diversity of teams, the Technical Logistics Specialist is provided with multiple opportunities to excel and discover where your skills can take you.

Who we’re looking for

We’re seeking someone who is:

  • Detail‑oriented and analytical.
  • Curious and eager to learn technical systems.
  • A strong communicator
  • A proactive problem‑solver
  • Reliable and adaptable in a fast‑moving environment.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will:

  • Build, maintain, and structure datasets used for clinical trial logistics reporting.
  • Analyze and transform data, including data conversion, merging, filtering, and quality review.
  • Create operational and analytical reports for internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional CTS&L teams to support logistics planning and execution.
  • Coordinate system setup activities in alignment with project requirements and SOPs.
  • Implement updates and ensure proper documentation within ICH‑GxP guidelines.
  • Assess system outputs to ensure accuracy and readiness for project milestones.
  • Manage technical files, logs, and project records.
  • Support continuous improvement of tools, workflows, and data processes.

Additional details

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline (e.g., Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field) required.
  • Experience in a laboratory, scientific, or technical environment preferred.
  • Strong comfort working with digital tools, structured data, and relational database concepts (no programming required, but a “programming mindset” is essential)
  • Ability to work fully home‑based in Argentina.
  • Fluency in English required.
  • Familiarity with ICH‑GxP or regulated environments is a plus.
  • Experience with Biological Sample Tracking Applications (e.g. Labmatrix) is preferred.

Why join us.

  • Be part of groundbreaking projects that are pushing the boundaries of the industry.
  • Experience a collaborative and inclusive work environment that highly appreciates your expertise.
  • Unlock your full potential with professional growth and development opportunities.
  • Enjoy work‑life balance and flexible working hours.

description:

Responsible for representing Texas Mutual Insurance Company before the Texas Department of Insurance, Division of Workers' Compensation (DWC), at Benefit Review Conferences and Contested Case Hearings.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

  • Facilitates discussions and training sessions with adjusters on claim handling for the dispute resolution process

title: Senior Geotechnical Engineer
description:
Who Are We?


SSR Mining Inc. is an intermediate gold company with four producing assets located in the USA, Canada, and Argentina, combined with a global pipeline of high-quality development and exploration assets in the USA, Turkey, and Canada.


SSR’s commitment to safety, collaboration, and excellence allows us to continue building upon our already strong foundation. With an industry-leading pipeline of projects, strong financial positioning, and talented employees, we look forward to our bright future!




Job Description:

The Senior Geotechnical Engineer is responsible for independently assessing, managing, and mitigating geotechnical hazards to support safe and responsible mining activities at SSR Mining’s Cripple Creek & Victor (CC&V) Mine. This role provides geotechnical support for open pit operations and valley leach pad facilities, with a strong focus on slope stability, highwall monitoring, ground control, and risk management. The Senior Geotechnical Engineer also works closely with the underground workings mitigation (voids) team to evaluate historic underground workings and facilitate safe production in affected mining areas.

This position partners with Mine Operations, Drill & Blast, Process, and other technical teams to identify geotechnical risks, develop practical mitigation strategies, and drive continuous improvement through data analysis, monitoring systems, engineering practices, and new technologies.

Day to Day:

  • Identification and evaluation of geotechnical risks and opportunities

  • Geotechnical core logging and sampling to determine rock mass strength

  • Strong understanding and experience with open pit blasting techniques and controls

  • Understanding of 3-D geologic models, and impacts on slope stability

  • Perform engineering analysis including slope stability, structural, and rockfall hazard analysis

  • Experience with bench scale and inter-ramp scale slope design compliance

  • Working competence in surface stability software programs

  • Ensure reliability of highwall monitoring systems, ensure systems are implemented and maintained to support safe operations, and that Trigger Action Response Plans (TARPs) are in place and acted upon

  • Work with the void team to plan, schedule, and coordinate drilling campaigns to map out and analyze underground workings within the property

  • Develop or maintain mapping procedures, mapping systems and ensure data is collected in a timely manner

  • Develop geotechnical hazard model and data collection program based on site conditions

  • Perform geotechnical improvement reviews as requested, and ensure the site follows the ground control management plan

  • Ensure geotechnical risks are clearly explained to decision makers and cost-benefits are explained where possible

  • Complete and utilize highwall reconciliations to identify problems and improve the mining and modelling practices, provide guidance to drill and blast to better protect highwalls

  • Work with mine operations to identify potential geotechnical issues and clean up of dig faces

  • Closely work with process personnel to ensure slope stability of valley leach pad facilities

  • Provide mentorship for employees in the department

Is This You??

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geomechanics, Geological Engineering or related field

  • 7+ years’ experience in mining operations or geology

  • 3+ years’ experience with Leapfrog, Point Studio, RocScience Suite, and MinePlan or similar software packages

  • Python experience preferred

  • Core logging experience

  • Strong presentation, facilitation, writing and consultation skills

  • Ability to analyze data and make recommendations in a timely manner

  • Excellent interpersonal, negotiation and conflict resolution skills

  • Valid driver’s license

Working Conditions & Environment:

  • Role is based at the Cripple Creek & Victor Mine, located in Teller County, Colorado.

  • The Cripple Creek & Victor (CC&V) Mine site is located at elevations ranging from approximately 9,400 ft. to 10,600 ft. above sea level. Workers in this position are routinely exposed to conditions at various work sites throughout this range of elevations and must be physically capable of working at this altitude.

  • Weather conditions can and do change frequently and can become severe at times.

The summary provided is a basic outline of duties for the Senior Geotechnical Engineer role and is not all-inclusive. For applicants residing in CO, the salary range for this role is $125,000-$140,000. Benefits: 401(k); medical/dental/vision insurance; employee share purchase plan, PTO, and STI.

Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to SSR Mining in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where SSR Mining has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of SSR Mining and SSR Mining will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

SSR Mining Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Vice President, Investment Technology
description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares is seeking a Vice President, Regional Head of Investment Technology to lead the Mumbai Investment Technology team supporting the firm’s Real Estate and Credit investment technology platforms. This role will co-report into the Principal, Global Head of Credit Technology and the Principal, Global Head of Real Estate Technology.
This individual will serve as the regional technology leader for investment technology delivery across Real Estate and Credit, responsible for engineering execution, platform delivery, architecture alignment, operating model maturity, talent development, and day-to-day technology leadership across the Mumbai team.
The role requires a senior, hands-on technology leader who can operate across investment domains, partner effectively with global Investment Technology leadership, and translate complex investment, portfolio, asset management, data, reporting, and operational workflows into scalable technology solutions.
The successful candidate will bring deep experience leading enterprise software engineering teams within financial services, investment management, alternative asset management, or related technology environments. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical judgment, modern engineering practices, architecture depth, delivery discipline, and the ability to build and scale high-performing teams.
This individual will partner closely with Credit Technology, Real Estate Technology, Product Management, Data & AI, investment professionals, portfolio and asset management teams, investment operations, finance, risk, and broader Technology stakeholders to deliver resilient, secure, scalable, and business-aligned technology capabilities.

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES


Regional Investment Technology Leadership:
• Serve as the regional head for Investment Technology in Mumbai, supporting Real Estate and Credit technology delivery, engineering execution, and team development.
• Partner with the Investment Technology leadership to execute the global Investment Technology operating model, delivery priorities, and engineering agenda.
• Provide regional leadership across application engineering, platform delivery, data integration, support, and modernization initiatives.
• Establish a high-performance culture focused on ownership, delivery discipline, technical excellence, accountability, and partnership with the business.
• Represent Mumbai Investment Technology priorities in global planning, delivery, governance, and talent discussions.


Engineering Delivery & Execution:
• Own regional engineering delivery across Real Estate and Credit technology initiatives.
• Drive execution of software delivery plans across front-end, backend, integration, data, reporting, and platform capabilities.
• Ensure teams deliver scalable technology solutions supporting deal sourcing, underwriting, acquisitions, portfolio and asset management, credit investment workflows, risk monitoring, operations, reporting, and analytics.
• Establish clear delivery plans, execution rhythms, release discipline, and accountability for business outcomes.
• Drive improvements in software quality, delivery velocity, production stability, and operational resilience.

Architecture, Platform Modernization & Technical Standards:
• Provide senior technical leadership across application architecture, system design, integration architecture, and modern engineering practices.
• Partner with global architecture, engineering, cloud, infrastructure, security, and Data & AI teams to align solutions with enterprise technology standards.
• Drive adoption of modern cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, observability, and automated delivery practices.
• Ensure engineering teams design and build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, and aligned with long-term platform strategy.
• Evaluate technology patterns, frameworks, and delivery approaches that improve engineering effectiveness and platform outcomes.
Credit & Real Estate Platform Partnership
• Partner with Credit Technology and Real Estate Technology leaders to deliver capabilities across the full investment lifecycle.

title: TECHNINIO APTARNAVIMO INŽINIERĖ (-IUS) I IGNITIS RENEWABLES
description:
Ieškome Techninio aptarnavimo inžinierės (-iaus) būti atsakinga (-u) už elektros ir elektromechaninės įrangos techninę priežiūrą, gedimų diagnostiką bei remontą, užtikrindama (-as) saugų, patikimą ir efektyvų mūsų atsinaujinančios energetikos objektų veikimą. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos sistemos kūrimo:

  • Vykdant planinį prevencinį, korekcinį aptarnavimą bei avarinės priežiūros darbus mūsų atsinaujinančios energetikos objektuose ir susijusioje infrastruktūroje;
  • Diagnozuojant gedimų priežastis, tiriant ir šalinant elektros, mechaninių, valdymo, ryšio bei pagalbinių sistemų gedimus, siekiant užtikrinti saugų ir patikimą objektų eksploatavimą;
  • Atliekant patikras, techninės būklės vertinimą, matavimus, bandymus, paleidimo ir pakartotinio paleidimo darbus po techninės priežiūros, remonto ar modifikavimo darbų, laikantis nustatytų standartų;
  • Operatyviai reaguojant į įrangos gedimus, aliarmus ir avarines situacijas, įskaitant budėjimą pagal iškvietimą bei dalyvavimą avarinių gedimų šalinimo ir sistemos atkūrimo darbuose;
  • Kasdienėje veikloje laikantis įmonės darbuotojų saugos, sveikatos ir aplinkosaugos (HSE) reikalavimų bei procedūrų;
  • Koordinuojant ir prižiūrint rangovų, paslaugų teikėjų ir subrangovų darbą objekte, užtikrinant saugos, kokybės ir techninių reikalavimų laikymąsi;
  • Tvarkant ir nuolat atnaujinant techninės priežiūros įrašus, patikrų ataskaitas, techninę dokumentaciją, užtikrinant, kad visi atlikti darbai būtų tinkamai dokumentuojami;
  • Stebint, kontroliuojant ir teikiant ataskaitas apie atsarginių dalių, įrankių, eksploatacinių medžiagų ir kitų resursų naudojimą;
  • Nuolat tobulinant profesinę kvalifikaciją dalyvaujant techniniuose, saugos, įrangos gamintojų ir pramonės sektoriaus mokymuose.
  • Aukštesnysis arba aukštasis išsilavinimas inžinerijos, elektros inžinerijos ar susijusioje srityje;
  • 2-3 metų patirtis elektros energijos gamybos objektų projektavimo, eksploatavimo arba techninės priežiūros srityje (patirtis atsinaujinančios energetikos sektoriuje būtų laikoma privalumu);
  • Patirtis dirbant su vidutinės įtampos (iki 35 kV) ir (arba) aukštos įtampos (iki 330 kV) įranga būtų laikoma privalumu;
  • Geros elektros įrenginių, valdymo sistemų ir saugos standartų žinios (papildomos mechaninės įrangos žinios būtų laikomos privalumu);
  • GWO (Global Wind Organisation) mokymų pažymėjimai būtų laikomi privalumu;
  • Anglų kalbos žinios A2-B1 lygiu.

Mes suteikiame išsamius mokymus, susijusius su darbu sauga, elektrosauga bei darbu su specialiais įrankiais, kurie padės jums sėkmingai įsilieti į šias pareigas.

  • Numatomas pasyvus budėjimas iš namų iki 20 val. pamaininiu grafiku, skiriant papildomą atlygio priedą;
  • Metinę premiją – iki 10 % metinio atlyginimo;
  • Papildomą sveikatos draudimą po bandomojo laikotarpio;
  • Draudimą nuo nelaimingų atsitikimų nuo pirmos darbo dienos;
  • Papildomas 3 apmokamas sveikatos dienas ir finansinę pagalbą ypatingais gyvenimo atvejais;
  • Modernią ir saugią darbo aprangą bei įrangą, kurią suteikia ir prižiūri įmonė (taip pat apmokamas mobilusis ryšys);
  • Naujus bendrus įmonės automobilius darbo reikmėms;
  • Tarptautinę komandą, dirbančia su žaliosios energetikos projektais;
  • Karjeros galimybes.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Director of Continuous Improvement (CI) & Quality
description:
Job Description
JOB TITLE: Director of Continuous Improvement (CI) & Quality
DEPARTMENT: Maintenance/Process Improvement
FLSA: Exempt
REPORTS TO: Chief Operating Officer
SUMMARY
The Director of Continuous Improvement (CI) & Quality plays a pivotal leadership role in driving operational excellence within a durable goods manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for developing and executing strategic initiatives that enhance product quality, streamline manufacturing processes, and foster a culture of continuous improvement across all levels of the organization. The Director will lead cross-functional teams to identify inefficiencies, implement best practices, and ensure compliance with industry standards and customer requirements. By leveraging data-driven methodologies and quality management systems, this role aims to reduce waste, improve product reliability, and increase overall customer satisfaction. Ultimately, the Director of CI & Quality will be instrumental in sustaining competitive advantage through innovation, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.

Requirements

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Develop and implement comprehensive continuous improvement strategies aligned with corporate goals to enhance manufacturing efficiency and product quality.
• Lead and mentor a team of quality assurance and continuous improvement professionals to drive performance improvements and foster a culture of accountability.
• Oversee quality management systems (QMS) ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and customer specifications.
• Collaborate with engineering, production, supply chain, and other departments to identify root causes of quality issues and implement corrective actions.
• Utilize Lean, Six Sigma, and other process improvement methodologies to analyze workflows, reduce variability, and eliminate waste.
• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality and operational performance, providing regular reports and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Manage audits, both internal and external, and lead initiatives to address findings and improve audit readiness.
• Drive supplier quality management programs to ensure incoming materials meet required standards and support overall product quality objectives.
• Drive continuous improvement (CI) initiatives across manufacturing and logistics processes, utilizing Lean, Six Sigma, or other industry best practices to optimize workflows, reduce waste, and increase productivity without compromising quality.
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) specific to the furniture manufacturing process, tracking metrics like production yield, inventory turnover, lead time, and cost efficiency.
• Lead cross-functional teams to identify and implement improvements across manufacturing, distribution, and customer fulfillment, ensuring alignment with luxury brand standards and customer expectations.
• Develop and standardize operating procedures (SOPs) and best practices across all operational functions to ensure efficiency, consistency, and high product quality.
• Drive a culture of continuous improvement within the organization, fostering collaboration and innovation across teams while maintaining a high standard of craftsmanship.
• Manage operational budgets, including cost forecasting, resource allocation, and capital expenditures, while ensuring cost-efficiency without compromising product quality.
• Report on the effectiveness of operational initiatives to senior leadership, offering data-driven insights and recommending areas for improvement.
• Lead change management initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new processes, tools, or technologies that support operational excellence.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
• Analytical and problem-solving skills daily to assess manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Strong leadership and communication skills are essential for guiding teams, facilitating cross-departmental collaboration, and presenting findings to executive leadership.
• Expertise in Lean and Six Sigma methodologies enables the Director to design and implement effective process improvements that reduce defects and increase efficiency.
• Proficiency with quality management systems and data analysis tools supports the monitoring of performance metrics and drives data-informed decision-making.
• Negotiation and supplier management skills are applied to ensure that external partners meet stringent quality standards, contributing to the overall success of the manufacturing operation.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality Management, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of experience in operations management, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership or director-level role within the luxury furniture or high-end manufacturing industry.
• Proven experience in managing complex manufacturing operations while maintaining a focus on quality and luxury craftsmanship.
• Strong proficiency with MS Office Suite, project management tools, ERP systems, and manufacturing software.
• Strong knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and industry-specific standards.
• Demonstrated expertise in Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma methodologies, and root cause analysis.
• Certification as a Six Sigma Black Belt or Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt preferred.

title: Sr. Engineer - Value Engineering
description:
The Sr. Value Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for working cross functionally to identify, develop and implement enterprise-wide value engineering processes and tools. This role will also act as a subject matter resource as needed to facilitate value engineering activities. This role will be instrumental in the identification and implementation of cost savings and ensuring that value is maximized across the full product lifecycle with solutions for cost, quality, and scale through a collaborative, cross-functional approach.

Essential Job Duties

  • Develop and Implement Value Engineering Processes and embed them into Intuitive’s broader business practices, such as the Product Development Process (PDP). Standardize and incorporate best practices to improve product cost, quality, and scale.

  • Collaboratively lead the identification, assessment, recommendation and implementation of Value Engineering Tools to be integrated into Intuitive’s broader business practices, such as Should Cost modeling and Design For Manufacturing (DFM). Standardize and incorporate best practices to improve product cost, quality, and scale.

  • Become a subject matter resource on various value engineering methodologies (FAST, Should Cost, DFx, etc). Facilitate Value Engineering workshops as required.

  • Develop training as needed to support embed the value engineering capability and mindset within the extended enterprise.

  • Collaborate with the extended enterprise to identify and drive systemic Value Engineering opportunities into focused actions necessary to accomplish overarching targets for released and new products.

  • Work with the extended enterprise to influence supplier technology roadmaps to ensure Intuitive system and instrument technical requirements are met.

  • Work with the extended enterprise to define criteria/guidelines for design for manufacturing based on process, and best practices for qualifying components.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Knowledge of value engineering and/or value analysis processes and tools.

  • Product design and analysis skills, including ability to interpret detailed drawings and execute tolerance stack-ups for assemblies.

  • Familiar with common manufacturing processes utilized to produce both low and high-volume components and assemblies.

  • Strong technical skills involving problem solving, DFM, and should-cost/could-cost.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of component manufacturing processes utilized in the medical device industry (e.g., injection molding, stamping, machining, etc)

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent interpersonal skills.

  • Experience training and/or facilitating value engineering workshops is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with medical device design, control and validation regulatory requirements is a plus.

Required Education and Training

  • Minimum Education & Experience: BS degree in Engineering with 7+ year’s of experience or Masters plus 5 or PhD plus 3 in design engineering, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, supplier engineering, preferably in the med device industry.

  • Certified Value Methodology Associate or Value Specialist preferred.

Working Conditions

title: Senior Software Engineer (Digital Engineering & Semantic Data)
description:
Job Description:

Salary Range:

Senior Engineer £45000 - £60000

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your Impact

Are you an experienced software engineer who enjoys tackling complex technical problems? Do you thrive in collaborative environments and want to contribute to the development of new capabilities that have a real impact across a wider business?

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the GCAP Enablers team and help develop innovative digital engineering capabilities that support the next generation of aerospace programmes. Working as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the design and development of software solutions that improve how engineering information is created, connected, and used across the product lifecycle.

You will work alongside software engineers, systems engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to solve complex challenges, while having opportunities to learn and apply modern technologies and approaches. This role is ideal for a software craftsman who is motivated by the challenge of building high-abstraction digital environments and is eager to apply their skills to a cutting-edge technical project.

What you’ll bring

You will help build the digital fabric that connects our distributed engineering landscape. By implementing a graph-based "Digital Thread," you will enable the seamless flow of enriched information across partners and teams, ensuring that our engineering ecosystem is resilient, scalable, and logically consistent.

  • Implementing the Digital Thread: Developing software that transforms fragmented data from disparate sources into a unified, ontology-driven Knowledge Graph.
  • Enabling Composable Engineering: Building a digital environment where relationships between engineering artefacts are first-class citizens, allowing for flexible and concurrent views of the system.
  • Solving Distributed Interoperability: Creating mechanisms that allow tenuously connected environments and partners to contribute to a shared semantic representation without requiring rigid, point-to-point tool integration.
  • Driving Strategic Adoption: Contributing to the overall strategy for the wider adoption of Knowledge Graphs and semantic technologies across the business to solve complex data challenges.
  • Ensuring Digital Rigour: Implementing the configuration control and concurrency models that ensure the Digital Thread remains a reliable, authoritative source of truth at scale.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key implementer of our digital engineering construct. You will move beyond "glue code" to build a high-abstraction layer based on semantic web principles.

Semantic Implementation & Graph Engineering

  • Develop and maintain the software implementation of the Digital Thread using the Semantic Web stack (e.g., RDF, OWL, SPARQL).
  • Build and optimise the graph databases and triple stores that house the engineering relationships and enrichments.
  • Implement the logic that allows for the "enrichment" of data as it moves through the thread, adding semantic value and context.

Adapter Development & Data Mapping

  • Develop tool adapters that map local data schemas to a global ontology, ensuring that tool-specific data is ingested into the graph without losing semantic meaning.
  • Focus on "mapping to the model" rather than "mapping to the tool," preventing the proliferation of fragile, point-to-point integrations.

Concurrency & Configuration Control

  • Architect and implement the versioning and configuration control mechanisms for the Digital Thread graph, ensuring that changes are traceable and concurrent access is managed.
  • Develop software patterns that allow the graph to remain performant and consistent across a large, distributed programme.

Technical Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Principal Systems Engineer to translate formal ontologies into performant software implementations.
  • Collaborate with other software engineers to ensure the Digital Thread provides the exact enablers they need to achieve quality at pace.

What You’ll Bring

Software Engineering Mastery

  • Strong Coding Foundation: Proven expertise in a modern language (e.g., Python, Java, Node, or TypeScript) with a deep commitment to software craftsmanship and clean code.
  • Complex Data Experience: Experience handling data from heterogeneous, distributed sources. While experience with the Semantic Web stack (RDF, OWL, SPARQL) or Graph Databases (Neo4j, GraphDB, Stardog, etc.) is highly desirable, we value a strong engineering mindset and a willingness to learn these technologies.
  • Distributed Systems Knowledge: An understanding of the challenges associated with "tenuously connected" digital environments and distributed data.
  • Software Craftsmanship: A commitment to SOLID principles, maintainable architecture, and automated testing.

Professional Attributes

  • A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • An interest in Knowledge Engineering and the ability to think in terms of relationships and abstractions.
  • A mindset that prioritises composability and scalability over quick, hard-coded fixes.

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit:

Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
  • Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
  • Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
  • Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
  • Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
  • Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
  • Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
  • Flexible working: Flexible hours are available. Due to the nature of this role, full-time, on-site working is required. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.

At Leonardo we are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people and our customers. title: Event Delivery Lead (Casual) - Upper Mount Gravatt
description:
Who We Are

At Contour, we’re reshaping education, one student at a time.


Born from the frustration of students who knew the system could be better, we set out to build what we once wished existed: tutoring that actually works. Not generic classes. Not recycled notes. Not overpriced, overcrowded rooms with an out-of-touch teacher who couldn’t relate. But a complete ecosystem of tutoring, resources, and support, meticulously designed to help every student reach their full potential.

Since 2020, over 10,000+ students have trusted Contour to guide their academic journey, and we’ve grown to over 300+ team members. We’ve produced hundreds of 99+ ATARs, tutored the World-Record UCAT scorer, and placed more students into medical school than any school in Australia.

Our growth is a testament to the simple philosophy: Put the student first, always. Everything we design, from our world-class tutor-training programs to our purpose-built campuses, exists to help students master content faster, perform with confidence, and even rekindle the joy of learning.


Contour is a group of three brands united by one goal: to give every student the best chance to achieve their full potential:

  • Contour Education: Reshaping how students master their high school subjects with small-group tutoring, structured resources, and 1-on-1 support across Maths, Science, and English.
  • Contour Medprep: Reshaping medical preparation with a proven, step-by-step pathway through the UCAT, interviews, and admissions, led by a team of 100+ medical students.
  • Contour TestPrep: Reshaping test preparation, starting with the selective entry exam, through rigorous tutoring, mock exams, and data-driven feedback to give students a decisive advantage.

This is Contour. Built by students, for students.

What You Will Do

  • End-to-end event delivery – Lead on-site logistics, timetabling, and team coordination for student assessments and events at our Upper Mount Gravatt campus.
  • Flawless planning – Map out detailed timelines, floor plans, and run sheets to ensure seamless execution from setup to pack-down.
  • Rigorous documentation – Build clear checklists, site manuals, and operational guides to keep every event component fully aligned.
  • On-site leadership – Serve as the calm, authoritative point of contact for casual staff, venue managers, students, and internal teams.
  • Staff management & briefs – Roster, brief, and guide casual invigilators and event teams to maintain high standards of delivery.
  • Exam integrity & supervision – Direct and oversee assessment rooms to ensure a highly structured, quiet, and strictly compliant environment.
  • Student wellbeing & equity – Facilitate approved Special Examination Arrangements and handle student needs with poise and professionalism.
  • Daily agile briefings – Lead daily team huddles during multi-day events to surface challenges, gather feedback, and implement rapid fixes.
  • Resource & budget control – Manage printing, stationery, and vendor sourcing while keeping event expenses strictly within approved budgets.
  • Venue evaluation – Conduct thorough site visits and assessment checks to inform venue selection and operational design.
  • Registration & attendance – Oversee event software to manage check-in flows and accurately track student attendance in real time.

What You Will Bring

  • Event operations background with proven experience in coordination, exam delivery, or logistics is ideal.
  • Casual team leadership exposure is desirable, but full training and onboarding support are provided.
  • Operational mastery with a track record of managing timelines, documentation, compliance, and event budgets.
  • Tech confidence navigating registration platforms, booking software, and standard office tools.
  • Unshakable composure to stay calm, sharp, and decisive during live, on-the-day surprises.
  • Meticulous precision and high attention to detail across candidate data, venue manuals, and procedures.
  • Exceptional organization, time management, and clear written communication skills.
  • Student-first mindset dedicated to maintaining a safe, calm, and supportive environment.
  • Required clearances – Valid Queensland Working with Children Check (Blue Card).
  • Reliable availability to work on-site at our Upper Mount Gravatt campus for shifts tied directly to the event calendar.

Why You Will Love It

  • Join a vibrant, fast-growing educational ecosystem that has impacted over 15,000+ students.
  • Gain access to full training, comprehensive site manuals, and dedicated support to set you up for success.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of casual work that varies naturally with our event schedules.
  • Opportunity for career development to progress within the Operations department as the organisation grows.
  • Competitive casual hourly rates with the benefits of a collaborative, purpose-driven team environment.

How To Apply

If you care about delivering seamless event experiences and putting students first, we’d love to hear from you.

Application Process

  • Suitable candidates will then be invited for an interview

  • Interpretation and execution of contractual credit and loan agreements

Join the industry’s #1 lead arranger and bookrunner of syndicated asset-based loans (YTD 9/2024, Source: Refinitiv/Wells Fargo).
